jobs.title: Robotics Software Engineer, Autonomy
jobs.description:
Join Us, and Ship Robots

Weave was founded to build the robots we’d want to have in our own home. We believe the next generation of robotics will transform everyday life by enabling people to do more and to reclaim time to spend on what’s important.

We also believe robots are in a sense like any other product: to matter, they have to ship. Our robots are already operating in real homes and businesses, giving us the opportunity to rapidly improve from real-world experience. With a growing team, strong customer demand, and capital for expansion, we’re entering an exciting stage of growth—and we’re looking for people with exceptional talent and standards to help bring home robotics to millions of households.

The Role

Weave is building robots that work in real customer homes. We’re looking for a software engineer with strong robotics fundamentals who enjoys developing algorithms, designing systems, and making them work on physical machines. You’ll develop software for localization, motion planning, and autonomy, with a role in the architecture that connects these capabilities. The work spans mathematical modeling, algorithm development, sensor integration, and system validation. You should enjoy making thoughtful design decisions and following an idea from its formulation through implementation and measured performance on a robot.

We value strong fundamentals, practical judgment, and curiosity across disciplines. You might bring years of experience developing robotic systems, or a smaller set of substantial projects that demonstrate depth and resourcefulness. There’s room to investigate new methods and deepen your expertise, with success measured by what our robots can reliably do.

What You'll Do

Localization and state estimation: Develop algorithms that combine IMUs, cameras, wheel odometry, and other measurements to estimate robot motion and maintain reliable localization.
Trajectory analysis and motion planning: Analyze robot trajectories and develop planning algorithms that account for geometry, kinematics, obstacles, and execution constraints.
System architecture and validation: Make system-level decisions about computation, timing, data flow, and component responsibilities. Define metrics and validation methods to assess accuracy, latency, robustness, and overall behavior.
AI and autonomy: Assess research in AI and robotics, evaluate emerging autonomy architectures, and integrate promising approaches where they improve robot capabilities and reliability.
Sensors and hardware: Integrate and characterize sensors, manage calibration and synchronization, and understand how hardware limitations and environmental conditions affect algorithm performance.
Software architecture: Design maintainable C++ and Python software, clear interfaces, and reliable communication across the robotics stack, using ROS 2 and other frameworks or custom infrastructure as appropriate.

What You'll Bring

Hands-on robotics experience: You’ve implemented and tested algorithms on physical systems and worked through the gap between a clean formulation and imperfect hardware.
Strong mathematical foundations: You’re comfortable with linear algebra, coordinate transformations, probability, and numerical optimization. You can reason about uncertainty, assumptions, and failure modes.
Depth in a core robotics discipline: Substantial experience in state estimation, sensor fusion, SLAM, motion planning, trajectory optimization, or control, with an interest in learning adjacent areas.
Algorithmic understanding: You understand the principles behind the methods you use. Relevant experience might include Kalman or particle filtering, factor graphs, bundle adjustment, graph search, constrained optimization, or model predictive control.
Strong software engineering: Experience implementing algorithms in C++, using Python or similar tools for experimentation and analysis, and contributing to maintainable software within a team.
Experimental judgment: You can design an informative experiment, compare results against ground truth or other meaningful references, and distinguish an algorithmic limitation from an integration or sensor problem.
Curiosity and ownership: You’re willing to investigate unfamiliar parts of the system and carry a problem through to a tested solution.

Nice To Have

Experience integrating multiple sensor modalities, including cameras, IMUs, wheel encoders, LiDAR, or radar.
Experience with sensor characterization, calibration, system identification, or parameter estimation.
Experience deploying algorithms under onboard compute, power, or latency constraints.
Familiarity with ROS or ROS 2.
Experience with mobile robots or mobile manipulators.
Experience evaluating learned methods for perception, estimation, or planning.

You don’t need experience in every area listed. We’re interested in the systems you’ve built, the fundamentals you understand deeply, and how you approach problems you haven’t solved before.

At Sonos we want to create the ultimate listening experience for our customers and know that it starts by listening to each other. As part of the Sonos team, you’ll collaborate with people of all styles, skill sets, and backgrounds to realize our vision while fostering a community where everyone feels included and empowered to do the best work of their lives.

Sonos is a sound experience company making it easier than ever for millions of listeners around the world to play more, hear more, and feel more. We’re seeking talented students to join Sonos’s Internship Program and explore what it means to blend creativity, technology, and sound. Our interns are an essential part of our team, bringing fresh ideas, learning from experts, and helping us push the boundaries of what’s possible. Come broaden your skills, share your input and pursue your passion with a 11 week internship experience.

Work Period:
June 7- August 20, 2027

Location & Schedule:
This is a 40-hour-per-week position with minimum 4 days per week onsite in our Seattle
office. There is no relocation or housing assistance for this position.

As a Software Engineer
, you will contribute to the foundational pieces of our system, ensuring high-quality and reliable operation. You will collaborate with a team of industry-leading innovators across various disciplines, including hardware, product management, and user experience. If you enjoy solving challenging problems and delivering high-quality products, we want to talk with you!

What You’ll Do

As a Software Engineer, you’ll work on a cross-functional team to design and build product features and capabilities. Examples include:

Building world class speaker products and solving challenges in areas involving embedded software development for multi-room audio processing, networking, security and user experience.
Working on the next generation of services and APIs for controlling the Sonos system as part of a smart, internet-connected home.
Empowering our users to listen better by making it easy to access new, relevant content.
Adding new features to the mobile applications that let our users control and listen to their audio content on their system.
Creating a semantic data layer to empower machine learning and AI to leverage data and diagnostics.
Using AI tools to automate critical software development workflows to improve developer productivity, experience, and security.

Skills And Attributes

Basic Qualifications

Currently enrolled in a College or University with a preferred field of study in Computer Science, Software Engineering or equivalent
Demonstrated proficiency writing code with one or more of the following: Swift/Kotlin, C/C++, Java, Python
Familiarity with version control such as Git
Understanding of the software development lifecycle and continuous integration and deployment techniques
Implementing automated and self service software engineering processes

App Development: Kotlin, Swift
Embedded Software: C/C++, Audio Processing, Networking, Security, AOSP
Data: Tableau, OpenSearch, Snowflake, DataDog and other system reliability and quality tracking tools

Experience with AWS Cloud Services
Experience with CI/CD build and release pipelines: Github Actions, Jenkins, Azure Pipelines, etc

Program Qualifications

Currently enrolled in an undergraduate program at a College or University, with expected graduation date of Winter 2027/2028 or Spring 2028/2029.
Available to participate in our internship program from June to August
Ability to work out of our Seattle office a minimum 4 days per week
Authorized to work for any US employer, both now and in the future. Sonos is unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa for this role at this time.

Your profile will be reviewed and you'll hear from us once we have an update. At Sonos we take the time to hire right and appreciate your patience.

A generous employee discount program & Sonos Radio HD - on us!

jobs.title: Application Development Intern
jobs.description:
Overview

Keysight is at the forefront of technology innovation, delivering breakthroughs and trusted insights in electronic design, simulation, prototyping, test, manufacturing, and optimization. Our ~16,800 employees create world-class solutions in communications, 5G, automotive, energy, quantum, aerospace, defense, and semiconductor markets for customers in over 100 countries. Learn more about what we do.

Our award-winning culture embraces a bold vision of where technology can take us and a passion for tackling challenging problems with industry-first solutions. We believe that when people feel a sense of belonging, they can be more creative, innovative, and thrive at all points in their careers.

We are excited to announce that we are looking for a talented individual to join our team as a Configure, Price Quote (CPQ) Knowledge Engineer (KE) & Application Development Intern. In this role, the candidate will be assisting with the development and maintenance of Product Configuration applications (e.g., Logik.AI), ensuring seamless integration with our existing systems, and optimizing the configuration and pricing processes. We are seeking someone with strong technical skills, a keen eye for detail, and a passion for innovation. If you are looking for an opportunity to work in a dynamic and collaborative environment, we would love to hear from you!

Knowledge Engineers (KEs) collaborate cross-functionally with Marketing, R&D, Order Fulfillment, and Order Management to design ERP product structures and configurations for new product/option introductions with selectable features and pricing. KEs are responsible for automating the generation of accurate product quotes and orders for customers quickly and efficiently, improving quote and sales efficiency. KEs ensure that product configuration complexity is hidden using logical rules to display only relevant product selections and feature information in compliance with product specifications and Keysight Standards, guiding Keysight customers, sales representatives, and field engineers through product selection and configuration.

In the KE Team we also develop applied solutions for streamlining & modernizing digitized processes within Technology Order Fulfillment (TOF), replacing manual processes with innovative informatics and software solutions to increase configuration and operations productivity.

Responsibilities

Primary Responsibilities:

Design new ways to optimize and improve the product quote-to-order process and experience.
Reduce new product introduction time to market through innovative product structure, configuration and related processes or solutions.
Deliver and maintain Technology Order Fulfillment (TOF) software solutions for configuration and operations which complement Keysight Enterprise Solutions.
Drive increased efficiency and productivity.
Modernize existing processes and digital assets with a focus on reducing or replacing manual work and eliminating waste.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications:

Pursuing a BS in Computer Engineering, Computer Science or equivalent degree
Proficient with standard Microsoft Office suite (e.g., Excel, Outlook, MS Word, etc.)
Good oral and written communication skills
Experience with web application development
Experience with object-oriented programming

Desired Qualifications

Experience using Microsoft Visual Studio
Working knowledge of the Angular framework or a similar framework, such as React
Understanding of REST APIs and CRUD (Create, Read, Update, Delete) operations
Experience with Atlassian tools, including Confluence, Jira, and Bitbucket
Knowledge of relational databases, SQL, or T-SQL
Ability to analyze data using applications such as Power BI, report builder, or other data visualization tools.

The level of role will be based on applicable experience, education and skills; most offers will be between the minimum and the midpoint of the salary range listed below.

CA pay range: MIN $32.03 to MAX $34.49

Note: for other locations, pay ranges will vary by region.

Relocation is available for this position.

jobs.title: Software Engineer - New Grad, Distributed Data Systems (2027 Start)
jobs.description:
P-965

At Databricks, we are obsessed with enabling data teams to solve the world's toughest problems, from security threat detection to cancer drug development. We do this by building and running the world's best data and AI infrastructure platform, so our customers can focus on the high value challenges that are central to their own missions.

Our mission at Databricks is to radically simplify the whole data lifecycle from ingestion to ETL, BI, and all the way up to ML/AI with a unified platform. To achieve this goal, we believe the data warehouse architecture as we know it today will be replaced by a new architectural pattern, Lakehouse (CIDR 2021 paper), open platforms that unify data warehousing and advanced analytics. The new architecture will help address several major challenges, including data staleness, reliability, total cost of ownership, data lock-in, and limited use-case support.

As part of this team, you could be working in one or more of the following areas:

Query compilation and optimization
Distributed query execution and scheduling
Vectorized execution engine
Data security
Resource management
Transaction coordination
Efficient storage structures (encodings, indexes)
Automatic physical data optimization
Data plane storage
Storage management system

You will graduate in Fall 2026 or Spring 2027 with a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related subject
You have implementation skills with a general purpose program language, such as Java, or C++
You have knowledge of algorithms, data structures, and OOP principles
A passion for database systems, storage systems, distributed systems, language design, or performance optimization

jobs.title: Embedded Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Nuro believes self-driving vehicles are the most immediate and profound opportunity for AI to drive positive change in the physical world. Safer streets, more time for what matters, and easier access to the world around us, that’s why we’re building a universal autonomy platform: self-driving for all roads and all rides.

Founded in 2016, Nuro is a physical AI company developing Level 4 autonomous driving technology for a wide range of vehicles, use cases, and markets. Powered by the Nuro Driver™, our universal autonomy platform enables the global mobility ecosystem to deploy autonomy at scale, from robotaxis and logistics fleets to personal vehicles.

With years of real-world deployment experience and a flexible, partner-led business model, Nuro is working toward a future where millions of autonomous vehicles powered by our technology help make everyday life safer, easier, and more connected.

Nuro has raised over $2B in capital from Uber, NVIDIA, Google, Softbank, Fidelity, T. Rowe Price, and other leading investors.

About The Role

Nuro operates real self-driving vehicles on public roads today — not a research platform, not ADAS. The Embedded Software Engineering team builds the software for the safety-critical embedded controllers that connect the Nuro Driver™ to the vehicle: the devices that command steering, braking, and propulsion, alongside other vehicle actuators, distribute and monitor power, monitor vehicle motion, and bring the vehicle to a safe state when something goes wrong.

As an Embedded Software Engineer, you will work across the full stack of multicore automotive microcontrollers from RTOS, drivers, and scheduler up through middleware and application components that talk to the vehicle, and help extend that stack as our hardware evolves. You will bring the Nuro Driver™ up on new vehicle platforms alongside OEM and supplier engineers, and see your code drive real vehicles on public roads. We're hiring across levels, from engineers with a couple years of embedded experience to those who've shipped a production automotive launch.

About The Work

Design, implement and test embedded C software for safety-critical multicore automotive microcontrollers, spanning base software such as RTOS, device drivers, scheduling and bootloader, middleware such as inter-component messaging and end-to-end protection, and application components such as actuator interface, body controls, power management and fault management.
Integrate the Nuro Driver™ with new vehicle platforms: define and implement CAN and Ethernet interfaces with OEM ECUs, adapt actuator and body-control interfaces, and validate them on bench and in vehicle.
Take part in hands-on device and vehicle bring-up, prototyping and debugging on multiple vehicle platforms, from first power-on to autonomous driving.
Build and maintain the team's verification infrastructure: unit tests, hardware-in-the-loop benches and vehicle test procedures.
Work within an ISO 26262 development process: define software requirements from system safety requirements, then implement and verify them with full traceability.
Collaborate daily with systems, safety, hardware, controls and autonomy engineers, and with OEM and supplier partners, from definition through verification.

About You

B.S. or higher in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering or a closely related field.
2+ years of industry experience developing embedded software in C, including work on a real-time operating system.
Solid computer science fundamentals: data structures, concurrency and algorithm design.
Working knowledge of microcontroller internals and peripherals, with depth in at least one of device driver development, CAN or automotive Ethernet, bootloaders and software update, embedded security, or vehicle-level integration and test.
Strong problem-solving and debugging skills, clear written and spoken communication, and a track record of working well with engineers from other disciplines.
Comfortable at the bench with debug probes, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers and CAN tools. You enjoy finding out why hardware and software disagree.

Bonus Points

3+ years of embedded development in the automotive or autonomous vehicle industry, including a production launch.
Hands-on functional safety experience with ISO 26262, or safety-critical development in another regulated industry such as DO-178C or IEC 62304.
Experience with Infineon AURIX TC3xx, SafeRTOS or FreeRTOS, or AUTOSAR Classic base software such as MCAL and communication stacks.
Vehicle network integration experience: DBC and ARXML, UDS diagnostics, E2E protection, time synchronization.
Knowledge of vehicle functions, vehicle dynamics or control theory.

At Nuro, your base pay is one part of your total compensation package. For this position, the reasonably expected base pay range is between $145,830 and $219,000 for the level at which this job has been scoped. Your base pay will depend on several factors, including your experience, qualifications, education, location, and skills. In the event that you are considered for a different level, a higher or lower pay range would apply. This position is also eligible for an annual performance bonus, equity, and a competitive benefits package.

Nuro is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and expressly prohibits any form of workplace discrimination based on race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics.

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Customer Success
jobs.description:
At Feedzai, we're building a world of safer money. A world where financial institutions move faster than criminals. Where the payments that fund real lives through salaries, savings, and businesses are protected in real time. We use trusted AI to detect and prevent financial crime, fraud, and money laundering at scale: the world's top banks, payment networks, and acquirers trust our technology to safeguard more than one billion consumers and $9 trillion in payment volume every year.

Feedzai is a Series D company and has raised $282M to date. With a valuation of $2 billion, our technology protects 1 billion consumers and 90 billion transactions each year.

The Customer Success Engineering
team works directly with clients and partners to ensure that every technical aspect of our product—installation, configuration, and customization—is delivered smoothly and at the highest standard. We act as technical consultants, helping clients solve complex and unique challenges. Our team is dynamic, persistent, and committed to delivering a world-class experience. If you’re excited about being a client-facing engineer who makes a real impact, this is the opportunity for you.

You

As a Professional Software Engineer in the Customer Success Department, you will serve as a technical consultant to our clients, ensuring our solutions align with their unique architectural and business needs. You will guide clients through complex integration and performance management strategies, leveraging your deep technical expertise in SQL, NoSQL, Cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP), and messaging systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ). While you will advise on the installation and configuration of our platform, you will also apply your hands-on engineering skills to design and implement custom Java interfaces, web service integrations, and bespoke extensions for our Fraud Analysis platform. Working alongside Data Scientists, Project Managers, and Fraud Analysts, you will translate client challenges into robust, scalable technical requirements and remain actively involved in executing those requirements when specialized development is required.

Your Day To Day

Consult with clients to define technical requirements and architectural approaches for custom integrations.
Develop high-quality, testable Java code for custom extensions and complex integrations when standard configurations do not meet specific client needs.
Diagnose complex performance and integration challenges, providing expert guidance and code-level solutions to ensure system stability.
Act as a strategic bridge between client business goals and technical execution, translating needs into efficient, scalable software solutions.
Contribute to and advocate for engineering best practices, ensuring that custom work remains maintainable and aligned with the core product roadmap.
Mentor, coach, and inspire other team members, helping foster best practices in software development and technical consulting.
Work with Agile principles to regularly deliver quality products.
Provide Second Tier support for live clients.

You Have & You Know-how

A Bachelor of Science and/or a Master of Science in Computer Science, a degree in a comparable field, or equivalent work experience;
3 years of work experience in Java software development;
Thread and JVM Memory Management in high-performance systems;
Client engagement experience and ability to act as a consultant to our clients;
Excellent English communication skills, both verbal and written;
Experience with Zookeeper, RabbitMQ, Cassandra, Ansible, Docker, and databases (nice to have).

The Customer Success
Team is responsible for delivering our product to our clients. This includes configuration, solution development, and risk strategy to enable them to address their pain points. We collaborate with our clients to ensure they have the right solution, build out a strategy and training plan for them, and then support them through each phase of our client lifecycle. We grow at a fast clip and believe no challenge is too big or too small. Therefore, we have an open environment that encourages us to lean in, try new things, and discover our potential. Join us!

Your First 30-Days At Feedzai

You will be immersed in our brand with training, connections, and one-on-one time with your manager. You may shadow your colleagues virtually or onsite at an office depending on where you work as you are supported through your Feedzai journey. In addition, you will have access to a ton of information to give you history, context, and all the knowledge you can handle about Feedzai and the team. Finally, you will start working on projects and collaborating on work currently being done. We can't wait to have you join the team!

Design, develop, and deliver features for the Portfolio Management suite.

Qualifications

Strong communication skills and the ability to work with product, QE, and platform partners.
Familiarity with developing products that are accessibility compliant (WCAG).

About Activate Care:

At Activate Care, we're on a mission to improve health equity and drive better health outcomes across the country. Our Care Link platform enables healthcare and community organizations to coordinate care for populations challenged with health-related social needs (HRSN). Path Assist is our tech-enabled community health worker program for HRSN that uses an evidence-based, structured intervention to help individuals build confidence managing their health and accessing the resources they need. Our goal is simple: increase health confidence, improve self-efficacy, and reduce inappropriate healthcare spending.

About the Role:

Our platform helps healthcare providers and community organizations coordinate care for individuals facing complex medical and social challenges. The systems we build support real-time collaboration across health records, referral networks, and community services.

As a Software Engineer at Activate Care, you will help design and build the tools that power this coordination. You will work alongside experienced engineers, product managers, and designers to deliver high-quality software that directly supports organizations improving outcomes for vulnerable populations.

You'll contribute across the full development lifecycle—from designing solutions and writing production code to improving system quality and participating in technical discussions within your team.

Responsibilities:

Implement well-specified features with guidance from senior engineers
Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code that supports system reliability and scalability
Contribute to responsive web applications and progressive web apps
Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and team ceremonies
Write and maintain automated tests to ensure system reliability
Collaborate with product and design teams to deliver user-focused solutions
Document code, specifications, and workflows for clarity and reusability
Learn and apply prompt engineering, AI-assisted dev tools, and automation frameworks to accelerate productivity

Requirements

Qualifications & Skills:

Must Have:

Minimum of a High School Diploma with an equivalent of 4+ years of Software Engineering experience, or a Bachelor's Degree in a related field
3+ years of experience working as a Software Engineer, healthcare experience is preferred
Experience working effectively within Agile/Scrum teams
Advanced ability to communicate technical concepts effectively to both technical and non technical stakeholders
Willingness, and ability to learn new technologies, adapt to feedback and continuously improve technical skills

Core Technical Skills

Experience building applications using Ruby on Rails, Ruby Sinatra, or Node JS /Fastify
Frontend development experience with React, Svelte and modern JavaScript
Experience building scalable responsive web applications and progressive web apps using HTML/CSS
Experience with Native web applications is a plus

Experience developing and integrating RESTful APIs and web services
Familiarity with relational or document databases such as PostgreSQL, MongoDB, or EdgeDB
Experience with background job processing systems such as ActiveJob, Sidekiq, or Resque

Productivity & AI-Enhanced Development

Experience using Cursor, MCP agents, LLMs, or Ollama
Strong understanding of prompt engineering concepts
Exposure to CI/CD pipelines such as Jenkins or CircleCI
Familiarity with development automation and workflow optimization

Software Engineering Principles

Strong understanding of separation of concerns, code quality, and maintainable architecture
Experience designing and implementing well-tested features
Familiarity with multiple quality domains such as functionality, performance, and reliability
Experience with testing frameworks such as Cypress, MiniTest, or other automated testing approaches
Experience working with Git workflows, pull requests, and collaborative development practices

Nice to Have:

Experience maintaining Ruby on Rails applications in production environments
Experience maintaining PWA's and SPA applications
Experience working with AWS or other cloud platforms
Familiarity with containerization tools such as Docker and orchestration platforms such as Kubernetes/Helm
Knowledge of secure coding practices (OWASP, Brakeman) and handling sensitive healthcare data (HIPAA awareness)
Prior experience working on healthcare platforms or workflow automation systems

Ally Financial only succeeds when its people do - and that’s more than some cliché people put on job postings. We love this stuff! Work Schedule:

All work requirements are subject to change at any time based on leader discretion and/or business need.

The Opportunity

As a Senior Software Engineer at Ally, you will design, build, test, and support software that powers critical customer and business experiences. You will own meaningful technical solutions from design through production, work independently within squad priorities, and mentor less-experienced engineers.

This is a hands-on role for an engineer who balances near-term delivery with quality, security, reliability, and long-term technical health. We value the ability to solve problems, learn new technologies, and use AI development tools effectively.

At Ally, you will solve meaningful engineering problems at enterprise scale while staying close to the code. You will work across modern and established platforms, use advanced AI-assisted development tools, and help shape how our technology evolves.

Professional experience building and supporting production software in a complex environment.

How We'll Have Your Back

Ally's compensation program offers market-competitive base pay and pay-for-performance incentives (bonuses) based on achieving personal and company goals. Our Total Rewards program includes industry-leading compensation and benefits plus additional incentives that are designed to meet your needs and those of your family so you can get the most out of your career and your life, including:

Time Away:
Program starts at 20 paid time off days in addition to 11 paid holidays and 8 hours of volunteer time off yearly (time off days are prorated based on start date and program varies based on full or part-time status and management level).

plan for the near and long term with an industry-leading 401K retirement savings plan with matching and company contributions, student loan pay downs and 529 educational save up assistance programs, tuition reimbursement, employee stock purchase plan, and financial learning center and financial coach access.

Supporting your Health & Well-being:
flexible health and insurance options including medical, dental and vision, employee, spouse and child life insurance, short- and long-term disability, pre-tax Health Savings Account with employer contributions, Healthcare FSA, critical illness, accident & hospital indemnity insurance, and a total well-being program that helps you and your family stay on track physically, socially, emotionally, and financially.

adoption, surrogacy and fertility assistance as well as paid parental and caregiver leave, Dependent Day Care FSA back-up child and adult/elder care days and childcare discounts.

Work-Life Integration:
other benefits including Mentally Fit Employee Assistance Program, subsidized and discounted Weight Watchers® program and other employee discount programs.

Other Compensations:
depending on the role for which you are considered, you may be eligible for travel allowances, relocation assistance, a signing bonus and/or equity.

jobs.title: Computer Vision Software Engineer
jobs.description:
About Fab2

The fab2 team can build anything. We design all the hardware and software needed to make chips and we make the fabs, tools, and components ourselves.

We're looking for exceptional, hands-on people who can iterate to the limits of what's possible.

fab2 was founded by Sam Zeloof and Jim Keller. Sam is best known for making chips in his garage, and Jim has been a leader in the semiconductor industry for the past 40 years.

About The Team

The tool software group builds Linux control software and microcontroller firmware for fab2’s in-house semiconductor manufacturing equipment. This includes software for sensing, real-time microcontroller firmware, closed loop controls, sequencing, recipe execution, interlocks, operator user interfaces, and diagnostics.

About The Role

You will build computer vision software for lithography and metrology on semiconductor manufacturing equipment. This includes modeling optical systems and developing nanometer-scale alignment (fiducials, calibration methods) through iteration on real hardware. You will also develop vision systems for wafer-handling and process automation equipment. Additionally, you will work on post-lithography metrology, including defect detection and optical proximity correction (OPC) modeling.

You will work closely with full-stack, mechanical, electrical, optical, and process engineers on cross-functional problems.

We are open to a range of experience levels, from early-career to experienced engineers. The most important attribute is a strong mathematical and programming background and the ability to experiment and learn new things.

Responsibilities

Develop classical computer vision algorithms for inspection, measurement/metrology, alignment, positioning, defect detection, and camera calibration.
Build systems that extract reliable measurements and process information from images, including dimensions, feature boundaries, and manufacturing variation.
Develop image registration, camera calibration, and pose estimation capabilities for precision equipment and optical systems.
Apply spatial-domain and frequency-domain image processing techniques to solve scientific and industrial vision problems.
Integrate computer vision systems with cameras, motion systems, robotics, and other electromechanical equipment.
Turn experimental approaches into reliable production software, including testing, validation, performance optimization, and failure handling.
Partner with software, mechanical, electrical, optical, and process engineers to develop new manufacturing and metrology tools.

Required Experience

Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, Optical Engineering, Applied Physics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Strong foundation in classical computer vision and image processing.
Experience with techniques such as image registration, feature detection, camera calibration, geometric transformations, pose estimation, or image filtering.
Experience analyzing images in both the spatial and frequency domains.
Understanding of how optics, illumination, sensors, noise, and resolution affect image quality and computer vision performance.
Experience developing computer vision software using Python, C++, OpenCV, or similar tools.
Ability to design experiments, compare technical approaches, and characterize algorithm accuracy and repeatability.
Ability to take computer vision work beyond a prototype and deploy it as maintainable, reliable software.

Nice-to-have

Experience with semiconductor equipment, metrology, manufacturing inspection, microscopy, scientific instrumentation, or industrial automation.
Experience characterizing optical systems using metrics such as resolution, MTF, PSF, etc.
An understanding of optical inaccuracies: chromatic/spherical aberrations, astigmatism, etc.
Experience with precision alignment, motion systems, robotics, or sensor fusion.
Experience working with scientific or industrial cameras.
Research experience, publications, or a strong computer vision project portfolio.

Working at fab2

We’re an early-stage hardware startup with solid funding, world-class advisors, and labs/offices in Austin, TX, Lockhart, TX, and San Francisco, CA.

Job Summary

JOB DESCRIPTION

The position requires the individual to apply their technical knowledge and experience for the successful database programming and custom graphics development and subsequent installation of this programming into the Building Management System for all assigned projects. Additionally this role supports the startup, commissioning and trouble-shooting of the assigned projects. The position requires a high level of experience in computer skills and the understanding of computer-operated systems, including network types. This role will also require responsibility for documenting all fields as built conditions, as well as, the commissioning process documents. The position is required to closely interact with the Project Manager and any assigned Project Engineering staff to assist with the timely and successful completion of each project.

Essential Functions

Performs as a lead Systems Software Engineer in the development of lower and mid-level control systems databases & programs.
Supports the execution of the initial systems point-to-point commissioning activities
Performs the troubleshooting of local and wide area network issues as they arise.
Utilizes computer hardware and software to support and/or execute the pre-functional testing of the system software code in relationship to the design sequence of operations.
Participates and supports the final systems functional testing relative to standard, 3rd party, LEED and Title 24 testing as required.
Possesses the knowledge of multiple vendor software versions
Develops and utilizes the skill set to effectively work with 3rd party integrations of other vendor products, systems and protocols.
Maintains a lead role in the field coordination of installing subcontractors when a Project Engineer is not assigned to the project.
Responsible for attending required field project coordination meetings and commissioning meetings as required by the assigned projects.
Participates and leads all end user/customer system training requirements on assigned projects.
Responsible for the systematic turnover of the project from the construction phase to the Service team on all assigned projects.
Assists Design Engineers with the validation of sequence of operations development against design build and/or contract requirements.
Coordinates with project staff to ensure accurate and timely recording of project costs including time sheets, daily reports, etc.
Manages field time and budgets relative to the field work of assigned projects.
Provides the necessary leadership role for the field team when executing mid-sized projects requiring multiple team members.
Communicates effectively with other team members regarding project issues, obstacles, and information needs.
Attends and successfully completes the OSHA 10 and OSHA 30 safety training classes.
Responsible for practicing safe work habits and participates in office safety program requirements and that of any specific safety requirements of all assigned projects.
Responsible for coaching, mentoring and development of junior level Systems Software Engineers.

Education And Experience

Associates degree in a technical field or 2-5 years of related work experience in building automation systems. Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering preferred.
Strong mechanical aptitude and any technical school training.
Working knowledge of MS Office, Windows, File Structure. Basic TCP/IP network structure and web navigation are desired.
Must be highly organized and possess the ability to work in a high paced environment with the ability to prioritize tasks to meet the schedules given by Sunbelt leadership.
Has the ability to operate independently and autonomously and take ownership of all assigned tasks.
Must possess a valid California driver’s license.
Ability to execute their work to ensure high customer satisfaction and the highest quality deliverable.
Excellent oral, written and interpersonal skills are a requirement of this position.

Proactivity / Initiative: Recognizes what needs to be done and accomplishes it in a manner appropriate for one’s level/position and with minimal supervision.
Perseverance: Shows the wherewithal to fight for difficult goals despite challenges and to bounce back from adversity.
Insight: The ability to gather and make sense of information that suggests new possibilities.
Engagement: Shows a knack for using emotion and logic to communicate a persuasive vision and connect with people.
Teamwork: The ability to effectively work toward common goals with others by supporting, encouraging, and sharing information in an authentic and approachable manner.
Big Picture: Understands and contributes to organizations’ short- and long-term business strategy. On a personal level has independently developed a vision for short- and long-term career success.

Technical Curiosity / Willingness to Learn: Interest in seeking out new experiences, knowledge, and candid feed, back; demonstrating an openness to learning and change.

jobs.description:
Join Our Talented Team at Protagonist

We fuse rigorous, methodologically sound analysis with our cutting-edge technology platform, Narrative Analytics®. This powerful combination enables us to quantitatively analyze open-source media, deliver strategic recommendations, and craft executive-level communication strategies for clients with missions that matter.

Why Us?

Our team is a vibrant mix of communication specialists, data scientists, and subject matter experts with extensive experience across U.S. Government agencies, non-profit organizations, and Fortune 500 companies. By joining Protagonist, you'll immerse yourself in a collaborative environment where innovation thrives, and your contributions truly matter.

What We Do

Innovative Solutions:
We co-develop cutting-edge solutions with our clients to address tough communication problems and capitalize on opportunities to make a tangible impact.
Data-Driven Insights:
Our tools and methodologies provide actionable insights that help clients meet their communication objectives and stay ahead of global challenges.
Applied Expertise:
We integrate our solutions within client organizations, leveraging our profound expertise to address critical issues and ensure sustainable success.

Be Part of Something Bigger

At Protagonist, you'll work on compelling projects that make a real difference. We seek talented individuals eager to contribute to our mission and grow alongside us. If you're passionate about communication, data analysis, and making an impact, we invite you to explore a career with Protagonist.

Explore Your Future with Us!

Ready to take the next step in your career? Join us at Protagonist and be part of a team that's making a difference.

Job Description

We're seeking a talented Software Engineer
to join our Washington, DC-based team. In this role, you'll collaborate with data scientists, analysts, and engineers to build, optimize, and scale our Narrative Analytics® platform, which helps clients make informed, strategic decisions.

Responsibilities

Build and Scale
Contribute to the development of core features of our Narrative Analytics® platform using Python, React, and related tools
Build robust backend services and APIs, and implement frontend functionality as needed
Help design, build, and scale infrastructure components on AWS
Work with Kubernetes and containerized workloads to support microservice deployments
Integrate data processing pipelines and support analytics features such as NLP and search

Collaborate and Grow
Collaborate with senior engineers and data scientists to bring research prototypes into production
Participate in code reviews and uphold high standards of software quality
Work closely with senior team members to learn architectural design and system tradeoffs
Contribute to technical discussions and engineering planning processes
Participate in Agile development cycles, sprint planning, and standups
Seek and incorporate feedback from peers and mentors to grow your technical skill set

Requirements

Must meet applicable U.S. Government contract eligibility requirements, including any citizenship or security clearance requirements associated with assigned work
Must be eligible to obtain a US Government security clearance
BS in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field
3+ years of experience in professional software engineering roles
Strong experience with Python in production environments
Experience building modern web applications (React, TypeScript preferred)
Familiarity with cloud environments, particularly AWS
Experience with PostgreSQL or similar relational databases
Passion for writing clean, maintainable code and learning from peers

Ideal Candidates

Experience with Elasticsearch or similar analytics/search engines
Exposure to machine learning and NLP concepts or pipelines
Familiarity with Agile/Scrum development processes
Interest in working with large-scale data and distributed systems

Location & Work Arrangement

This position is based in our Washington, DC office with a hybrid work arrangement. We value in-person collaboration and team building, so we expect regular office presence, while offering flexibility for remote work. Our collaborative environment thrives when we can work together in person, particularly for technical discussions, and architectural planning.

Join Us

If you're passionate about technology and making an impact, apply today! Protagonist is dedicated to fostering a welcoming and innovative environment where everyone's voice can make a difference.

Protagonist is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Salary Range: $85,000 - $111,000 based on education and level of relevant experience.

All work requirements are subject to change at any time based on leader discretion and/or business need.

The Opportunity

At Ally, you get a startup feel, with the benefits of a company that has worked out the kinks and is fulfilling its purpose. We are always evolving, and we see that as a good thing. From owning our work to seeing its impact in the real world, our team is relentless in finding new ways technology can help make experiences better and help people. We are problem solvers, we value diverse thinking, we support one another, and we challenge ourselves to think bigger in the journey to deliver customer-obsessed tech solutions. To read more about what our tech team does, be sure to visit our tech blog at ally.tech

We are seeking a hands-on Senior Software Engineer to design, develop, test, deploy, and support dealer-facing applications that power critical business interactions and digital experiences. This role will contribute to secure, scalable, and high-performing platforms across front-end, back-end, APIs, and cloud infrastructure, with a strong focus on usability, reliability, integration, maintainability, and production excellence.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will partner with product, architecture, business, and engineering teams to translate requirements into high-quality technical solutions, participate in release and production support activities, and help continuously improve dealer experience and platform stability. You will also contribute to engineering standards, perform code reviews, and support a culture of collaboration, quality, and continuous improvement.

At this time, Ally will not sponsor a new applicant for employment authorization for this position.

The Work Itself

The Work Itself

Full-Stack Engineering. Design, develop, test, and support full-stack capabilities across front-end, back-end, APIs, data, and cloud infrastructure for dealer-facing applications, with a focus on usability, performance, resiliency, security, and maintainability.
Backend Engineering. Build secure, performant REST APIs and microservices using Node.js, NestJS, and TypeScript; apply sound API design, asynchronous processing, error handling, enterprise integration patterns, and relational database practices using platforms such as Postgres or Oracle.
AWS Backend Stack. Develop and support cloud-native solutions using AWS Lambda, API Gateway, Step Functions, S3, and CloudFront; use Terraform, IAM, Secrets Manager, Parameter Store, and CloudWatch to support secure configuration, repeatable provisioning, monitoring, alerting, and production observability.
Frontend Engineering. Build performant, responsive, and accessible dealer-facing user interfaces using React.js, Next.js, TypeScript, and modern CSS practices; integrate APIs and apply usability-focused implementation, DevOps practices, and AWS deployment patterns.
Frontend Architecture. Contribute to micro frontend architecture, module federation, reusable component design, and client/server state management using tools such as React Query, Redux, or Zustand.
Architecture, Delivery & Operations
Collaborate with architects, product partners, and cross-functional teams to define technical approaches, integration patterns, and scalable solution components that improve dealer workflows and experience.
Translate business and dealer workflow requirements into technical designs, implementation tasks, and high-quality application changes.
Support release management activities for dealer-facing applications, including deployment readiness, dependency coordination, production validation, rollback planning, and post-release support.
Identify technical risks related to scalability, security, production stability, and dealer impact, and recommend practical mitigation options.
Participate in sprint planning, technical estimation, dependency management, support prioritization, and delivery commitments with clear ownership of assigned engineering work.
Partner with product, architecture, and development team members to clarify scope, resolve dependencies, and deliver reliable solutions.
Work directly with product owners to ensure stories contain appropriate technical direction, acceptance criteria, and implementation detail.
Coordinate with Engineering and Operations teams to support environment readiness, deployment activities, and production stability.
Drive continuous improvement through code reviews, documentation, troubleshooting, knowledge sharing, and collaboration with peers.
Create and maintain high-quality deliverables that meet performance, security, testability, and maintainability expectations.
Communicate effectively with product partners, architecture, engineering peers, support teams, and leadership as needed.
Provide technical guidance to peers and help promote consistent engineering practices across the team.

Minimum Qualifications

The Qualifications You Bring

3+ years of relevant experience or equivalent combination of education and experience
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Qualifications

3+ years of hands-on cloud engineering experience building and operating scalable applications on AWS, with strong knowledge of serverless and distributed system patterns
Strong CI/CD and DevOps experience, including build automation, release pipelines, infrastructure as code, environment promotion, and production deployment support
Perform detailed code reviews and apply feedback to improve engineering quality across performance, security, testability, maintainability, and adherence to design standards.
Contribute to coding standards, secure development practices, testing discipline, and engineering best practices that improve reliability, supportability, and long-term maintainability of dealer-facing platforms.
Candidate must have hands-on experience with AI tooling for software engineering productivity, code generation, analysis, or automation use cases

Highly Preferred Qualifications

3+ years of software development experience delivering scalable enterprise applications.
Experience serving as a senior engineer or technical contributor with ownership of complex features, technical design, delivery quality, and production support.
Proven ability to contribute to end-to-end engineering for dealer-facing applications with strong focus on usability, reliability, performance, and business impact.
Mentor junior developers through technical guidance, code reviews, troubleshooting support, and hands-on collaboration.

How We'll Have Your Back

Ally's compensation program offers market-competitive base pay and pay-for-performance incentives (bonuses) based on achieving personal and company goals. Our Total Rewards program includes industry-leading compensation and benefits plus additional incentives that are designed to meet your needs and those of your family so you can get the most out of your career and your life, including:

Time Away:
Program starts at 20 paid time off days in addition to 11 paid holidays and 8 hours of volunteer time off yearly (time off days are prorated based on start date and program varies based on full or part-time status and management level).

Planning for the Future:
plan for the near and long term with an industry-leading 401K retirement savings plan with matching and company contributions, student loan pay downs and 529 educational save up assistance programs, tuition reimbursement, employee stock purchase plan, and financial learning center and financial coach access.

Supporting your Health & Well-being:
flexible health and insurance options including medical, dental and vision, employee, spouse and child life insurance, short- and long-term disability, pre-tax Health Savings Account with employer contributions, Healthcare FSA, critical illness, accident & hospital indemnity insurance, and a total well-being program that helps you and your family stay on track physically, socially, emotionally, and financially.

Building a Family:
adoption, surrogacy and fertility assistance as well as paid parental and caregiver leave, Dependent Day Care FSA back-up child and adult/elder care days and childcare discounts.

Work-Life Integration:
other benefits including Mentally Fit Employee Assistance Program, subsidized and discounted Weight Watchers® program and other employee discount programs.

Other Compensations:
depending on the role for which you are considered, you may be eligible for travel allowances, relocation assistance, a signing bonus and/or equity.

NRC Health h elp s healthcare organizations deeply understand the people they serve and turning that “Human Understanding” into meaningful action. At its core, our work is about helping organizations build trust, improve engagement, and advance better outcomes.

My Time Off (MTO), our flexible paid time off program
Up to 12 weeks of paid parental and emergency leave
Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage
Wellness program and financial coaching
Professional growth and career development opportunities

Who we want

Do you have experience building modern cloud-native engineering platforms that enable healthcare organizations to deliver exceptional patient and employee experiences?
Do you have experience developing customer-facing software while continuously improving the platform that powers it, including experience with Kubernetes, AWS, Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD automation, and AI-assisted software development?

Write clean, maintainable, well-tested, and well-documented code.

Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, MIS, IT, Engineering, or a related field with outstanding academics, or equivalent experience and the demonstrated ability to learn
3+ years’ experience working on a professional development team
Strong software engineering experience developing production applications.
Experience administering Kubernetes clusters (Amazon EKS preferred).
Experience working with AWS cloud service such as EKS, RDS, IAM, S3, Route 53, ALB, and CloudWatch.
Experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines.
Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, or similar).
Experience automating infrastructure, deployments, or operational workflows.
Understanding of cloud architecture, scalability, distributed systems, and modern application design.
Experience troubleshooting production systems in cloud environments.
Familiarity with observability, monitoring, and logging platforms.
Demonstrated proficiency using AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, ChatGPT, or similar to improve software development effectiveness.
For candidates newer to AI-assisted development, a strong willingness and proven ability to rapidly learn and adopt modern AI-powered engineering workflows.
Strong problem-solving skills with an ownership mindset.
Excellent collaboration and communication skills.
Experience with test-driven development (NUnit or similar).
Familiarity with client-side JavaScript/Typescript web frameworks, such as ReactJS or EmberJS.
Strong SQL development experience
Experience working effectively with non-technical business partners to inform product and business decisions
Willingness to act as a mentor to other team members.

Nice to have

Experience with GitOps tools such as Argo CD or Flux.
Experience with Docker and container security.
Experience implementing observability using Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, or similar platforms.
Experience with Linux system administration.
Experience supporting highly available production systems.
Experience in healthcare or other regulated industries.

Compensation

In the spirit of pay transparency, we are excited to share the base salary range for this position is $ 115,200 - $ 167,040 , exclusive of fringe benefits or potential bonuses. If you are hired at NRC Health, your final base salary compensation will be determined based on factors such as skills, education, and/or experience. For more information on specific benefits, please refer to our Careers Page .

We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

Job Description

NBCUniversal Advertising Products & Solutions (AP&S) is responsible for the product development and project management of NBCUniversal’s full advertising technology suite. From sales support to campaign execution, delivery, and billing, our division services both internal and external customers in support of NBCUniversal’s $7B+ annual advertising business. Together, we’re building the platform that powers the future of advertising at NBCU.

Our Data Collaboration Group, a core part of AP&S, powers the full advertiser lifecycle across insights, measurement, onboarding, activation, and optimization, utilizing various integration pathways including Data Clean Rooms and secure data shares.

Within the Data Collaboration Group, our Engineering & Operations team builds the automation and platform capabilities behind these workflows. We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer, Automation Engineering to join the Engineering & Operations team. Reporting to the Director of Automation Engineering, this role will build AI-enabled automation systems and production-grade software that support NBCUniversal’s data collaboration ecosystem. 

The ideal candidate is a strong Python engineer who can design reliable systems, productize repeatable workflows, and build AI agents that help automate complex engineering and operational tasks across data platforms for audience activation, measurement, and reporting. 

Responsibilities:

AI Agent & Automation Engineering 

Design and build internal AI agents and automation workflows using technologies such as, Snowflake Cortex, LangChain, LangGraph, or similar frameworks, to support planning, tool use, retrieval, validation, and human-in-the-loop execution where appropriate. 

Develop reusable tools, APIs, and components that engineers can compose into new agentic workflows. 

Implement retrieval-augmented generation workflows, context management strategies, and prompt patterns that improve accuracy, reliability, latency, and cost efficiency. 

Agent Evaluation & Reliability 

Build evaluation harnesses, regression tests, and monitoring patterns for AI-agent behavior. 

Define and track metrics such as task completion, groundedness, response accuracy, latency, cost, and failure rate. 

Design guardrails and validation patterns to reduce hallucinations, unsafe outputs, and unreliable automation behavior. 

Partner with engineering and operations teams to move AI workflows from prototype to production-ready systems. 

Software Engineering & Platform Development 

Design, build, and maintain production-grade Python applications, libraries, and services. 

Champion object-oriented design principles, including encapsulation, abstraction, inheritance/composition, reusable interfaces, and clean separation of concerns to improve maintainability and extensibility. 

Champion software engineering best practices including modular design, automated testing, CI/CD, code reviews, observability, and documentation. 

Create reusable engineering patterns that reduce bespoke development effort and improve consistency across partner engagements. 

Collaborate with product, engineering, operations, and data platform teams to translate repeatable business needs into scalable technical solutions. 

Audience & Measurement Productization 

Build reusable Python libraries that support clean room capabilities across first-party audience workflows and core measurement use cases, including audience onboarding, ingestion, indexing, activation, campaign and impression delivery analysis, reach and frequency, attribution, and incrementality. 

Abstract complex analytical and data collaboration workflows into repeatable, self-service components for internal teams and external partners. 

Enable configurable feature deployment so new audience and measurement capabilities can be delivered quickly and consistently across partners. 

Technical Mentorship 

Mentor engineers through code reviews, technical design discussions, and operational best practices. 

Help establish engineering standards for AI-assisted workflows, agentic system design, reusable libraries, and production automation. 

Promote a culture of reliability, maintainability, and continuous improvement.

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related technical field 

Software Engineering

5+ years of experience building production-grade software using Python, including libraries, services, testing, CI/CD, and code reviews

Hands-on experience building applications using LLMs, RAG, vector databases, prompt engineering, or frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or similar tools 

Agentic Systems / Automation 

Experience designing AI-enabled workflows, reasoning agents, tool-using agents, or complex automation systems

3+ years of hands-on experience with cloud data platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, or similar technologies

Strong understanding of production system design, including observability, reliability, scalability, performance tuning, and operational support

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Storage Systems (Agent Infra)
jobs.description:
About Baseten

Baseten powers mission-critical inference for the world's most dynamic AI companies, like Cursor, Notion, OpenEvidence, Abridge, Clay, Gamma, and Writer. By uniting applied AI research, flexible infrastructure, and seamless developer tooling, we enable companies operating at the frontier of AI to bring cutting-edge models into production. We're growing quickly and recently raised our $1.5B Series F, led by Altimeter Capital, Conviction Partners, and Spark Capital. Join us and help build the platform engineers turn to ship AI products.

THE ROLE

Storage decides how fast agent sandboxes start and how safely they share data. Agents need a filesystem that thousands of sandboxes mount at the same time, with strict isolation and the consistency agents need. Agent context is mostly small files, so the access patterns look very different from storage built for large files.

The Agent Infra team builds Agent Drive, the distributed filesystem that agent sandboxes mount over FUSE, and the storage underneath it. The work uses tiered caching, replication, content-addressed data, and Linux filesystem internals. In September 2026, Baseten acquired Blaxel, whose sandboxes and Agent Drive filesystem are the foundation for Baseten Sandboxes.

We are building a cloud, not just using one, so storage is designed for many tenants from day one. The team is small and ownership is big: we ship in weeks and months, not multi-year programs.

If you care about page cache coherency, FUSE, replication protocols, and content-addressable storage, we'd love to talk.

EXAMPLE INITIATIVES

Blaxel is joining Baseten to build the future of agentic infrastructure
Baseten Sandboxes documentation

Responsibilities

Design and implement core Agent Drive features: metadata replication, volume placement, garbage collection, and FUSE client behavior
Solve multi-attach correctness: cache coherency across many FUSE mounts of the same drive, dentry and inode invalidation, write ordering, and crash consistency
Optimize tail latency on read and write paths, including page cache strategy, writeback, prefetch, and metadata RPC batching
Build tenant isolation into the storage layer, including quota enforcement, blast-radius containment, and noisy-neighbor mitigation
Own the storage side of sandbox startup and resume performance
Build durable block storage for sandboxes alongside other Baseten storage teams
Build observability into every layer, drive storage incidents end to end, and turn each one into a permanent fix
Contribute upstream to the open-source storage projects we build on

Requirements

Strong systems programming background in Go, Rust, and/or C/C++, with comfort reading kernel code
Deep understanding of Linux filesystem and storage internals: VFS, page cache, dentry and inode caches, FUSE, the block I/O stack, fsync semantics, and crash consistency
Hands-on experience building distributed storage systems, content-addressable storage, or large-scale caching infrastructure
Experience profiling I/O, memory, and RPC bottlenecks and optimizing tail latency in production
Ability to debug correctness bugs that only show up under concurrency or partial failure
You move fast and like owning a problem end to end on a small team

NICE TO HAVE

Experience with a distributed filesystem or object store such as JuiceFS, CephFS, or S3-compatible storage, or contributions to those projects
Knowledge of consensus and replication protocols (Raft, leader leases, quorum reads)
Experience with snapshot, clone, and copy-on-write filesystem features
Experience operating multi-tenant storage with hard isolation requirements
Familiarity with Linux performance tooling such as eBPF, io_uring, perf, ftrace, and blktrace

Benefits

Competitive compensation, including meaningful equity
(U.S. only) 100% coverage of medical, dental, and vision insurance for employee and dependents
Flexible PTO policy including company wide Winter Break (our offices are closed from Christmas Eve to New Year's Day!)
Paid parental leave
Fertility and family-building stipend through Carrot
(U.S. only) Company-facilitated 401(k)
Exposure to a variety of ML startups, offering unparalleled learning and networking opportunities.

Apply now

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Storage Systems (Agent Infra)
jobs.description:
About Baseten

Baseten powers mission-critical inference for the world's most dynamic AI companies, like Cursor, Notion, OpenEvidence, Abridge, Clay, Gamma, and Writer. By uniting applied AI research, flexible infrastructure, and seamless developer tooling, we enable companies operating at the frontier of AI to bring cutting-edge models into production. We're growing quickly and recently raised our $1.5B Series F, led by Altimeter Capital, Conviction Partners, and Spark Capital. Join us and help build the platform engineers turn to ship AI products.

THE ROLE

Storage decides how fast agent sandboxes start and how safely they share data. Agents need a filesystem that thousands of sandboxes mount at the same time, with strict isolation and the consistency agents need. Agent context is mostly small files, so the access patterns look very different from storage built for large files.

The Agent Infra team builds Agent Drive, the distributed filesystem that agent sandboxes mount over FUSE, and the storage underneath it. The work uses tiered caching, replication, content-addressed data, and Linux filesystem internals. In September 2026, Baseten acquired Blaxel, whose sandboxes and Agent Drive filesystem are the foundation for Baseten Sandboxes.

We are building a cloud, not just using one, so storage is designed for many tenants from day one. The team is small and ownership is big: we ship in weeks and months, not multi-year programs.

If you care about page cache coherency, FUSE, replication protocols, and content-addressable storage, we'd love to talk.

EXAMPLE INITIATIVES

Blaxel is joining Baseten to build the future of agentic infrastructure
Baseten Sandboxes documentation

Responsibilities

Design and implement core Agent Drive features: metadata replication, volume placement, garbage collection, and FUSE client behavior
Solve multi-attach correctness: cache coherency across many FUSE mounts of the same drive, dentry and inode invalidation, write ordering, and crash consistency
Optimize tail latency on read and write paths, including page cache strategy, writeback, prefetch, and metadata RPC batching
Build tenant isolation into the storage layer, including quota enforcement, blast-radius containment, and noisy-neighbor mitigation
Own the storage side of sandbox startup and resume performance
Build durable block storage for sandboxes alongside other Baseten storage teams
Build observability into every layer, drive storage incidents end to end, and turn each one into a permanent fix
Contribute upstream to the open-source storage projects we build on

Requirements

Strong systems programming background in Go, Rust, and/or C/C++, with comfort reading kernel code
Deep understanding of Linux filesystem and storage internals: VFS, page cache, dentry and inode caches, FUSE, the block I/O stack, fsync semantics, and crash consistency
Hands-on experience building distributed storage systems, content-addressable storage, or large-scale caching infrastructure
Experience profiling I/O, memory, and RPC bottlenecks and optimizing tail latency in production
Ability to debug correctness bugs that only show up under concurrency or partial failure
You move fast and like owning a problem end to end on a small team

NICE TO HAVE

Experience with a distributed filesystem or object store such as JuiceFS, CephFS, or S3-compatible storage, or contributions to those projects
Knowledge of consensus and replication protocols (Raft, leader leases, quorum reads)
Experience with snapshot, clone, and copy-on-write filesystem features
Experience operating multi-tenant storage with hard isolation requirements
Familiarity with Linux performance tooling such as eBPF, io_uring, perf, ftrace, and blktrace

Flexible PTO policy including company wide Winter Break (our offices are closed from Christmas Eve to New Year's Day!)

Own Every Moment at NetApp

At NetApp, your ideas power innovation. We lead in intelligent data infrastructure—delivering unified storage, integrated data services, and solutions that help organizations unlock the full potential of their data, from AI to multicloud.

Ready to innovate and contribute to our path to $10B? Here, you'll collaborate with passionate teams, tackle real-world challenges, and see your impact in how customers transform and grow. If you're ready to bring curiosity, creativity, and drive to every moment, NetApp is where your journey begins. Join teams that innovate to elevate, drive results, and excel together across every function.

Job Summary

We are hiring experienced Systems Software Engineers across multiple NetApp engineering organizations. This pipeline posting is designed to attract strong C/C++ systems-level engineers who can contribute to core storage and data management technologies across ONTAP and other NetApp products. Candidates will be considered for roles on several teams, including ONTAP, WAFL, Replication/HA, Protocols (NFS/SMB/SAN/NVMe), Distributed Systems, Cloud Platforms, and Performance Engineering.

Engineers in these roles design, build, and optimize foundational components of NetApp’s storage stack. You will work on real-world problems involving filesystems, storage internals, distributed systems, performance, scalability, reliability, and data integrity. Work may include developing new features, enhancing subsystems, analyzing complex code paths, improving throughput and latency, debugging customer issues, or driving proofs of concept. You will collaborate with senior engineers, product teams, hardware teams, and cloud engineering groups to deliver high-quality software used globally by enterprise customers.

This posting can support multiple levels (3, 4, and 5). Team and level placement will be determined during the interview process based on experience, technical depth, and demonstrated capabilities.

Job Requirements

Core Responsibilities (All Levels)

Design, implement, and enhance features within ONTAP and related NetApp storage systems
Write high-quality C/C++ code that is efficient, reliable, and maintainable
Analyze and improve existing code paths for performance, scalability, and correctness
Debug complex issues using system-level tools, logs, tracing, and profiling
Collaborate across engineering teams, including filesystem, protocol, cloud, hardware, and QA
Participate in design and code reviews, contributing to engineering best practices
Investigate performance bottlenecks and implement optimizations
Support prototyping, research, and feasibility analysis for new ideas and features
Communicate design decisions, technical findings, and progress clearly with peers
Use AI-assisted tools to accelerate design, development, testing, and troubleshooting

Drives cross-team delivery with minimal supervision
Mentors junior and mid-level engineers
Leads deep-dive debugging and performance analysis

Leads major technical initiatives across teams or product line
Defines long-term architectural direction and technical strategy
Resolves highly complex system-wide issues in performance, data integrity, HA, scale, or protocols
Mentors senior engineers and influences engineering culture
Demonstrates deep domain expertise in filesystems, operating systems, HA/replication, or distributed systems

Qualifications

Strong proficiency in C/C++ for systems-level development
Understanding of data structures, algorithms, memory management, and concurrency
Experience with Unix/Linux systems programming
Experience with one or more: filesystems, storage systems, networking/protocol stacks, distributed systems, high-availability architectures
Strong debugging and performance analysis skills (gdb, perf, tracing, profiling tools)
Ability to write maintainable, well-documented code
Effective communication and collaboration skills

Experience with NFS, SMB, SAN (iSCSI/FC), NVMe/TCP, NVMe-oF
Experience with replication, clustering, HA, or consistency protocols

Experience with distributed systems design and large-scale performance tuning

jobs.description:
Caltech is a world-renowned science and engineering institute that marshals some of the world's brightest minds and most innovative tools to address fundamental scientific questions. We thrive on finding and cultivating talented people who are passionate about what they do. Join us and be a part of the diverse Caltech community.

Job Summary

IPAC at Caltech has an opening for an Associate Applications Developer to participate in the development of the data processing pipelines for the UVEX mission.

IPAC, part of the Physics, Math, and Astronomy Division at Caltech (www.caltech.edu), provides science operations, user support, data and archive services, and scientific vision to maximize discovery with observatories both in space and on the ground.

The Ultraviolet Explorer (UVEX) is targeted to launch in 2030 as NASA’s next Astrophysics Medium-Class Explorer mission. UVEX will undertake a synoptic survey of the entire sky in the near-UV and far-UV, probing the dynamic universe with a sensitivity more than 50 times better than GALEX. UVEX will also have a powerful broadband spectroscopic capability. UVEX will address fundamental questions from the Astro2020 Decadal Survey and study the evolution of low-metallicity, low-mass galaxies. UVEX time-domain surveys will probe the aftermaths of gravitational-wave-discovered compact object mergers, discover fast UV transients, and diagnose the early stages of explosive phenomena.

Essential Job Duties

As an Application Developer, you will work with the UVEX team to develop and test algorithms and write original production-quality code for pipeline processing and validation. You will also document your designs and software, and participate in meetings with the UVEX project.

Bachelor’s or equivalent degree in a technical subject such as Astronomy, Physics, Math, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Sciences, or a related field.

Familiarity with software configuration management principles and tools, source code version control (e.g., git/GitHub) and issue/bug tracking systems (e.g., Jira).

Preferred Qualifications
