The following might give you a head start here, but even if these do not describe you or your experience, we would still like to hear from you:

Advanced degree in Astronomy, Physics, Math, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Sciences, or a related field.
Experience working with scientific datasets and use cases.
Experience developing software for astronomical data analysis.
Experience with the Rubin/LSST Science Pipelines software stack.

Since UVEX is a distributed collaboration, it’s important that you have good written and verbal communication skills, and are comfortable working in a distributed development environment.

Resume

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Networking (Agent Infra)
jobs.description:
About Baseten

Baseten powers mission-critical inference for the world's most dynamic AI companies, like Cursor, Notion, OpenEvidence, Abridge, Clay, Gamma, and Writer. By uniting applied AI research, flexible infrastructure, and seamless developer tooling, we enable companies operating at the frontier of AI to bring cutting-edge models into production. We're growing quickly and recently raised our $1.5B Series F, led by Altimeter Capital, Conviction Partners, and Spark Capital. Join us and help build the platform engineers turn to ship AI products.

THE ROLE

Every agent on Baseten Sandboxes runs in its own microVM. Agents call models, reach tools and APIs, expose services, and more and more often talk to each other. Networking built into today's cloud providers was not designed for very large numbers of isolated machines that suspend, resume, and exchange data constantly.

The Agent Infra team builds its own networking stack for sandboxes, designed from the start for that scale. It runs in user space, with VPP (FD.io) as its main data plane technology, and is built from virtualized network functions (VNF/NFV): carrier-grade, low-latency packet processing designed for very large numbers of agents. In September 2026, Baseten acquired Blaxel, whose sandboxes, storage, and networking are the foundation for Baseten Sandboxes.

You'll build multi-tenant virtual private networking that connects each customer's agents and services privately and securely, using modern overlay technologies.

We are building a cloud, not just using one. We want engineers who expose the network as a programmable API and write the code, not operators who push router and switch configuration. The team is small and ownership is big: we ship in weeks and months, not multi-year programs.

This role is separate from Baseten's GPU-to-GPU networking. Here you'll own how sandboxes connect to each other, to Baseten services, to customer networks, and to the internet.

If you've built user-space data planes, virtualized network functions, or multi-tenant cloud networking and want to design one for agents, we'd love to talk.

EXAMPLE INITIATIVES

Blaxel is joining Baseten to build the future of agentic infrastructure
Securing the open frontier with NVIDIA OpenShell and Blaxel sandboxes
Baseten Sandboxes documentation

Responsibilities

Design and build the user-space, VPP-based data plane that connects microVM sandboxes to each other, to Baseten services, and to the internet
Build multi-tenant virtual private networking and overlays (for example EVPN, GENEVE, VXLAN) across regions
Expose the network as a programmable API that the rest of the platform calls
Cut latency and raise connection scale for agent-to-agent and agent-to-service traffic
Build routing that sends each request to the nearest region and keeps connections working as sandboxes suspend and resume
Build secure ingress and egress for sandboxes, including firewalling, static egress IPs, and custom domains with managed TLS
Build L7 proxies for request inspection, filtering, secret injection, and auditing
Own per-sandbox addressing, including IPv6, and network isolation between tenants
Build observability for the packet path across guest, host, and network, and debug production issues end to end
Work closely with the compute, storage, GPU infrastructure, and datacenter teams

Requirements

Experience with user-space packet processing (DPDK, VPP, or similar) or virtualized network functions (VNF/NFV)
Experience building multi-tenant networking in production (VXLAN, GENEVE, VRF)

jobs.description:
Description

Invent the future with us.

Ampere is a semiconductor design company for a new era, leading the future of computing with an innovative approach to CPU design focused on high-performance, energy efficient AI compute.

As a pioneer in the new frontier of energy efficient high-performance computing, Ampere is part of the Softbank Group of companies driving sustainable computing for AI, Cloud, and edge applications.

Join us at Ampere and work alongside a passionate and growing team-we’dlove to have you apply! 

About the Role:

Ampere is seeking a Senior Software Engineer to design, develop, and support low-level platform firmware for Armv9-based systems. In this role, you will focus on Trusted Firmware-A (TF-A) and related platform software, working at the intersection of hardware and software to enable secure, reliable, high-performance compute platforms.

You will collaborate closely with hardware design, validation, and software engineering teams throughout the product lifecycle—from pre-silicon development on models, emulation, and FPGA platforms through post-silicon bring-up, validation, release, and customer support. This is an opportunity to solve complex system-level problems, influence firmware architecture, and contribute to technology used by internal teams, customers, and the broader open-source community.

What You’ll Achieve:

Design, develop, integrate, and maintain Trusted Firmware-A (TF-A) for Armv9-based platforms.
Define and maintain firmware specifications, architecture and design documentation, and technical collateral.
Enable and validate pre-silicon software support across hardware models, emulation environments, and FPGA platforms.
Lead post-silicon platform bring-up; diagnose complex issues and drive them through root cause, resolution, and validation.
Debug challenging problems spanning firmware, boot flows, operating systems, and platform subsystems.
Deliver features end-to-end, from requirements and implementation through validation, release, and lifecycle support.
Partner with hardware design, validation, and software teams to ensure robust platform integration and product readiness.
Support multiple platforms and projects for internal stakeholders and external customers.
Work directly with customers to diagnose, communicate, and resolve technical issues in a timely manner.
Produce technical whitepapers and other materials that support product marketing, customer engagement, and open-source outreach.
Write high-quality, maintainable production code; participate in code reviews and help continuously improve engineering practices and development processes.

About You:

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical field—or equivalent practical experience.
5+ years of relevant experience with a bachelor’s degree, or 3+ years of relevant experience with a master’s degree.
Strong C/C++ and Arm assembly-language programming skills.
Hands-on experience with 32-bit and 64-bit Arm architectures, including Armv8; Armv9 experience is strongly preferred.
Experience developing low-level software, including firmware, TF-A/ATF, BIOS/UEFI, bootloaders, Linux, or Windows platform software.
Strong analytical, debugging, validation, and test-methodology skills.
Knowledge of microcontroller hardware interfaces and protocols, including SPI, I2C, DDR3/DDR4/DDR5, and PCIe.
Experience using source control, CI, and issue-tracking tools such as Git, Jenkins, Bugzilla, and Jira.
Experience with hardware/software debug tools such as JTAG, Lauterbach TRACE32, GDB, and/or OpenOCD.
Strong understanding of software development lifecycle processes and Agile development methodologies.
Demonstrated ability to independently own complex technical problems, work across multiple subsystems, and drive issues to resolution.
Experience delivering maintainable, production-quality software and supporting products throughout their lifecycle.
At least two years of customer-facing experience diagnosing and resolving technical issues.
Strong written, verbal, and cross-functional communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Trusted Firmware-A, secure monitor software, Arm boot flows, and Arm exception levels.
Knowledge of system power management.
Knowledge of platform security, cryptography, secure boot, trusted execution, and firmware-security best practices.
Familiarity with ISO 26262 functional-safety concepts, processes, or safety-critical software development.
Experience with AUTOSAR, including AUTOSAR Classic or Adaptive Platform architectures and integration concepts.
Experience contributing to or actively engaging with open-source software communities.

What We’ll Offer:

At Ampere we believe in taking care of our employees and providing a competitive total rewards package that includes base pay, cash long-term incentive, and comprehensive benefits. The full base pay range for this role is between $147,000 and $220,000, except in the San Francisco Bay Area where the range is between $159,000 and $239,000.

Our benefits include health, wellness, and financial programs that support employees through every stage of life.

Benefit highlights include:

Premium medical insurance, dental insurance, vision insurance, as well as income protection and a 401K retirement plan, so that you can feel secure in your health and financial future.
Unlimited Flextime and 10+ paid holidays so that you can embrace a healthy work-life balance.
A variety of healthy snacks, energizing espresso, and refreshing drinks to keep you fueled and focused throughout the day.

And there is much more than compensation and benefits. At Ampere, we foster an inclusive culture that empowers our employees to do more and grow more. We are excited to share more about our career opportunities with you through the interview process. jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer, Driving Foundation Models
jobs.description:
We are looking for the best

About Us

42dot is a mobility AI company committed to solving mobility challenges with software and AI. As the Global Software Center of Hyundai Motor Group, 42dot pioneers the future of mobility by advancing the development of software-defined vehicles.

We develop safety-first, user-centric software-defined vehicle technologies that deliver the latest performance through continuous updates like smartphones. By advancing software and AI technology, 42dot envisions a world where everything is connected and moves autonomously through a self-managing urban transportation operating system.

About The Role

Develop driving and physical AI foundation models. Support Aria VLA model development.

Responsibilities

Data Curation & Pretraining: Design and manage massive, multi-terabyte datasets, including data scraping, filtering, deduplication, tokenization, and synthetic data generation.
Distributed Model Training: Scale training across massive GPU/TPU clusters using parallel processing, custom data loaders, and framework optimization (PyTorch, JAX, or TensorFlow).
Post-Training & Alignment: Implement instruction tuning, Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF), or direct preference optimization to align models with safety and behavior goals.
Inference & Optimization: Compress and optimize models (quantization, pruning, speculative decoding) to run at low latency on cloud infrastructure or edge hardware like smartphones and robotics.
Evaluation & Guardrails: Build benchmarking harnesses, hallucination checkers, and red-teaming pipelines to test model accuracy and safety.

Qualifications

jobs.title: Hardware Test and Automation Engineer I
jobs.description:
**Advanced Reentry Technologies**

**Who We Are:**

  

Inversion is an aerospace and defense company pioneering advanced reentry technology to enable next-generation capabilities from space. By combining high-performance materials, precision aerodynamics, and mission-driven autonomy, Inversion is transforming reentry into an operational capability for an entirely new class of missions.

The company's highly maneuverable reentry spacecraft, Arc, is designed for rapid global cargo delivery, hypersonic testing, and other national security missions that require precise, controlled flight through the atmosphere. Arc creates an entirely new transportation domain, unlocking unprecedented speed and global reach.

Headquartered in Los Angeles, Inversion designs, manufactures, and integrates its spacecraft under one roof, enabling the company to move rapidly from concept to flight. The company is backed by leading investors including Y Combinator, Spark Capital, and Lockheed Martin Ventures, with customers across the U.S. government and commercial space industry.

**Position Overview:**

As a Hardware Test and Automation Engineer at Inversion, you will work as part of the simulation team to build, test, maintain, and develop the automated software and hardware systems that support the simulation and test environments for our flight systems. The simulation team is responsible for ensuring that flight software and flight hardware can be continuously integrated and tested under realistic flight conditions. You will play a key role in the automation of electrical ground support equipment (EGSE) and hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) test benches that will enable fast, repeatable development and deployment workflows across the engineering stack. Your work will empower Inversion's engineering teams to iterate rapidly throughout the development life cycle and will strengthen Inversion's ability to put our products into the hands of our customers with unprecedented speed and agility.

* Automate provisioning, deployment, execution, operation, and logging tasks to optimize resource utilization and allocation
* Develop automated test scripts to support qualification efforts for our flight software and hardware systems
* Develop device API wrappers for EGSE equipment (e.g.: to control power supplies, oscilloscopes, etc., via automated test scripts)
* Develop emulators for flight hardware to support software-in-the-loop (SIL) and hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) testing
* Integrate electronics hardware needed to enable on-demand, hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) simulation workflows (this includes building custom harnessing, performing safe to mate procedures, safely powering-up components, troubleshooting hardware interfaces, etc.)
* Contribute to the design and development of a simulation system capable of automatically provisioning and deploying resources to support simulation workflows

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, computer engineering, electrical engineering or equivalent technical experience
* Typically 1+ years of applicable hands-on experience of hardware experience
* Proficiency in one or more scripting languages (Python, Lua, Bash, PowerShell, etc.)
* Proficiency in one or more embedded languages (C/C++, Rust, etc.)
* Experience with Linux-based systems
* Experience handling and integrating unhoused/open-frame custom electronics and prototype hardware
* **Must have the ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. government Secret/Top Secret security clearance**

**Desired Qualifications:**

* Experience with data acquisition and logging
* Experience with robotics middleware and autonomy stacks (ROS 2, Webots, Orocos, YARP, etc.)
* Familiarity with modern DevOps practices
* Familiarity with time-series databases (InfluxDB, QuestDB, Prometheus, etc.)
* Familiarity with message-oriented middleware (NATS, Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ, etc.)
* Familiarity with containerization (Docker, Docker Compose, etc.)

**Our office headquarters is located in Playa Vista, CA. This position requires in office presence.**

*The California annual base salary for this role is currently $77,000 -$116,000. Pay Grades are determined by role, level, location, and alignment with market data. Individual pay will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: interviews and an assessment of several factors that are unique to each candidate, job-related skills, relevant education and experience, certifications, abilities of the candidate and internal equity.*

**ITAR Compliance:**

To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

jobs.title: Software Application Developer
jobs.description:
**Position Description**

**Degenkolb Engineers** is seeking an experienced **Application Developer** to develop and support custom applications for the firm across two areas — Applied Technology Team (ATT) engineering applications and Information Systems (IS) business applications — using Python, React, SQL databases, and Azure deployment. Working under the direction of the IT Director, the Director of Engineering Technology, and with other developers, the Application Developer builds application features, assists with deployment and maintenance, and utilizes the firm's development standards and platforms. This hybrid position can be based near any of these offices: **Detroit, Los Angeles, Oakland, Orange, Sacramento, San Diego, San Francisco, or Seattle**.

**Ideal Candidate**

The ideal candidate is a versatile application developer with at least five years of experience building and supporting custom business and engineering applications using Python, React, SQL, and Azure. They combine strong technical skills with clear communication, a methodical problem-solving approach, and a customer-service mindset, and are comfortable working across both internal business systems and engineering-focused tools. Experience with AI-assisted development, Microsoft Power Platform, and collaborative development practices such as documentation, QA/QC, and code review will help them succeed in this role.

**Who We Are**

Founded in 1940 and headquartered in San Francisco, **Degenkolb Engineers** helps make complex, high-stakes projects real. We bring deep technical expertise, disciplined creativity, and a practical understanding of construction to every challenge; building strong relationships early, making complexity easier to navigate, and keeping the success of projects central to our work.

Our teams deliver customized structural solutions across healthcare, education, science and technology, forensics, construction engineering, federal buildings, and other complex markets. Whether a project calls for navigating stringent codes, balancing budget and schedule, solving an unusual technical problem, or creating a landmark structural system, we connect the right people and ideas to develop solutions that serve our clients and communities.

**Key Result Areas**

ATT Application Development

* Develop, upgrade, and maintain custom applications, tools, and scripts for engineering practice under the direction of senior developers.

* Build front-end interfaces (React) and back-end services (Python, SQL) for internal engineering tools.

* Assist with deployment to Azure and with maintenance and troubleshooting of deployed applications.

* Follow the team's QA/QC, code-review, and version-control standards; write and maintain documentation, tutorials, and specifications.

Application Development & Support

* Support the development, configuration, and maintenance of the firm's business applications (Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Power Platform, Dynamics).

* Build workflows and automations (Power Automate) and reports and dashboards (Power BI) to improve organizational efficiency.

* Assist with API integrations between the firm's systems.

* Help resolve escalated user technical issues related to applications.

Professional Development

* Comply with life-long learning requirements; build proficiency in the firm's development stack, platforms, and standards.

* Seek to learn from senior developers and take on progressively more complex tasks over time.

Collaboration & Internal Activities

* Keep the direct manager and senior developers informed of progress, blockers, and issues.

* Collaborate with ATT and IS team members; attend relevant internal meetings.

* Assist in instructing staff on the usage of applications and tools, as directed.

*Professional development and learning are ongoing and are accommodated within the above.*

**Minimum Requirements**

* **BA/BS degree in Computer Science, Data Science or a related technical field**

* A minimum of 5 years of application-development experience

* Experience with AI-assisted development (Claude Code, Cursor or similar agentic tools)

* Familiarity with application deployment on Microsoft Azure (or an equivalent cloud platform)

* Power platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI)

* HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React

* Python proficiency for scripting and web back end

* SQL database experience

* Azure services experience

* Strong verbal and written communication skills — write task specs, flag ambiguities, and document decisions and changes

* Strong customer service mindset

* Methodical problem solver – read the codebase before touching it, ask before assuming

**Desired Qualifications**

* REST and third-party API integration experience

* Exposure to Microsoft Dynamics 365

* Experience with Azure DevOps / CI/CD pipelines

* Exposure to the AEC industry / structural engineering, BIM, earthquake, construction tech

* Experience with Java or a C-based language (C#, C++)

* Relevant certification (AWS, Microsoft Azure, ITIL or similar)

* SharePoint development

**Compensation & Benefits**

The annual salary range for this position across our offices generally falls between **$120,000 and $153,000** annually. This range is a good-faith estimate provided pursuant to applicable pay transparency laws. Actual compensation will be based on factors including work location, company geographic differentials, education, experience, and candidate qualifications.

Our benefits are designed to support your well-being, growth, and long-term connection to the firm. They include:

* Health and life insurance

* Commuter benefits

* 401(k) with company profit-sharing contribution

* Employee ownership through a privately held stock plan

* Financial support for professional activities and development

* Company holidays, a generous paid time off program, and paid parental leave

**Our Culture**

Degenkolb is a place where technical rigor and human connection strengthen

jobs.title: Software Engineer - AI Systems (Go)
jobs.description:
Stanbridge University is seeking **Software Engineers – AI Systems (Go)** to design, build, and operate production AI systems that perform complex, multi-stage work reliably and at scale.

This is a hands-on engineering role focused on a challenging class of problems: long-running AI workflows that call models, tools, and external APIs; maintain state across extended executions; produce structured content and generated media; interact with human reviewers; recover from partial failures; and consistently deliver accurate results to users.

The core engineering challenges extend well beyond prompt development. These systems must account for provider failures and rate limits, interrupted workflows, changing state, non-deterministic model behavior, incorrect or unsupported outputs, variable latency and cost, and deployments occurring while work is in progress.

The successful candidate will combine strong **software and distributed-systems engineering judgment** with practical experience building and operating **LLM-backed applications, AI agents, or agent-based systems in production**.

You will join at a stage where significant architecture remains to be designed and built. Engineers in this role will have substantial ownership over the patterns, services, infrastructure, and engineering standards that shape the University's AI systems.

**Remote Work Eligibility**  
This position is eligible for remote work for candidates residing in states where Stanbridge University is currently authorized to employ remote employees. Eligible states currently include: **Arizona, Colorado, Illinois, Indiana, Kansas, Kentucky, Louisiana, Maryland, Michigan, Minnesota, Nevada, New Jersey, North Carolina, North Dakota, Ohio, Tennessee, Texas, and Wisconsin.**

Candidates must reside in an eligible state at the time of employment. Remote-work eligibility is subject to University employment requirements and may change based on applicable state requirements.

### **Engineering Environment**

The engineering problems addressed by this team include:

* **Durable workflow orchestration:** Long-running, multi-stage pipelines using persistent state, job queues, checkpoints, resumability, idempotent execution, and recovery from interrupted or orphaned work.
* **Multi-provider model infrastructure:** Routing across commercial model providers with model registries, token and cost controls, rate-limit handling, retries, circuit breakers, health monitoring, and provider failover.
* **Agent and tool orchestration:** Systems in which AI agents interact with tools, APIs, data sources, application services, and deterministic business logic to complete multi-step work.
* **Prompt engineering infrastructure:** Treating prompts as version-controlled production artifacts with review, testing, regression protection, and measurable behavior.
* **Testing non-deterministic systems:** Recorded and replayable provider interactions, deterministic fixtures, evaluation harnesses, baselines, and regression testing for AI behavior.
* **Correctness and quality controls:** Structured-output validation, automated evaluation, domain-specific requirements, evidence checking, and safeguards against confident but incorrect model output.
* **Human-in-the-loop workflows:** Review and approval stages within automated processes, including systems capable of safely responding when users modify state or inputs during execution.
* **Generated media pipelines:** Systems capable of producing and managing documents, audio, imagery, video, and other generated assets.
* **Production service architecture:** Go-based APIs and backend services, relational data stores, job infrastructure, observability, and integrations supporting user-facing applications.
* **Secure ingestion:** Processing user-supplied and potentially untrusted documents while maintaining appropriate security and authorization boundaries.

### **Two Engineering Emphases**

Engineers will meet the same overall technical bar but may bring deeper expertise in one of two areas:

### **Platform and Pipeline**

Focused on distributed systems, workflow orchestration, durable state, job queues, recovery, provider infrastructure, latency, throughput, scalability, reliability, and cost optimization.

This emphasis is particularly well suited for experienced systems engineers who view AI models as powerful components that introduce a new set of distributed-systems and reliability challenges.

### **Agents and Quality**

Focused on agent and tool architecture, prompt systems, context management, evaluation frameworks, regression testing, judge models, evidence validation, and end-to-end output quality.

This emphasis is particularly well suited for engineers who approach AI behavior through experimentation, measurement, testing, and systematic improvement.

Candidates may indicate an area of preference; however, specialization in one area is not required.

### **Essential Functions**

* Design, develop, test, deploy, and operate **production-quality software and backend services**, primarily using **Go (Golang)**.
* Architect and build **AI agents and agent-based systems** capable of using tools, interacting with APIs, maintaining state and context, and executing complex multi-step workflows.
* Design durable workflows that can **checkpoint, resume, retry, recover, and safely continue execution following partial failures or system interruptions**.
* Determine how **models, agents, tools, APIs, data sources, services, and deterministic application logic** should divide responsibilities within an AI system, including recognizing when an AI model is not the appropriate solution.
* Design integrations across multiple AI model providers, including routing, failover, rate-limit management, health monitoring, and degradation strategies.
* Build safeguards including structured-output validation, error handling, retries, quality gates, evidence validation, and automated recovery mechanisms.

**Job Title:** Software Developer

**Location:** United States or Canada, Remote  
**Employment Type :** Full-time

**About SMRTR**

SMRTR builds software that helps businesses run more efficiently. Together with our sister companies Shea, a SYSPRO ERP partner, and DTEC, a distribution ERP provider, we are part of Solen Software Group. Our customers rely on us every day, and our Subscriptions, Renewals, Collections & Accounting team keeps that relationship healthy, making sure software subscriptions, renewals and services are billed on time and accurately, and that outstanding balances are resolved quickly and professionally.

**The Opportunity**

We are looking for a software developer with 3–5 years of experience to build product features and integrations for NG and SMRTR TRAC. Our stack is Vue, TypeScript, Node.js and PostgreSQL, with services on the JVM (Scala).

Working with our Director of Software Engineering, you will help deliver our 2027 roadmap: connecting our products to the ERP systems our customers run (starting with SYSPRO), AI-powered document capture, and new NG and TRAC features. You will join a small, experienced team where what you build reaches customers quickly.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Product development**

* Build features across the front end (Vue, TypeScript) and back end (Node.js, Scala/JVM) for NG and SMRTR TRAC.
* Design and work with PostgreSQL data models and queries (and some MongoDB), with attention to performance.
* Fix defects and improve the reliability of the products you work on.

**Integrations and APIs**

* Build and maintain REST APIs and integrations between NG / SMRTR TRAC and ERP systems such as SYSPRO, Microsoft Dynamics 365, VAI and NCR, following the team's integration patterns.
* Contribute to AI document capture (classification and data extraction) and the print-to-NG driver.

**Delivery and collaboration**

* Turn requirements from Professional Services, Sales and customers into working software, with guidance from engineering leadership.
* Estimate your own tasks and deliver to agreed dates.
* Support go-lives and help troubleshoot production issues.

**Engineering practices**

* Write tested, reviewed and secure code in our GitHub-based workflow with CI/CD.
* Write clear technical documentation and release notes.
* Use AI-assisted development tools to work faster, safely.

**What You Bring**

**Required**

* 3–5 years of professional software development experience.
* Production experience with Vue.js, TypeScript and Node.js.
* PostgreSQL: schema design, SQL and query performance.
* JVM experience, preferably Scala.
* Experience building REST APIs and integrating with third-party systems.
* Git-based workflows, code review and automated testing.
* Clear communication with colleagues and, when needed, customers.
* Authorized to work in the United States or Canada; set up for remote work.

**Nice to Have**

* MongoDB.
* Android or Xamarin.
* ERP integration experience (e.g., SYSPRO, Microsoft Dynamics 365, VAI, NCR).
* Document management, OCR or AI document capture.
* Experience with manufacturing, distribution or food & beverage software.

**How Success Is Measured**

* Features and integrations delivered on schedule
* Quality: defects and production incidents in your code
* Accuracy of estimates on your own work
* Growing ownership of product areas over the year

**Compensation and Benefits**

* Base salary of USD 65,000–85,000 (United States) or CAD 95,000–110,000 (Canada), depending on experience and location
* Benefits according to country of employment (in the US: health, dental and vision insurance and a 401(k) with company match)
* Paid time off and company holidays
* Fully remote work with a collaborative, experienced team

**Recruitment Disclaimer**

Solen Software Group will never request payment, banking information, or other sensitive personal or financial details during any stage of the recruitment process. All official communication will come from a verified @solensoftwaregroup.com email address. Any outreach outside these standards should be disregarded and reported through our official channels.

***We thank all applicants for their interest in joining Solen Software Group. Only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.***

MSK is dedicated to training the next generation of scientists and clinicians, who go on to pursue our mission at MSK and around the globe.

  

Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center seeks Software Engineer in New York, NY responsible for the full development life cycle of complex projects requiring integration to other systems, including analysis, design, programming, implementation and support. Provide technical leadership for development projects, and act as an internal consultant for other team members. Responsible for system analysis, design, programming, testing, integration, implementation, and documentation for all phases of systems development projects, supporting new applications and ensuring the successful operation of existing applications. Write code and develop specifications that result in expected levels of output, handling exceptions and errors, and is maintainable. Review specifications against user and vendor requirements and guidelines for accuracy. Plan, coordinate, and provide estimates for assigned projects. Design program and technical specifications for various applications that may include data flow, data storage, interface design, and system architecture, on assigned projects. AutoStore™ holds a simple yet powerful vision: to store and move things for everyone, everywhere. Founded in Norway, we've grown into a global technology company. AutoStore uses advanced software to automate and orchestrate order fulfillment. Our goal is to ensure orders arrive faster than ever, with minimal environmental impact. That's how we help brands exceed customer expectations.

We have more than 1600 systems in nearly 60 countries, and we grow continuously as a community of employees, partners, customers, suppliers, and connected technologies. Automation should make life easier, and by listening carefully to our community, we innovate to meet the industry's most complex needs. With AutoStore™, brands gain speed, efficiency, and improved workplaces. And much more floor space.

AutoStore – moving things forward.

The Role:

AutoStore is hiring an Entry-Level Software Engineer to join our team at the start of their career. You will help design, build, and test the software that powers our automated storage and fulfillment systems, working alongside experienced engineers on real production code.

We are looking for a recent graduate with a strong academic record and, ideally, some internship experience. You don't need to know everything on day one. What matters most is a genuine passion for software, curiosity about how things work, and an eagerness to learn quickly.

You will receive structured mentoring and hands-on training, including in C++ and Python, the core languages our team works with.

Key Tasks and Responsibilities:

Software Development

Design, write, and maintain clean, well-structured code in C++ and Python under the guidance of senior engineers.
Implement new features and fix bugs across our software products.
Apply object-oriented design principles and follow the team's coding standards.

Testing and Quality

Write unit and integration tests for the code you develop.
Debug and troubleshoot issues, and learn to find root causes.
Take part in code reviews, both receiving feedback and reviewing teammates' code as you grow.

Collaboration and Delivery

Work in an agile team, contributing to sprint planning, stand-ups, and retrospectives.
Use Git and GitHub for version control, pull requests, and code reviews.
Work with QA, DevOps, and product teammates to deliver working software.

Learning and Growth

Develop your C++ and Python skills on the job through training, mentoring, and real project work.
Write and update technical documentation as you learn our systems.

We are hiring a hands-on Reliability Engineer to improve the availability, performance, resilience, and operational stability of enterprise applications and cloud platforms.

You will work across cloud infrastructure, application monitoring, incident management, automation, and data platforms to identify reliability risks and deliver measurable improvements. Be a part of our mission! As a world leader in creating comfortable, sustainable, and efficient climate solutions for buildings, homes and transportation, it's our responsibility to put the planet first. If the answer is yes, we invite you to consider joining us in boldly challenging what's possible for a sustainable world.

Learn about our benefits designed for you to Thrive at work and at home.

We boldly go.

Where Is The Work

Monday to Thursday, work onsite with your colleagues. Fridays, choose your work location, balancing what your work requires.

Job Description

As a key member of our team, you will develop and automate analytical tools and data workflows that directly support the engineering, design, sales, and manufacturing in our chiller business across North America. You will join a team that is expanding its capabilities in Analytics, Machine Learning, and AI. In this role, you will collaborate with subject matter experts across engineering and manufacturing to build data products that enable the development of new, high-efficiency products worldwide.

Apply critical thinking to translate design, engineering, product support, and manufacturing requirements into supporting tools.

Experience with Solving Problems through automation.

jobs.description:
*No C2C*

Title:
Full Stack Engineer II
Pay:
$75-$80 per hour
Type:
Hybrid, Plano Texas
Duration:
12-month contract

Position Overview:

We are seeking a hands-on Senior Full Stack Engineer with strong experience in backend development, modern frontend technologies, cloud infrastructure, and AI-powered automation. This role will design, build, and deploy scalable applications and intelligent agentic AI solutions that automate workflows, integrate with enterprise systems, and improve operational efficiency.

The ideal candidate has experience developing production-grade applications using Python, Go, JavaScript, and React; deploying cloud-native services on AWS; and leveraging Model Context Protocol (MCP), agentic AI architectures, and AI-assisted coding tools to accelerate software development and automation.

Key Responsibilities:

Full Stack Development:
Design, develop, test, and maintain scalable applications using Python, Go, JavaScript, and React across backend services, APIs, and frontend interfaces.
Agentic AI Engineering:
Design and implement agentic AI solutions, autonomous workflows, tool integrations, and intelligent automation using LLMs and MCP-based architectures.
MCP Integration:
Build and integrate MCP servers, clients, tools, and context-aware workflows that enable AI agents to interact securely with APIs, databases, and external systems.
Cloud Infrastructure:
Develop, deploy, and operate cloud-native applications on AWS, with hands-on experience using Amazon ECS and Amazon RDS.
Containerization & Deployment:
Package and deploy applications using Docker, implement CI/CD pipelines, and improve build, testing, release, and deployment automation.
API Development & Integration:
Design, build, and maintain secure, reliable RESTful APIs and service integrations that connect frontend applications, backend services, databases, and AI agents.
AI-Assisted Software Development:
Use AI coding tools such as Claude Code and OpenAI Codex to accelerate development, generate and refactor code, troubleshoot issues, automate repetitive engineering tasks, and improve developer productivity.
Monitoring & Observability:
Implement application monitoring, logging, alerting, and performance analysis using Amazon CloudWatch and New Relic to maintain reliability and troubleshoot production issues.
Reliability & Security:
Apply engineering best practices for authentication, authorization, error handling, testing, scalability, and secure handling of application data and AI tool access.
Cross-Functional Collaboration:
Partner with engineering, product, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into practical software solutions and deliver measurable automation outcomes.

Qualifications:

Strong professional software engineering experience building and supporting production applications.
Proficiency in Python and experience with Go and JavaScript; hands-on React development experience.
Experience designing and integrating APIs, backend services, and distributed application components.
Hands-on experience deploying and operating applications on AWS, particularly ECS and RDS.
Experience with Docker, containerized application development, and CI/CD pipelines.
Practical experience designing or implementing agentic AI solutions, LLM-powered workflows, or AI-driven automation.
Understanding of MCP and how AI agents can securely access tools, APIs, and contextual data.
Experience using AI-assisted coding tools such as Claude Code, Codex, or comparable development agents.
Familiarity with production observability and troubleshooting using CloudWatch, New Relic, or similar monitoring platforms.
Strong debugging, problem-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to work independently in a fast-paced engineering environment.

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience deploying MCP-based applications and integrating AI agents with enterprise APIs, databases, and internal tools.
Familiarity with LLM orchestration, tool calling, structured outputs, agent workflows, and human-in-the-loop controls.
Experience with automated testing, infrastructure as code, and secure software delivery practices.
Understanding of AI application security, including least-privilege access, secrets management, input validation, and prompt-injection risks.
Experience optimizing application performance, cloud resource utilization, and engineering workflows through automation.

jobs.title: Sr. Software Developer III (Hybrid)
jobs.description:
Job Description

Sr. Software Developer III (Hybrid)

Primary Duties & Responsibilities

At Globe Life, we are committed to empowering our employees with the support and opportunities they need to succeed at every stage of their career. We take pride in fostering a caring and innovative culture that enables us to collectively grow and overcome challenges in a connected, collaborative, and mutually respectful environment that calls us to help Make Tomorrow Better.

Role Overview

Could you be our next Sr. Software Developer III
? Globe Life is looking for a Sr. Software Developer III
to join the team!

In this role, you will be responsible for providing technical support and guidance across system applications while driving enhancements and designing scalable solutions throughout the full application lifecycle. You will serve as a technical expert making architectural decisions, ensuring quality, and bridging technical execution with business needs for both new and existing applications. You will also manage client relationships with a high sense of urgency, providing technical guidance and hands-on support across end-user, application, and cloud environments.

This is a hybrid position located in McKinney, TX. (WFH Monday & Friday, In Office Tuesday–Thursday).

What You Will Do

Application Development

Design, build, and ship full-stack web applications from requirements through production release, owning quality, performance, and reliability throughout.
Build complex, data-driven, multi-user web applications that handle real-world load, concurrency, and security requirements.
Ensure web applications are maintainable, well-tested, well-documented, and built to last.
Take full ownership of features end-to-end: front-end UI, back-end API, data layer, and deployment.
Proactively identify and resolve performance bottlenecks, security vulnerabilities, and scalability issues.
Participate in production support, diagnosing, triaging, and resolving application issues in live environments.

Front-End

Own the front-end architecture, making deliberate, well-reasoned decisions about component structure, state management, routing strategy, data fetching patterns, and build configuration.
Build production-quality Vue 3 applications using the Composition API, script setup syntax, composables, provide/inject, teleport, and advanced slot patterns.
Design and enforce a scalable, maintainable component library with reusable, well-documented, and prop-typed components that the team can build on confidently.
Write TypeScript across the entire front-end codebase, including strict mode, well-defined interfaces, generic types, utility types, and proper type narrowing.
Architect state management with a clear separation of state, getters, and actions, applying the right approach for each situation.
Configure and optimize Vite build pipelines, including code splitting, tree shaking, lazy-loaded routes, dynamic imports, chunk strategy, and bundle size analysis.
Build responsive, mobile-first UIs using modern CSS, including Flexbox, Grid, SCSS/SASS, CSS custom properties, and BEM or equivalent methodology.
Implement and enforce WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility standards, including semantic HTML, ARIA roles and attributes, keyboard navigation, focus management, and screen reader compatibility.
Own front-end performance, optimizing Core Web Vitals (LCP, CLS, FID/INP), implementing lazy loading, virtual scrolling, debounce/throttle strategies, and memoization.
Handle complex client-side concerns including authentication flows (JWT, OAuth2, token refresh), route guards, role-based UI rendering, and secure token storage patterns.
Design robust API integration layers with interceptors, centralized error handling, retry logic, loading/error/empty states, and optimistic UI updates.
Write comprehensive front-end tests, including unit/component tests and end-to-end tests with Playwright or Cypress.
Collaborate closely with UX/UI designers to translate wireframes and mockups into pixel-perfect, accessible, performant implementations.
Ensure cross-browser and cross-device compatibility across Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge, and major mobile browsers.
Stay current with front-end tooling and web standards and bring forward-thinking recommendations to the team.

Back-End

Design and deliver full-stack features end-to-end, from front-end through .NET Core Web API.
Architect and implement RESTful APIs using ASP.NET Core Web API, including versioning, error handling, input validation, middleware pipelines, and security best practices.
Build and maintain back-end services using C# and .NET Core with clean architecture principles.
Implement authentication and authorization using JWT bearer tokens, OAuth2/OpenID Connect, and ASP.NET Core Identity.
Develop data access layers using Entity Framework Core and Dapper for performance-critical queries.
Design and optimize Microsoft SQL Server schemas, stored procedures, indexes, and T-SQL queries.
Implement background processing and messaging using Hangfire, AWS SQS, or Azure Service Bus.
Write clean, testable code and implement unit and integration tests as part of the development workflow.

DevOps & CI/CD

Own and continuously improve multi-stage CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps, including build, automated testing, code quality gates, approval gates, and environment-specific releases.
Enforce Git best practices including branching strategy (GitFlow or trunk-based), pull request standards, code review quality, and release tagging.
Automate front-end and back-end testing and deployment processes within the pipeline.
Maintain Azure DevOps Boards and contribute to sprint planning and backlog refinement.

Leadership & Collaboration

Serve as the front-end authority on the team, setting standards and guiding others through complex front-end challenges.
Lead code reviews with substantive, constructive feedback that elevates code quality and team capability.
Mentor junior and mid-level developers, especially on front-end architecture, Vue 3 patterns, TypeScript, and performance.
Drive architecture and design discussions, creating technical specifications, component diagrams, and ADRs.
Partner with QA, DBAs, Business Analysts, and Product Owners throughout the full SDLC.
Proactively identify technical debt, propose remediation plans, and lead modernization efforts.
Participate in all Agile ceremonies: sprint planning, standups, retrospectives, and backlog grooming.

What You Can Bring

Education

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent demonstrable professional experience.

Experience

10+ years of overall software development experience, including 7+ years of expert-level front-end development (Vue 3 or Angular), 5+ years of full-stack .NET Core development, 4+ years of production TypeScript and Git, and 3+ years each of hands-on AWS, Azure DevOps CI/CD, and Microsoft SQL Server experience.
Demonstrated history of building and delivering complex, production web applications, enterprise or consumer-facing with real users, real data, and real uptime requirements.
Expert-level front-end framework experience including:

Technical Skills

Mastery-level front-end engineering expertise, with a track record of owning deliverables, raising team capability, and delivering reliable production outcomes.

jobs.title: Sr. Software Engineer - Android Display & Graphics
jobs.description:
About Us

Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies is a joint venture between two industry leaders with a clear vision for automotive’s next chapter. From operating systems to zonal controllers to cloud and connectivity solutions, we’re addressing the challenges of electric vehicles through technology that will set the standards for software-defined vehicles around the world.

The road to the future is uncharted. By combining our expertise across connectivity, AI, security and more, we’ll map a new way forward. Working together, we’ll create a future that’s more connected, more intelligent, more sustainable for everyone.

Role Summary

The Infotainment Platform team at Rivian Volkswagen Technologies is looking for a skilled Platform Engineer to join our Automotive Software team. We are developing the next generation, Android-based in-vehicle experience that will be deployed across all future electric vehicles in the Rivian and Volkswagen Group portfolios. In this role, you will own the architecture and implementation of the display subsystem, ensuring that pixels travel from applications to the physical screens efficiently, correctly, and reliably.

You will work deep within the display and graphics stack, bridging the gap between high-level applications and low-level hardware drivers. You will be responsible for enabling complex multi-display setups, optimizing display and graphics performance, and ensuring the stability of the visual experience in our next-generation vehicles.

Key Responsibilities

Display & Graphics Stack Ownership: Design, develop, and maintain the display pipeline across both Android and non-Android platforms — focusing on SurfaceFlinger, Window Manager, and the Hardware Composer (HWC) HAL on Android, and equivalent compositor/display-server stacks such as Wayland/Weston and OpenWF Display (OpenWFD) on QNX/Linux-based systems.
Multi-Display Architecture: Engineer solutions for complex automotive display topologies, including Instrument Clusters, Central Infotainment (IVI), Passenger Displays, and Rear Seat Entertainment systems.
SoC Display Bring-Up & Integration: Partner directly with automotive infotainment SoC vendors to bring up and validate new display panels and interfaces on target hardware, spanning both Android and non-Android display stacks (e.g. OpenWF Display / OpenWFD on QNX-based systems, and Wayland/Weston compositors on Linux-based systems).
Performance Optimization: Analyze and optimize the graphics pipeline to ensure 60FPS+ performance, low latency, and efficient memory bandwidth usage. Debug VSYNC issues, frame drops, and jank.
HAL & Driver Integration: Work with SoC vendors to integrate and debug display drivers, ensuring proper communication between the Android Framework and the Kernel (DRM/KMS).
Stability & Robustness: Investigate and resolve stability issues such as screen freezes, black screens, and graphical artifacts. Analyze ANRs and native crashes related to the display/graphics stack.
Feature Development: Implement custom display features such as dynamic resolution switching, content mirroring, and hardware-accelerated layering/composition.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with the Hardware, Kernel, and HMI Application teams to define requirements and resolve cross-layer dependencies.

Minimum Qualifications

BS/MS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
5+ years of experience in embedded software development or platform engineering.
Strong proficiency in C++ and C. Familiarity with Java/Kotlin for Android Framework debugging.
Deep understanding of Android framework components like SurfaceFlinger, BufferQueue, and the Android display/graphics architecture.
Experience implementing or debugging HIDL/AIDL interfaces, specifically the Hardware Composer (HWC) or Gralloc.
Solid understanding of Linux OS internals, memory management (Ion/Dmabuf), and multi-threading.
Familiarity with low level display HW including Serializer/Deserializer, video links and display interfaces.
Hands-on experience integrating and bringing up new displays on automotive infotainment SoCs (e.g. Qualcomm Snapdragon Cockpit/Ride, NXP i.MX, TI Jacinto), including working knowledge of non-Android display compositor stacks such as OpenWF Display (OpenWFD) and Wayland/Weston.
Proficiency with version control systems like Git.

Preferred Qualifications

Low-Level Display: Knowledge of Linux DRM/KMS (Direct Rendering Manager / Kernel Mode Setting) subsystem and V4L2.
Automotive Standards: Experience with Android Automotive OS (AAOS) specific features like EVS (Exterior View System) or Cluster display management.
Functional Safety: Familiarity with display related automotive functional safety aspects.
Virtualization: Familiarity with display virtualization (VirtIO-GPU) and hypervisor environments (e.g., QNX, Gunyah).
SoC Experience: Experience bringing up display stacks on major automotive SoCs (Qualcomm Snapdragon, MediaTek, NXP, etc.).
Tools: Proficiency with performance profiling tools like Systrace, Perfetto, and vendor-specific GPU profilers.
Graphics APIs: Experience with OpenGL ES, Vulkan, or EGL.

Total Rewards

We build the exceptional — and we believe the people doing that work should be rewarded accordingly. In addition to a competitive base salary, full-time positions may be is eligible to participate in our annual company performance bonus program.

Payments are discretionary and not guaranteed; actual amounts depend on company results and the terms of the plan in effect, and require active employment at the time of payout. This role is also eligible for equity in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), subject to board approval and the terms of our equity incentive plans, including applicable vesting requirements.

In addition to our compensation programs, we invest in our people with a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the health, wellbeing, and financial future for full-time employees — including health coverage, retirement savings, time off, and family planning programs. Offerings vary by country. Learn more about our global benefit programs
.

External candidates can apply for this role through the Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies careers site ( https://rivianvw.tech/#careers
). If you are a current employee, please apply through our internal job board
.

Equal Opportunity

Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender expression, gender identity, genetic information or characteristics, physical or mental disability, marital/domestic partner status, age, military/veteran status, medical condition, or any other characteristic protected by law. We are also committed to ensuring compliance with all applicable fair employment practice laws regarding citizenship and immigration status.

Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies is committed to ensuring that our hiring process is accessible for persons with disabilities. If you have a disability or limitation, such as those covered by the Americans with Disabilities Act, that requires accommodations to assist you in the search and application process, please email us at candidateaccommodations@rivian.com.

Candidate Data Privacy

jobs.description:
Location: Schaumburg, IL Department: Engineering Posted: 10/22/2026 Location Name: HSIO-Schaumburg

Wage Max: 120,000.00 Annual Wage Min: 100,000.00 Annual

Amphenol Communications Solutions (ACS), a division of Amphenol Corporation, is a world leader in interconnect solutions for Communications, Mobile, RF, Optics, and Commercial electronics markets. Amphenol Corporation is one of the world’s largest designers and manufacturers of electrical, electronic and fiber optic connectors and interconnect systems, antennas, sensors and sensor-based products and coaxial and high-speed specialty cable. ACS has an expansive global presence in research and development, manufacturing, and sales. We design and manufacture a wide range of innovative connectors as well as cable assemblies for diverse applications including server, storage, data center, mobile, RF, networking, industrial, business equipment, and automotive.

Position: Advanced Automation Engineer - HSIO Overpass Solutions

Location: Nashua, NH / Valley Green, PA / Chicago, IL

Summary

The Advanced Automation Engineer will serve as a primary technical interface between Amphenol and customers developing automated or semi-automated systems for HSIO Overpass cable installation. This role will focus heavily on understanding customer automation requirements, identifying installation and process challenges, developing practical automation solutions, and driving technical issues to resolution.

The role will work closely with customer engineering, automation, manufacturing, and operations teams to evaluate applications, troubleshoot automation problems, develop proof-of-concept solutions, and recommend improvements to product design, tooling, fixtures, equipment, and installation processes. Internally, the engineer will connect customer requirements with product development, NPI, manufacturing, quality, and operations teams to ensure solutions are robust, scalable, and ready for production.

The successful candidate will be a hands-on problem solver who is comfortable working directly with customers, leading technical discussions, troubleshooting complex automation issues, and converting customer challenges into actionable engineering solutions.

Responsibilities

Serve as a primary customer-facing technical resource for automation, installation, handling, and manufacturability of HSIO Overpass cable solutions.
Build strong technical relationships with customer engineering, automation, manufacturing, and operations teams.
Engage directly with customers to understand automation requirements, installation challenges, production objectives, and system-level constraints.
Lead customer discussions and technical reviews to identify automation opportunities, risks, and potential solutions.
Act as the liaison between customer engineering teams and Amphenol product development, NPI, process engineering, quality, and operations.
Own and drive automation-related customer issues from problem identification through root-cause analysis, corrective action, validation, and closure.
Troubleshoot difficult automation and installation problems involving cable handling, routing, insertion, retention, orientation, fixturing, tooling, vision, force control, and product variation.
Quickly assess customer automation failures and determine whether the root cause is related to product design, tooling, equipment, process parameters, controls, handling, or operator interaction.
Develop practical, data-driven solutions to improve automation performance, repeatability, cycle time, yield, quality, and reliability.
Support customers during automation trials, equipment development, proof-of-concept builds, system integration, and production launch.
Participate in customer on-site trials and provide hands-on technical support during automation development and implementation.
Review customer automation concepts and provide recommendations to improve compatibility with HSIO Overpass products.
Conduct design-for-automation reviews for Overpass cable and interconnect products based on customer installation requirements.
Identify product design characteristics that may create automation challenges and recommend changes to improve handling, orientation, insertion, routing, retention, and repeatability.
Work with equipment suppliers and integrators to develop, troubleshoot, and optimize automation solutions.
Establish troubleshooting methods and standardized approaches for common Overpass automation challenges.
Identify opportunities for emerging automation technologies, robotics, machine vision, sensors, force control, and intelligent process monitoring.
Translate lessons learned from customer applications into product design guidelines, automation standards, and internal best practices.
Communicate customer requirements, technical findings, risks, action plans, and project status to internal leadership and cross-functional teams.
Develop and maintain process documentation, work instructions, training materials, validation plans, and automation troubleshooting guides.
Support the transition of successful customer automation concepts into scalable manufacturing processes.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Automation Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or related technical discipline.
5+ years of experience in automation engineering, manufacturing engineering, process engineering, equipment engineering, or related technical role.
Strong experience troubleshooting automated manufacturing processes.
Demonstrated experience solving complex mechanical, process, tooling, equipment, and automation problems.
Strong understanding of Design for Manufacturability and Design for Automation principles.
Experience reviewing product designs and identifying potential automation and manufacturing risks.
Ability to read and interpret mechanical drawings, electrical schematics, control diagrams, and product documentation.
Strong understanding of mechanical systems, fixtures, tooling, sensors, pneumatics, actuators, motion-control systems, and automated material handling.
Strong root-cause analysis and structured problem-solving skills.
Ability to quickly diagnose problems and develop practical corrective actions under customer and production time constraints.
Strong customer-facing communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical problems and solutions clearly.
Ability to lead technical discussions with customer engineering and automation teams.
Strong interpersonal skills and ability to establish credibility and trust with customers.
Ability to manage multiple customer issues and projects simultaneously while maintaining strong follow-through.
Ability to travel domestically and internationally to support customers, suppliers, and manufacturing sites.

Preferred Experience

Experience supporting automation integration directly with OEM or Tier 1 customers.
Experience with automated installation of cables, connectors, wire harnesses, interconnects, or similar products.
Experience troubleshooting customer automation equipment and production processes.
Experience working with machine builders, system integrators, robotics integrators, and automation suppliers.
Experience taking a customer automation problem from initial investigation through proof-of-concept, validation, and production implementation.
Experience scaling automation from prototype or pilot production into high-volume manufacturing.
Experience developing automation roadmaps tied to capacity, labor efficiency, yield improvement, quality, reliability, and customer program timing.
Experience with rapid-response engineering and customer escalation environments.
Experience developing customer-facing technical presentations, proposals, feasibility studies, and problem-solving reports.
Experience mentoring automation engineers, process engineers, technicians, or equipment-development teams.

KEY SUCCESS FACTORS

Customer-Focused Problem Solver: Quickly understand customer automation challenges and take ownership of finding practical solutions.
Strong Customer Interaction: Build trusted relationships with customer engineering, automation, manufacturing, and operations teams.
Automation Troubleshooting: Diagnose problems across product design, tooling, equipment, controls, process parameters, and material handling.
Hands-On Engineering: Work directly with equipment, fixtures, tooling, products, and processes to identify and solve problems.
Root-Cause Ownership: Drive automation issues from initial problem identification through root cause, corrective action, validation, and closure.
Technical Communication: Clearly communicate complex automation problems, risks, recommendations, and solutions to customers and internal stakeholders.
Fast Response: Respond effectively to customer escalations and production issues where rapid technical problem-solving is critical.
Design for Automation: Identify automation risks early and influence product design to improve automated handling, installation, inspection, and production scalability.
Cross-Functional Leadership: Connect customers with product engineering, NPI, manufacturing, quality, operations, and suppliers to solve problems efficiently.
Continuous Improvement: Identify recurring customer and manufacturing issues and convert lessons learned into better products, processes, tooling, and automation standards.
Customer-to-Factory Translation: Convert customer application requirements into clear internal engineering, product, tooling, equipment, and process requirements.
Production Readiness: Ensure automation solutions developed with customers can be reliably scaled into repeatable, high-volume manufacturing.

The base salary range for this position is $100,000- $120,000 annually. In determining rate of pay, Amphenol considers a variety of nondiscriminatory factors, including but not limited to geographic location, relevant industry experience, qualifications, skills, and education. It would be rare for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for a given role. Base salary is one facet of Amphenol's total rewards package which includes participation in our comprehensive benefits program with medical, dental, and vision benefits effective day 1, vacation, sick leave, personal days, paid holidays, life insurance, short/long term disability, and matching 401K.

Amphenol Corporation is proud of our reputation as an excellent employer. Our focus is to provide the highest level of support and responsiveness to both our employees and our customers, the world's largest technology companies. Amphenol Corporation offers the opportunity for career growth within a global organization. We believe that Amphenol Corporation is unique in that every employee, regardless of his or her position, has the ability to positively impact the business.

Experience with Agile lifecycle processes including Scrum, Continuous Integration, and Test-Driven Development Methodologies

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description

About the Team

The Multimodal team is transforming how ServiceNow understands multimodal content, including documents, images, and videos, by bringing the latest advances in AI into enterprise workflows. We build and own the platform services and products that power use cases across document extraction, visual understanding, and agentic automation. Our team includes ML engineers and applied researchers who are passionate about turning cutting-edge research into reliable products that deliver real customer impact.

Job Description

The Machine Learning Engineer designs, builds, deploys, and operates the services behind ServiceNow's multimodal AI capabilities, helping the platform understand documents, images, and videos. The Engineer works on the platform services and products that bring LLMs into reliable, scalable enterprise features. This role needs someone who cares deeply about building production-ready ML services: designing clean APIs and pipelines, deploying and scaling services on Kubernetes, and keeping them fast, observable, and resilient. The Engineer owns the quality and correctness of what ships, whether the code was written by a human or with the help of AI coding agents.

What You Get To Do:

Build scalable ML services. Design, develop, and improve services and pipelines for document extraction, visual understanding, and agentic automation, integrating LLMs into production systems.
Deploy and operate on Kubernetes. Containerize, deploy, and scale services on Kubernetes, and contribute to CI/CD, observability, and alerting that keep them reliable.
Own quality and reliability in production. Write clean, tested code, build automated tests, monitor service health, and help investigate and resolve customer-facing issues such as performance limits and quality gaps.
Build product features end to end. Turn product requirements into well-designed features, from API design and data handling to performance tuning and release.
Collaborate across teams. Partner with product managers, engineers, designers and consuming product teams to define success criteria, understand tradeoffs, and communicate capabilities and limitations clearly.

Qualifications

Qualifications

Master's degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related technical field, with 1 to 3 years of related experience.
Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.
Software engineering fundamentals. Strong command of data structures, algorithms, system design, APIs, concurrency, and testing. Java or JavaScript experience is a bonus.
Hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes
ML foundations. Solid understanding of machine learning fundamentals and how LLMs and vision-language models are integrated into applications.
Computer vision and model evaluation. Understanding computer vision techniques and the ability to evaluate model quality independently, including designing test sets and choosing the right metrics.
Production mindset. Experience building, deploying, and operating services, with attention to scalability, observability, and reliability.
Hands-on multimodal experience. Projects, research, or work involving document understanding or multimodal models is a strong plus.
AI-native approach. Curiosity and a track record of using AI tools to improve engineering workflows.
Growth mindset. Eagerness to learn, take ownership, and grow in a collaborative team.
