jobs.title: Enterprise Software Engineer
jobs.description:
About Us

At Antares, our long-term mission is to make clean energy abundant from Earth to the Asteroid Belt. We’re fueled by the belief that advanced nuclear energy can strengthen our military, solve the climate crisis, elevate global living standards, and expand humanity's presence in outer space. To achieve our mission, we’re building mass-producible, inherently safe, deployable microreactors that can be used terrestrially, underwater, and in space.

The Antares team hails from SpaceX, the White House, the Pentagon, the Department of Energy, MIT, Rigetti Computing, General Atomics, Relativity Space, Ursa Major, and National Laboratories like Idaho, Oak Ridge, Los Alamos, and Savannah River. Antares has raised over $600M in venture capital from top-tier investors and has hundreds of million-dollars on contract with the military services, NASA, and the Department of Energy.

About The Team

As an early member of Antares' quality systems function, you will help build the operating backbone that connects supplier execution, manufacturing, purchasing, quality, engineering, and finance. This role owns the practical systems and workflows that keep physical work moving: manufacturing execution, purchasing, supplier status, material readiness, inspections, exceptions, approvals, and the data structures that make those workflows reliable.

This is not a traditional dashboard or reporting analyst role. The ideal candidate is a systems-minded operator who can administer enterprise tools, map real business processes, build automations and AI-enabled workflows, as well as sit with users to make the system match how work actually gets done. You will partner with supply chain, manufacturing, quality, engineering, finance, software, and external suppliers to create workflows that track commitments, surface blockers, trigger escalations, and help the team execute faster without losing configuration control or compliance readiness.

Roles & Responsibilities:

Translate supply chain, manufacturing, quality, engineering, and finance requirements into reliable system workflows, data models, forms, approvals, exception logic, permissions, and operating procedures.
Design and implement agentic and AI-enabled workflows that help track supplier commitments, purchase order status, material readiness, action items, nonconformances, expediting needs, open risks, and required follow-ups.
Implement anomaly detection algorithms to identify gaps in quality processes and help prioritize system architecture improvements.
Build practical automations using SQL, Python, APIs, low-code tools, Robotic Process Automation, webhooks, or workflow engines to reduce manual status chasing and improve execution visibility across internal teams and suppliers.
Develop human-in-the-loop AI workflows that can summarize communications, extract commitments, propose next actions, draft follow-ups, flag missing data, and escalate exceptions throughout enterprise systems while preserving user accountability and review.
Own day-to-day administration, configuration, and improvement of supply chain and manufacturing enterprise systems, including MES, purchasing/procurement systems, ERP/MRP modules, supplier portals, inventory/material systems, and related operational tools.
Create integrations between enterprise systems and collaboration tools such as email, Slack/Teams, ticketing systems, document repositories, supplier portals, spreadsheets, and internal applications.
Maintain master data and system hygiene for suppliers, parts, BOMs, routings, purchase orders, work orders, inspection status, ownership, lead times, milestones, and operational metadata.
Support implementation and rollout of new tools or modules, including requirements gathering, vendor coordination, configuration, testing, migration, user acceptance testing, training, and post-launch support.
Partner with supply chain and manufacturing teams to build workflows for PO release, supplier onboarding, supplier execution reviews, material readiness, receiving, inspection, nonconformance handling, change/containment impact analyses, and production handoffs.
Create repeatable process documentation, system runbooks, automation specs, change logs, training materials, access-control guidance, and audit evidence that support regulated and government-facing operations.
Monitor workflow performance and system adoption, proactively identifying bottlenecks, data-quality issues, broken integrations, and opportunities to simplify or automate operational work.
Own practical data quality and exception-management routines so AI workflows act on trusted information, produce auditable outputs, and route edge cases to the right accountable owners.
Incorporate and grow unit and integration testing for the enterprise software suite and internal tools developed as part of the role.
Partner with database architects and system administrators to design and develop extract, transform, and load pipelines from various source systems into optimized formats for AI-enabled processing.

Basic Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, math, physics or related fields
3+ years of experience in supply chain systems, manufacturing systems, procurement operations, business systems, operations technology, industrial engineering, or a similar role supporting enterprise workflows.

Preferred Skills and Experience:

Hands-on experience administering or implementing at least one enterprise operations system such as MES, ERP/MRP, procurement/purchasing, supplier management, inventory/materials, QMS, PLM, or workflow automation platforms.
Software development experience in a high-level coding language (e.g. Python, Java, C#).
Strong understanding of supply chain and manufacturing processes such as purchase orders, supplier commitments, expediting, material readiness, inventory, work orders, receiving, inspections, nonconformances, and production support.
Ability to translate ambiguous operational needs into clear process maps, system requirements, workflow logic, test plans, documentation, and user training.
Working knowledge of SQL and data structures, plus experience using Python, APIs, low-code automation, RPA, scripting, or similar tools to connect systems and automate operational tasks.
Interest in and practical understanding of AI-enabled workflows, including prompt design, structured outputs, human-in-the-loop review, permissions, data quality, and safe escalation logic.
Experience with software version control systems (e.g. Git) and continuous integration/continuous deployment software that incorporates automated testing and release.
Strong documentation habits, attention to data quality, and ability to maintain disciplined systems in a fast-moving, regulated, hardware-focused environment.
Ability to work onsite in Torrance, CA and support urgent supply chain, supplier, manufacturing, audit, or production milestones as needed.

Additional Requirements:

Ability to work long hours and weekends as necessary to support critical supplier, manufacturing, production, system implementation, or audit milestones.
Ability to travel occasionally to suppliers, implementation partners, customer/government sites, or company facilities as business needs require.

Location

We are located in Torrance, CA in a 322,000 square foot, brand new facility featuring large open spaces for team collaboration, R&D, and production, as well as easy access to the 405, 105, and 110 freeways. Our facility is in the heart of Los Angeles' vibrant emerging tech ecosystem alongside many other high-growth startups and enterprises.

Culture

At Antares, we like to specifically tie each role to our founding document’s set of values–here are the top five cultural values we think you should believe at your core to be successful:

Think in Systems - Energy and Defense are complex ecosystems with numerous stakeholders with competing priorities, conflicting policies, perverse incentives, and emergent and path-dependent properties. First principles thinking alone is insufficient. Think probabilistically and then take action. “If you want to be certain, then you are apt to be obsolete.” Over-optimizing the components often degrades the system
Obsess over the End User - The customer and end user are often not the same. We will never build globally competitive commercial products if we lose sight of our end users and their entire interaction with the product life cycle
Be Unconstrained by Convention - Our only limits are the laws of physics. Many, even experts, will say what we are working on is impossible. They said the same about SpaceX reusing rockets. Generationally impactful companies, by definition, must accomplish the seemingly impossible. If it were easy, it would have already been done. Never shy away from a solution because it has never been tried before, and never choose to do something because that's “how it's always been done”
Go Where the Work Is - Never miss a chance to meet a customer, user, or stakeholder face to face, even if that means hopping on a plane. If you can’t make it, find a teammate who can channel your intentions and go in your place. Deep work can be done from anywhere, but we believe teams are built in person, and aim to maximize our time together
Operate in the Grey - Embrace nuance in pursuit of truth. Question every fundamental assumption

Equal Opportunity

Employment decisions are based solely on merit, competence, and qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability, or any other legally protected status.

2 years of demonstrated experience working and collaborating with AI researchers to develop and deploy AI models into production systems.

The Compliance Program Engineering team builds the core infrastructure that supports Block's compliance program and the product teams that depend on it. When Block needs to meet a regulatory obligation, the investigators, analysts, and automated systems doing that work rely on our platforms to understand what is happening across Block's ecosystem and act on it.
We focus on two areas:
1) Unified transaction store and search. Transactions are one of the most important building blocks at Block. We bring transaction data from across Block's products into one place and make it easy to understand, search, and use. This helps the business stay compliant and supports new product use cases. We're investing in data coverage, quality, and usability, and in self-serve tools that make it simple for new product types to onboard.
2) Entity labeling, ingestion, and workflow. We give teams a flexible way to label any entity at Block, such as a customer, account, or transaction, without cluttering core data models. Those labels can trigger downstream effects, so teams can build complex workflows on top of them. Labels can be applied through simple self-serve tools or through high-volume bulk ingestion at scale, which makes automation possible.
As a full stack software engineer on Compliance Program Engineering, you'll design, build, and operate these platforms. We work with an incubator mindset: we start small, prove value quickly, scale what works, and hand mature solutions to a dedicated team. You'll balance delivering value today with building foundations that last. Where business units have similar needs, you'll help them share the same systems so every team can move faster.
You Will
Partner closely with your team to design, develop, test, ship, and maintain features across our transaction and labeling platforms
Write high-quality, well-tested code, and participate actively in design reviews and code reviews
Design and implement systems that work within our microservice and event-driven architectures and handle sensitive customer and financial data with care and correctness
Improve the coverage, quality, and usability of transaction data so investigators, analysts, and automated systems can trust and act on it
Build self-serve tools and high-volume ingestion pipelines that let teams across Block onboard new products and label entities without waiting on us
Partner directly with Compliance, Risk, and product teams to turn regulatory and business requirements into durable, reusable platform capabilities
Participate in operational ownership of engineering systems, including on-call, incident response, and postmortems
Demonstrate AI fluency by using AI-powered tools throughout the development lifecycle to improve velocity and quality, while applying sound judgment in their use
Hold your teammates, and yourself, to high engineering standards
Learn from and support other engineers through code reviews and technical discussion

You Have
3+ years of software development or equivalent experience
Experience building and maintaining production software systems, and delivering well-scoped projects or features end-to-end (design, build, test, ship, operate) with guidance from more experienced engineers
Worked across the stack, on backend services and on the interfaces people use to operate them
Drive to find flaws in a system with many moving parts and take whatever steps are necessary to fix them
Curiosity about problems that arrive only partly specified, and a habit of asking the questions that make them concrete
A track record of explaining technical tradeoffs in writing and in person, to engineers and non-engineers alike
Demonstrated AI fluency, including experience using AI-powered developer tools and the ability to critically evaluate and responsibly apply their outputs
Bachelor's Degree or Diploma in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience

Even better:
Experience building platforms or self-serve tools that other engineering teams build on
Experience with search systems, data modeling, or bulk data ingestion at scale

Experience working with sensitive data (PII, PCI) or building to privacy, security, or regulatory requirements
Experience integrating LLMs or agents into production workflows
Interest in compliance or financial technology is a plus. Deep domain expertise isn't required; we'll teach you.

Ruby on Rails, Sidekiq
Java, Kotlin

AWS

Kafka, event-driven architecture, microservices

jobs.description:
Machine Learning Engineer – Evals

Location:
Brooklyn, New York

Work Arrangement:
Onsite, five days per week

Employment Type:
Full-time

Base Salary:
$220,000–$300,000 annually, plus equity

Relocation Assistance:
$5,000 stipend available

About The Opportunity

Our client is an engineering-driven AI research company developing infrastructure for AI memory, identity modeling, and personalization. Its work combines machine learning and cognitive science to help AI applications understand users and adapt their behavior over time.

Join a small, research-focused engineering team where you will report directly to the CTO, contribute to open-source work, and help shape how advanced language models are evaluated and improved.

Position Overview

We are seeking a Machine Learning Engineer specializing in evaluations to design, build, and maintain complex evaluation frameworks, simulators, and environments for reinforcement learning (RL) post-training.

This role requires both demonstrated research ability and strong software engineering skills. The ideal candidate has created novel LLM evaluations from scratch, produced high-quality published or open-source research, and developed production-quality Python systems.

Key Responsibilities

Design and build novel evaluation frameworks that measure LLM capabilities, behavior, and performance.
Develop complex simulators and RL environments to support model evaluation and post-training.
Build and validate LLM-as-judge methods, including scoring criteria and assessment reliability.
Create simulated environments and synthetic user interactions to assess memory, identity modeling, and personalization.
Collaborate with researchers and engineers to translate research questions into reproducible experiments and actionable findings.
Develop and maintain production-quality Python code, including tests, documentation, and ongoing maintenance.
Use experiment tracking and evaluation results to identify model limitations and guide improvements.
Integrate evaluation workflows into model development and the team’s regular release cycle.
Contribute to open-source research, evaluation tools, and benchmarks.

Required Qualifications

At least three years of experience designing and building LLM evaluations.
Demonstrated experience designing, building, and operating complex evaluations or simulators for RL post-training, such as LLM-as-judge systems, RL environments, or simulations.
A strong research record demonstrated through first-author or co-author publications at NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, or equivalent venues, or self-published open-source research of comparable quality.
Production-quality Python skills, including testing, maintainability, and experience supporting regular software releases.
Hands-on experience with PyTorch, Hugging Face, and Weights & Biases.
Experience designing original evaluation methods beyond running existing benchmarks.
Ability to communicate research findings clearly and collaborate closely with a small engineering team.
Availability to work onsite in Brooklyn five days per week.

Preferred Qualifications

Master’s degree or PhD in computer science, mathematics, statistics, or a related quantitative field.
Experience building simulated environments or synthetic users to evaluate or train LLMs.
Research or engineering experience involving LLM memory, identity, or personalization.
Familiarity with data pipeline and configuration tools such as Hydra, Kafka, and SQL.
Meaningful contributions to open-source AI research or benchmarks.

What Success Looks Like

You bring research depth and the engineering ability to turn novel evaluation methods into reliable systems. Your experience extends beyond standard benchmark execution, RAG evaluation, or applied agent testing to include original evaluation design and research relevant to RL post-training.

Compensation And Benefits

Annual base salary of $220,000–$300,000, plus equity.
Fully covered premiums for medical, dental, and vision insurance.
Starter 401(k) plan.
$5,000 annual lifestyle stipend.
Unlimited paid time off.
Office located in a building with an Equinox fitness club.
$5,000 relocation stipend.

Why Join

Help address foundational research challenges in AI memory and personalization.
Work directly with the CTO in a flat team structure.
Own consequential evaluation work from research through implementation.
Contribute to visible, citable open-source work.
Join a fast-growing AI company with a biweekly release cadence.

Application Materials

Please submit your resume or CV and links to relevant publications, open-source research, or evaluation projects. Highlight your contributions to original evaluation design, RL environments, simulators, or LLM-as-judge systems.

By submitting your application, you authorize Lovefreedom Solution Workforce to represent your candidacy and present your qualifications to its client for the Machine Learning Engineer – Evals position, subject to disclosure of the client’s identity and verification that no prior application or representation exists for this specific opportunity.

Proficiency in Python, and strong skills in TypeScript with a modern frontend framework.
REST API design, and strong SQL against relational databases and cloud data platforms.
Practical understanding of AI application patterns — RAG, embeddings and vector search, semantic layers, tool calling, evaluation, and grounding.
Strong Git and collaborative development practice, including CI/CD and written documentation.
Ability to work in an unfamiliar codebase and cloud environment: read it, extend it safely, and document what you find.
Comfort in an early-stage, start-up-style team — owning work independently and shaping process where none exists yet.

Experience at a start-up, or on a founding or early-stage product team.
Azure certification — Azure AI Engineer Associate, Azure Developer Associate, or equivalent.

jobs.description:
Optical Communications Software Engineer – Modem Integration

Bright Silicon Technologies | Pleasanton, CA | Full time

About The Role

Bright Silicon Technologies (BST) develops precision optical systems built around our Lightfield Directing Array (LDA), a MEMS micromirror array for fast, precise control of light. Our OCTANE free-space optical communications terminal brings together free-space optics, fiber-based photonics, and communications hardware to enable high-bandwidth links between ground and airborne platforms.

We’re looking for a software engineer to own modem integration and communications software for OCTANE. You’ll build the software that configures and monitors our (expected to be a COMET) modem, connects it to the terminal’s data interfaces, and manages link operation and recovery. Working with our photonics, firmware, controls, and hardware engineers, you’ll take a working laboratory system toward reliable outdoor and mobile operation, targeting Space Development Agency (SDA) interoperability.

What you’ll do

Own modem software integration for our free space optical communications terminal. Develop C/C++ software for modem configuration, telemetry, host interfaces, network interface and data transfer.
Define software interfaces and acceptance criteria, including applicable SDA Optical Communications Terminal (OCT) requirements. Coordinate link states and timing with pointing, acquisition, and tracking (PAT) software.
Implement link state machines, startup and shutdown sequences, fault handling, and recovery after fades or interruptions.
Build Python tools and automated bench and hardware-in-the-loop tests. Measure throughput, latency, packet loss, and bit error rate to verify link performance.
Troubleshoot problems across software, embedded interfaces, modem behavior, interfaces with the next level up in the network, and optical performance

What we’re looking for

A bachelor’s or advanced degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience, and at least three years of modem integration and communications software development experience.
Strong C/C++ skills and experience developing and debugging software on Linux or real-time embedded platforms.
Hands-on experience integrating communications hardware and debugging hardware/software interfaces using logs, telemetry, protocol captures, and laboratory measurements.
Experience using Python or a similar language for test automation and data analysis, with working knowledge of communications performance measurements.
U.S. citizenship.

Nice to have

Experience with SDA OCT standards, compliant optical terminals, or modem and terminal interoperability testing.
Experience with COMET or other optical communications modems, including configuration, telemetry, and host integration.
Experience with free-space or fiber-optic communications, including optical link budgets, receiver sensitivity, and the effects of changing received power.
Familiarity with communications or modem DSP, including modulation, synchronization, framing, forward error correction, or equalization.
Experience integrating software with FPGA-based systems, including register interfaces and data paths.
Experience validating link state machines and fault recovery through hardware-in-the-loop testing or field demonstrations on mobile platforms.

Don't meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At BST we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Why BST

Own the software that connects OCTANE’s modem and terminal hardware into a working optical communications link, from bench integration through outdoor testing.
Work closely with colleagues in photonics, firmware, controls, and electronics. Follow problems across interfaces and see the results in operating hardware.
Take meaningful technical ownership in an engineer-led company with competitive compensation, equity, and a sustainable approach to work.

Company Overview

At Bright, we build precision optical systems to guide data for a new era of communication. Our team combines precision engineering, optical design, and product development to commercialize the Lightfield Directing Array. Applications include laser communications, optical switching for data centers, lidar, and additive manufacturing.

Founded in 2020, Bright Silicon Technologies is building an enduring technology manufacturing company. You’ll contribute to the development, launch, and scaling of advanced optical products. We offer competitive salaries and equity incentives, and we value effective engineering alongside long-term work/life balance.

About the Position

This is a highly collaborative, product-focused front-end software engineering role focused on building the customer-facing software systems, powering a next-generation manufacturing platform.

The priority for this position is front-end development, UX/UI, workflow visualization, 3D rendering, and operational software experiences. The ideal candidate will bring strong experience building intuitive, polished, user-facing applications that simplify highly technical manufacturing workflows.
A core part of this role is displaying 3D models of parts, dies, and toolpaths and letting users manipulate them directly in the application. Hands-on experience with 3D graphical rendering is required.

You’ll help develop the software layer that enables operators, engineers, and customers to interact with an AI-driven forging platform, proprietary Universal Operating System, and automation workflows. This includes helping create systems that support AI-assisted toolpath generation, interactive 3D visualization of parts, toolpaths, and forging cells, and long-term near-autonomous manufacturing initiatives.

Responsibilities

Design and develop modern customer-facing web applications and operational interfaces
Build intuitive UX/UI experiences supporting advanced manufacturing and automation workflows
Create workflow visualization tools and operational dashboards for manufacturing processes
Build interactive, performant 3D rendering experiences in the browser for displaying parts, dies, toolpaths, robotic cells, and live process states
Develop 3D interaction tools that let users manipulate models directly, including rotating, zooming, panning, sectioning, measuring, and annotating geometry
Support development of interfaces tied to AI-driven toolpath and automation systems
Collaborate closely with robotics, controls, manufacturing, and software engineering teams
Translate customer and operational feedback into scalable software features and workflows
Integrate APIs, backend systems, and hardware-connected platforms into front-end applications
Help shape the usability, functionality, and long-term direction of ForgeNest’s proprietary Universal Operating System.

Who You Are

Most effective building intuitive, polished, customer-facing software systems
Product-minded developer focused heavily on UX/UI, workflows, and usability
Comfortable collaborating directly with engineers, operators, customers, and leadership teams
Strong communicator capable of translating technical workflows into clean user experiences
Curious and resourceful with strong independent problem-solving ability
Adaptable and quick to ramp up on new technologies, domains, and projects
Motivated by building software that directly impacts real-world industrial and manufacturing systems

What You Bring

Strong front-end software development experience with emphasis on UX/UI and customer-facing applications
Experience building intuitive, workflow-oriented user interfaces
Strong understanding of usability, workflow design, and customer interaction principles
Experience with modern front-end frameworks such as React, Vue, or Angular
API integration and backend connectivity experience
Ability to collaborate directly with engineering teams, operators, and end users
Experience building operational dashboards, workflow tools, or visualization platforms preferred
Hands-on experience with 3D graphical rendering, including building interfaces that display and let users manipulate 3D models (e.g., Three.js, React Three Fiber, WebGL/WebGPU)
Understanding of 3D graphics fundamentals such as cameras, lighting, materials, and rendering performance
Experience working with CAD-derived geometry and formats such as STEP, STL, or glTF preferred
Comfortable operating in highly collaborative startup-style environments

What Success Looks Like

Workflow Development:
Within the first 6 months, you’ve delivered meaningful improvements to software usability, operational workflows, or customer-facing functionality
User Experience:
Operators, engineers, and customers actively rely on and enjoy using the interfaces and workflows you help build
3D Visualization:
Users can view and manipulate parts, toolpaths, and forging processes through clear, responsive 3D views that make complex geometry and machine behavior easy to understand
System Integration:
Front-end applications integrate effectively with hardware, controls, robotics, and backend systems
Collaboration:
Engineering and operations teams involve you early in workflow, tooling, and platform discussions
Platform Growth:
You contribute directly toward the long-term development of ForgeNest’s proprietary Universal Operating System and near-autonomous manufacturing ecosystem

Experience

5-10+ years of professional software development experience
Strong front-end development experience building modern web applications and customer-facing platforms
Experience with UX/UI design principles and workflow-driven application development
Experience with modern front-end frameworks such as React, Vue, or Angular
Experience integrating APIs and backend services into front-end applications
Ability to collaborate with technical and non-technical stakeholders to translate operational needs into software solutions
Demonstrated experience with 3D graphical rendering (WebGL, Three.js, or similar) in a production application
Experience with CAD/CAM visualization is a strong plus
Experience within manufacturing, industrial automation, robotics, or hardware-adjacent environments is helpful but not required
Startup or fast-paced product development experience preferred

Why Join ForgeNest

ForgeNest is a venture-backed startup building an AI-driven, software-forward forging platform designed to modernize one of the world’s most critical manufacturing industries.

By combining commercially available hardware with proprietary software, AI-driven toolpath generation, and a next-generation Universal Operating System, ForgeNest is transforming how forged metal parts are designed and manufactured across defense, aerospace, energy, maritime, and industrial markets.

jobs.description:
Description

Are you interested in tackling the challenges in defending our nation against cruise, ballistic, and hypersonic missile threats?

Do you want to help ensure that our nation’s afloat and ashore forces can effectively command and control defensive systems to counter these threats?

Are you passionate about designing, developing, and deploying software solutions to meet these national security challenges?

If so, we're looking for someone like you to join our team at APL!

We are a team of 40+ engineers and scientists who perform innovative research, modeling, analysis, testing, and prototype development in the cruise/ballistic/hypersonic missile defense and electronic warfare domains. We focus on ensuring command and control resiliency in these domains, where our nation’s afloat and ashore forces face degraded, hostile, and uncertain conditions. We are seeking talented team members to build and deploy modeling & simulation software systems and analysis tool suites that help solve problems in these areas, ultimately improving the capabilities of our nation's developmental and deployed defensive systems.

As a Software Engineer for Sensor/Weapon Command & Control …

Your primary responsibility will be working as part small teams to design, develop, improve, test, and maintain software which supports missile defense and electronic warfare missions.
You will work with a data-type agnostic analysis tool suite for missile defense applications, and will refactor, improve, and maintain the codebase as well as create and maintain analysis products based on users’ needs and feedback.
You will work with modeling and simulation frameworks for electronic warfare applications, and will improve these frameworks through refactoring, improving, and maintaining the codebase as well as adding new capabilities—algorithms, interfaces, data sources, and visualizations.
You will collaborate with government and industry partners to define software architecture, interface requirements, performance metrics, and verification and validation testing.

Qualifications

You meet our minimum qualifications for the job if you...

Have a Bachelor’s degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or other related technical field (Aerospace/Mechanical/Computer/Electrical Engineering, Physics, Applied Mathematics, or similar).
Have 5+ years of professional experience in software development.
Are proficient in framework development, and plotting and visualizing data in Python
Are proficient in Web-based User Interface development using Typescript and React, with familiarity with HTML5 and Javascript
Are proficient using Git/GitLab for version control, and can develop software in both Windows and Linux environments.
Have experience with software containerization (e.g., Docker, Podman) and/or relational database management (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL).
Can effectively communicate ideas and results, with excellent interpersonal skills.
Are willing and able to occasionally support test events and occasionally travel to field sites.
Are able to obtain a Secret level security clearance by your start date and can ultimately obtain a TS/SCI level clearance. If selected, you will be subject to a government security clearance investigation and must meet the requirements for access to classified information. Eligibility requirements include U.S. citizenship.

You'll go above and beyond our minimum requirements if you...

Have a Master’s degree or PhD in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or other related technical field (Aerospace/Mechanical/Computer/Electrical Engineering, Physics, Applied Mathematics, or similar).
Have experience with development, security, and operations (DevSecOps) processes, to include continuous integration / continuous development (CI/CD) pipelines, security scanning, and/or image hardening.
Have professional experience in missile defense, electronic warfare, or similar national security domain.
Have domain knowledge of Navy surface combatant systems, to include radars, communications systems, electronic warfare systems, and/or combat systems.
Hold an active Top Secret or TS/SCI clearance.

About Us

Why Work at APL?

The Johns Hopkins University Applied Physics Laboratory (APL) brings world-class expertise to our nation’s most critical defense, security, space and science challenges. While we are dedicated to solving complex challenges and pioneering new technologies, what makes us truly outstanding is our culture. We offer a vibrant, welcoming atmosphere where you can bring your authentic self to work, continue to grow, and build strong connections with inspiring teammates.

At APL, we celebrate our differences of perspectives and encourage creativity and bold, new ideas. Our employees enjoy generous benefits, including a robust education assistance program, unparalleled retirement contributions, and a healthy work/life balance. APL’s campus is located in the Baltimore-Washington metro area. Learn more about our career opportunities at https://www.jhuapl.edu/careers.

jobs.title: AgentCore Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
About Us

Appnovation is the AI Product Company. Headquartered in Vancouver, Canada, with teams around the world, Appnovation builds AI products, delivers enterprise AI and digital solutions, and co-invests with clients to bring new AI products to market.

Open source has been the foundation of Appnovation's work since 2007, and it remains the foundation underneath every AI product the company builds today. Appnovation teams work with organizations in highly regulated industries, including global leaders such as Pfizer, Google and AstraZeneca, to help them adopt AI they can govern and own.

We’re hiring AgentCore Platform Engineers to build the agent-facing layer of the platform. That covers how agents run, remember and work together, and how they safely reach the internal systems the business already runs on. Each engineer will have a main focus in one of the two areas below and work closely across both. What you build becomes the template other teams copy, so quality and clarity matter as much as speed. This is a named-team engagement, so the person we propose is the person who starts.

We know production experience with Bedrock AgentCore is rare. We care more about strong AWS fundamentals and real hands-on work with agent frameworks than about whether you’ve used AgentCore by name. If that’s you, please apply.

FOCUS AREAS

Agent Runtime & Orchestration: Build runtime patterns, memory strategies, orchestration and multi-agent handoffs, and the reference implementations other teams copy.
Gateway, Tools & Integrations: Turn internal APIs, Lambdas and legacy systems into governed tools through AgentCore Gateway, including MCP server development.

Role Responsibilities

Runtime Patterns: Define how agents are structured, packaged and run on AgentCore Runtime, including sessions, state, error handling and timeouts.
Memory Strategies: Design short-term and long-term memory patterns using AgentCore Memory, and guide teams on when to use which.
Orchestration and Multi-Agent Handoffs: Build patterns for planning, tool use, supervisor/worker setups and handoffs between agents, with clear boundaries and fallbacks.
Tool Onboarding: Expose internal REST APIs, Lambda functions and legacy services as agent tools through AgentCore Gateway, using OpenAPI specs and Lambda targets.
MCP Server Development: Design and build Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers for systems that need custom integration, with clean tool definitions and schemas.
Governance and Access: Set up authentication and authorization for agents and tools (AgentCore Identity, OAuth, IAM) so agents only reach what they’re allowed to.
Legacy Integration: Work with system owners to wrap older or on-premises systems safely, handling rate limits, data mapping and error cases.
Reference Implementations and Standards: Build production-quality reference agents, starter kits and a repeatable process for adding, versioning and reviewing tools.
Evaluation and Guardrails: Build in evaluation, Bedrock Guardrails, contract tests and safety checks so agents and tools behave predictably before going live.
Enablement: Run walkthroughs, write docs and support the teams onboarding to the platform.

Qualifications

5+ years of software engineering experience, with strong Python (TypeScript is a plus).
Hands-on experience building LLM agents with at least one agent framework (e.g., Strands Agents, LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, OpenAI Agents SDK, LlamaIndex).
Practical experience with LLM tool/function calling and handling model output.
Strong AWS fundamentals: IAM, Lambda, API Gateway, containers, DynamoDB/S3, VPC connectivity and Secrets Manager.
Experience designing and consuming REST APIs and OpenAPI specs, and auth patterns such as OAuth 2.0 and OIDC.
Understanding of agent memory, retrieval (RAG) and context management trade-offs.
Deep hands-on strength in at least one of the two focus areas, and working knowledge of the other.
Clean, well-tested code that other engineers will read and reuse.
Clear communication and comfortable teaching patterns to other teams.

Preferred Qualifications

Hands-on experience with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore (Runtime, Memory, Gateway, Identity). A strong plus, but not required.
Experience building or running MCP servers in a real environment.
Experience with multi-agent systems in production, including observability and failure handling.
Experience integrating with enterprise or legacy systems, or with API management platforms (e.g., MuleSoft, Apigee, Kong).
Experience with LLM evaluation tools and approaches.
Experience in pharma, life sciences or another regulated industry with data access controls.

Who You Are

You’ve built agents that actually work, and you know where they tend to break
You care about patterns other people can copy, not just clever one-offs
You think about security and access control before anything goes live
You pick up new AWS services quickly and learn by building
You’re honest about what agents can and can’t do today
You work well inside a client team and enjoy helping other engineers succeed
You have prior experience in consulting
Prior experience and connections in the Life Sciences industry is preferred

Thank you for your interest in a career with Appnovation Technologies! Please note that only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

At Appnovation, we recognize that diverse teams are the strongest teams. Diversity, Equity & Inclusion is not only something that we embrace - we celebrate it! We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and we encourage applicants from all backgrounds, lived experiences and industries to apply. Come join us at Appnovation, and learn more about how we stay true to our company values as we build better lives through better digital.

Accommodations are available upon request throughout the recruitment process.

Must have a strong working knowledge and experience developing Java based software capabilities.
Should have an inquisitive nature, responsiveness, and excellent testing skills.
Must also possess strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to work under pressure with multiple deadlines.
Keep up-to-date with emerging trends and technologies in software development.
Experience with Next-Gen Coding Agents: Proven track record of integrating advanced AI agents, specifically Claude Code or Google's Antigravity / Gemini agentic workflows, into your daily software engineering routine.
Agentic Feature & Test Development: Experience using autonomous agents to handle multi-file feature implementations, complex codebase refactoring, and the automated generation of robust unit/integration tests.
Context & Workflow Management: Ability to guide AI agents through complex, multi-repository application architectures, managing context efficiently and critically auditing agent-generated code for security, performance, and architectural alignment.
Will work in a fast-paced, small business environment with our talented team.
Additional duties as assigned.

Minimum Qualifications

Clearance Requirement: Must currently have and maintain an active Top Secret level U.S. Government Security Clearance; U.S. Citizenship required.
At least 5 years of experience in Software Engineering, Modern Java Frameworks and Libraries (e.g., Spring, Guava) and a Bachelors in related field; 3 years relevant experience with Masters in related field; or High School Diploma or equivalent and 9 years relevant experience.
Experience in designing enterprise APIs.
Experience in RESTful web services.
Experience in Microservices architecture.
Experience in Object Oriented Programming (OOP) paradigms.
Experience with the agile software lifecycle.
Experience with configuration management tools (e.g. Git, Nexus, Maven).
Comfortable working on a linux command line.
Has a proven ability to learn quickly and works well both independently as well as in a team setting.
Problem solving skills and ability to review information and compile data appropriately as needed.
Must possess or be able to obtain IAT Level II certification within 60 days of start date. (CompTIA Security+ CE, CompTIA CySA+, SSCP, GIAC GSEC, CCNA Security, GICSP)
Must be able to work on customer site in Fort Meade, MD 3-4 days a week. Flexibility is essential to adapt to schedule changes as needed.

Preferred Requirements

Current Clearances: Active TS/SCI clearance is a strong plus.
Experience in cloud based technologies (AWS, Azure)
Experience in distributed databases, NoSQL databases, full text-search engines (e.g. Elasticsearch, MongoDB, Solr)
Scripting experience is a huge plus.
Next-Gen Coding Agents: Proven use of AI tools (Claude Code, Gemini) in daily engineering workflows.
Agentic Feature Delivery: Using autonomous agents for multi-file implementation, refactoring, and automated testing.
Prior experience or familiarity with Data Lakes/Warehouses (speificially BDP or JCRS-D) is a plus.
Understanding of AGILE software development methodologies and use of standard software development tool suites. (e.g., JIRA, Confluence, Github Enterprise, etc.)

Job Purpose:

BTIG seeks a DevOps/Site Reliability Engineer to join our technology team. This role is central to improving developer velocity by handling production application support escalations, managing and evolving our infrastructure stack, and providing operational continuity across the team. The ideal candidate thrives at the intersection of software operations, infrastructure engineering, and customer-facing support and is energized by the opportunity to progressively take ownership of critical platform systems within a financial services environment.
In this role, you will be a force multiplier for a focused engineering team, the person who keeps production running smoothly, evolves the platform, and creates the space for developers to build. You'll gain broad, hands-on exposure across the full stack in an environment where reliability directly impacts trading operations.
Duties & Responsibilities:

• Serve as the primary point of contact for production application escalations — triage, diagnosis, and resolution across application components and services.
• Monitor application and infrastructure health; investigate anomalies and remediate without pulling developers off feature work.
• Develop and maintain runbooks, escalation procedures, and operational knowledge base documentation.
• Identify recurring issues and collaborate with developers to drive root-cause fixes
• Own incident response and post-incident review processes
• Manage, maintain, and improve the team's infrastructure stack:
o Reverse proxy & traffic management
o Identity & Access Management
o Secret/Configuration Management
o Certificate management
o SQL and No SQL Databases
o OTEL/Metrics, Traces, Logs & Analytics
o Container Orchestration
o Event Streaming
• Automate provisioning, deployment, and configuration management
• Plan and execute upgrades, patches, security hardening, and capacity management
• Evolve infrastructure toward greater reliability, scalability, and developer self-service
• Own the observability stack — maintain and improve monitoring, alerting, dashboards, and centralized logging to ensure production issues are detected quickly and diagnosed efficiently
• Work with developers to ensure applications emit useful metrics, structured logs, and trace context
• Serve as backup to the customer support role during PTO, absences, or peak demand
• Develop familiarity with customer workflows, common issues, and resolution paths
• Contribute to support documentation and self-service tooling that reduces overall support burden
Requirements & Qualifications:

• 3–5+ years of experience in a DevOps, SRE, platform engineering, or production support role
• Strong Linux/Unix systems administration fundamentals
• Hands-on experience with containerization and container orchestration
• Experience with database administration (relational and/or document stores)
• Familiarity with reverse proxy configuration, TLS/certificate management, and identity systems
• Experience with monitoring, logging, and alerting tools in a production environment
• Comfort working directly with end users or customers in a support capacity
• Strong troubleshooting and diagnostic skills across application and infrastructure layers
• Scripting and automation proficiency (Bash, Python, PowerShell, or similar)
• Self-directed; comfortable operating with autonomy in a small, high-output team
• Strong communicator — can translate between technical and non-technical stakeholders
• Ownership mentality — treats production health as a personal responsibility
• Intellectually curious; eager to learn new domains and expand scope
Important Notes:

Must be authorized to work full time in the U.S., BTIG does not offer sponsorship for work visas of any type
No phone calls please, the applicant will be contacted within two weeks if successful

About BTIG:

BTIG is a global financial services firm specializing in institutional trading, investment banking, research and related brokerage services. With an extensive global footprint and more than 700 employees, BTIG, LLC and its affiliates operate out of 20 cities throughout the U.S., and in Europe, Asia and Australia. BTIG offers execution, expertise and insights for equities, equity derivatives, ETFs and fixed income, currency and commodities. The firm’s core capabilities include global execution, portfolio, electronic and outsource trading, investment banking, prime brokerage, capital introduction, corporate access, research and strategy, commission management and more.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or disability status. BTIG is an equal opportunity employer Minorities/Females/People with Disabilities/Protected Veterans/Sexual Orientation/Gender Identity.

Compensation: 

BTIG offers a competitive compensation and benefits package. Salary range is based on a variety of factors including, but not limited to, location, years of applicable experience, skills, qualifications, licensure and certifications, and other business and organization needs.
The current estimated base salary range for this role is $160,000.00 - $200,000.00 per year. Please note that certain positions are eligible for additional forms of compensation such as discretionary bonus or overtime.

jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

Stripe's Developer & End-user Experience Platform (DEEP) organization empowers all of Stripe's products with a shared product platform that helps with rapidly delivering high-quality, cross-product experiences across our UI and API surfaces. It focuses on providing a consistent and scalable developer experience that any developer (both internal and external) can leverage to accelerate a merchant's ability to create value using Stripe.

Team matching — exact team matching for one of the subteams will begin during final stages. Please note we may also consider you for different orgs based on your experience, location, etc. More information on our team matching process can be found here.

What you’ll do

We're looking for Backend Engineers who want to make an impact on managing money at a global scale with a passion for building ergonomic APIs. You'll play a key role in extending our balance management platform and in building out a new funds accessibility platform that enterprises and SMBs use. Our team collaborates with many cross-functional teams—from Infrastructure to Product—at Stripe to deliver innovative solutions that address evolving user needs.

Responsibilities

Scope, design, build, and maintain APIs, services, and large-scale systems that reliably and efficiently handle billions of money movement requests
Debug and solve critical production issues across services and multiple levels of the stack
Mentor engineers to help them grow
Collaborate with stakeholders across the company to build new features at large-scale, while improving internal engineering standards, tooling, and processes
Collaborate effectively in a distributed and hybrid team, maintaining open communication and strong connections with colleagues

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements

2–12+ years of industry software engineering experience (does not include internships or co-ops)
Strong coding skills in any programming language (we understand new languages can be learned on the job, so our interview process is language-agnostic)
Strong collaboration skills and the ability to work across workstreams within your team and contribute to your peers' success
Ability to thrive with a high level of autonomy and responsibility, with an entrepreneurial mindset
Interest in working as a generalist across varying technologies and stacks to solve problems and delight both internal and external users

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with large-scale financial tracking systems
Good understanding and practical knowledge in cloud-based services (e.g., gRPC, GraphQL, Docker and Kubernetes, cloud services such as AWS, etc.)

In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

Pay and benefits

The annual US base salary range for this role is $190,400 - $285,600. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the US may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.

Additional benefits for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; 401(k) plan; medical, dental, and vision benefits; and wellness stipends.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

Apply now

Job Description

Building trusted markets — powered by our people

At Cboe Global Markets, we inspire our people to solve complex challenges together because what we do matters. We provide the financial infrastructure that powers the global economy. As a leading provider of market infrastructure and tradable products, Cboe delivers cutting-edge trading, clearing and investment solutions to market participants around the world. 

We’re building meaningful ways to support professional and personal development while strengthening the trust we’ve earned as a global market leader. Our teams are empowered to share ideas, actively pursue them and bring on a challenge. As champions of internal mobility and access to opportunity, we encourage our people to “go for it” and equip our managers with the training to coach their teams to the next level. We strive to provide employees a safe space to network, share ideas and create opportunities.  

PLEASE NOTE: To support strong partnership and team connection, this role follows a four day in office work model.

While the internal title for this position is Senior Linux Engineer, this role has been posted externally under a different title to better align with market norms and to attract talent with comparable experience and skill sets.

Role Overview

We are seeking a Senior Platform Engineer to join our Systems Platform Engineer team. In this role, you will be responsible for managing and improving our highly automated Linux-based systems and platforms while supporting our broader technology infrastructure with a focus on automation. You'll be working collaboratively with our technology and operations teams to ensure the highest levels of system performance, security, and availability.

Your responsibilities will be:

Managing and improving our Linux-based infrastructure with a focus on performance, reliability, and scalability.
Designing, deploying, and maintaining on-premises Kubernetes clusters and containerized workloads.
Developing and maintaining system-level software, middleware, and APIs to support internal platforms and services.
Automating system workflows and infrastructure tasks using Python, Bash, and configuration management tools like SaltStack.
Building and maintaining RPM packages and internal software repositories.
Collaborating with Application Support (SRE), Development, and Security teams to ensure secure, automated CI/CD and platform integration.
Diagnosing and resolving complex system-level issues involving the OS, network, or container runtime.
Implementing hardened security configurations, including system hardening, secure communications, and identity/access integration.
Participating in an on-call rotation to support critical infrastructure services.
Documenting architectures, tools, and operational processes to support long-term maintainability.

The ideal candidate has

5+ years of experience in Linux systems administration and infrastructure/platform engineering.
Production experience managing Kubernetes, preferably in bare-metal or on-premises environments (e.g., with kubeadm, RKE, or OpenShift).
Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure or GCP) in production environments.
Strong scripting and automation skills in Python and Bash.
In-depth knowledge of Linux internals, kernel tuning, and performance diagnostics.
Hands-on experience with SaltStack (preferred), Puppet, or Ansible for configuration management.
Familiarity with observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, or Loki.
Solid understanding of core infrastructure protocols and services (TCP/IP, DNS, NTP/PTP, DHCP, etc.).
Experience managing CI/CD pipelines with tools such as Jenkins, GitLab, or similar.
Strong troubleshooting skills and a proactive approach to problem-solving.

You'll really stand out with:

Certifications such as RHCE or LFCE.
Experience with container runtimes (containerd, Docker) and registry management.
Knowledge of GitOps workflows or tools like ArgoCD or Flux.
Background in security best practices and compliance (e.g., CIS benchmarks, STIGs).
Prior experience in highly regulated or low-latency environments.

We value the total wellbeing of our people – including health, financial, personal and social wellness. We believe standard benefits like health insurance and fair pay are a given at any organization. Still, you should know we offer:

Fair and competitive salary and incentive compensation packages with an upside for overachievement

Health, dental and vision benefits, including access to telemedicine and mental health services 
2:1 401(k) match, up to 8% match immediately upon hire 
Discounted Employee Stock Purchase Plan  
Tax Savings Accounts for health, dependent and transportation 
Employee referral bonus program  
Volunteer opportunities to help you give back to your communities  

Some of our associates’ favorite benefits and perks include: 

Complimentary lunch, snacks and coffee in any Cboe office 
Paid Tuition assistance and education opportunities 
Generous charitable giving company match 
Paid parental leave and fertility benefits  
On-site gyms and discounts to other fitness centers 
Paid Time Off

We’re reimagining the future of the workplace by focusing on what matters most, our people. Our journey is an inclusive one. We’re investing deeply in leadership programs and career development initiatives that ensure everyone has an equal chance to succeed.  

We work with purpose, solving problems with ingenuity, collaboration, and a lot of passion. We’re an engaged and excited team connecting markets across borders and embracing growth in all its forms to achieve incredible outcomes. 

Learn more about life at Cboe on our website and LinkedIn.

, an automotive software development team with the Volkswagen Group. Our mission is to make the automotive experience safer, more sustainable, more comfortable, more digital, and more fun. To achieve that we are building the leading tech stack for the automotive industry and creating a unified software platform for over 10 million new vehicles per year.   We ’ re looking for talented, digital minds like you to help us create code that moves the world. Together with you, we ’ ll build outstanding digital experiences and products for all Volkswagen Group brands that will transform mobility. Join us as we shape the future of the car and everyone around it.

We are  CARIAD
, an automotive software development team with the Volkswagen Group. Our mission is to make the automotive experience safer, more sustainable, more comfortable, more digital, and more fun. To achieve that we are building the leading tech stack for the automotive industry and creating a unified software platform for over 10 million new vehicles per year. We’re looking for talented, digital minds like you to help us create code that moves the world. Together with you, we’ll build outstanding digital experiences and products for all Volkswagen Group brands that will transform mobility. Join us as we shape the future of the car and everyone around it.

Role Summary

The Sr Software Engineer, Integration integrates production C++ software, embedded middleware, and AI inference components into CARIAD’s autonomous-driving software stack. The role connects application software, inference runtimes, and embedded hardware to deliver reliable, real-time system behavior. Operating as a senior individual contributor, this engineer independently owns assigned complex integration deliverables on platforms such as Qualcomm 8797 and NVIDIA DRIVE Thor. The role develops C++ adapters and glue code, diagnoses issues across system interfaces, and validates integrated software through embedded testing, recompute with bit-identical replay, and HIL testing. The engineer will work closely with machine learning, embedded software, hardware, simulation, and vehicle engineering teams to resolve integration issues and prepare software for deployment.

Role Responsibilities

C++ and Middleware Integration

Design, implement, and maintain production-quality C++ software that integrates application components with embedded middleware such as Apex.AI, AOS, or ROS.
Develop C++ adapters and glue code for data exchange, interface compatibility, component lifecycle, and runtime coordination.
Integrate and debug software on Qualcomm 8797 and/or NVIDIA DRIVE Thor development kits, resolving issues across software and hardware boundaries.
Independently own assigned integration issues from reproduction and root-cause analysis through corrective implementation and verified resolution, escalating cross-system architectural decisions as appropriate.

Embedded AI Inference Integration

Integrate AI models and inference runtimes into embedded applications, including input and output handling and execution interfaces.
Implement and maintain C++ adapters connecting inference libraries with middleware and application software.
Profile and resolve integration issues affecting inference correctness, latency, memory use, and runtime stability on target hardware.
Collaborate with ML engineers to validate model behavior and runtime compatibility, using QNN or TensorRT where applicable.

Embedded Testing and Validation

Develop and execute embedded integration on development kits, benches, and HIL systems.
Implement and maintain recompute workflows for bit-identical replay under controlled inputs and execution conditions.
Investigate replay mismatches and integration regressions using logs, traces, recorded data, and target-hardware evidence.
Automate regression testing and document functional, timing, and resource-use results to support release

Technical Collaboration and Documentation

Coordinate interface changes and integration dependencies with ML, embedded software, hardware, simulation, and vehicle engineering teams.
Participate in design and code reviews, provide practical technical guidance to engineering peers, and document interfaces, configurations, integration procedures, and validation evidence.
Improve integration tooling and share lessons learned to increase reliability, reproducibility, and development efficiency.

General Skills

Strong analytical and debugging skills across software, middleware, runtime, and hardware interfaces.
Ability to independently own complex integration work and resolve issues using measurable evidence.
Clear communication and effective collaboration with ML, embedded software, hardware, and vehicle engineering teams.
Strong software engineering practices, including code review, testing, documentation, and reproducible validation.

Required Specialized Skills

Strong hands-on C++ programming skills are required, including production-quality embedded software development and debugging.
Experience integrating software with embedded middleware solutions such as Apex.AI, AOS, or ROS
Hands-on experience integrating and debugging software on embedded AI compute platforms or development kits (e.g., Qualcomm 8797 or NVIDIA DRIVE Thor).
Experience integrating AI inference on embedded targets, including C++ adapters and glue code connecting models, inference runtimes, and application interfaces.
Experience with embedded testing, including recompute (bit-identical replay) and hardware-in-the- loop (HIL) validation.

Desired Skills

Knowledge of QNN and TensorRT libraries for embedded AI inference integration.
Experience integrating or debugging camera, radar, and lidar drivers.
Experience with agentic workflows for implementation, debugging, testing, or documentation, with review and validation of generated output.

Workplace Flexibility

Hands-on work with embedded development kits, lab systems, HIL environments, and development vehicles may require on-site presence when integration or validation activities cannot be performed remotely.
Collaboration across U.S. and international time zones and occasional travel for integration activities or vehicle testing may be required.

Years Of Relevant Experience

6+ years of experience in C++ software development, embedded systems, or software integration.
Hands-on experience integrating, debugging, and validating software on embedded target hardware.
Experience independently delivering complex technical work from integration planning through implementation and validation.

Required Education

Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

Desired Education

Master's Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field.

Compensation

Salary range is dependent on factors such as geographical differentials, credentials or certifications, industry-based experience, qualification and training. The salary range for this position is $128,369 - $185,858.

CARIAD, Inc. provides performance based merits and annual bonus along with a competitive benefits package. Benefits include medical, dental, vision, 401k with employer match and defined contribution plan, short and long term disability, basic life and AD&D insurance, employee assistance program, tuition reimbursement and student loan repayment plans, maternity and non-primary caregiver leave, adoption assistance, employee referral program and vacation and paid holidays. We also offer a unique vehicle lease program that covers registration and insurance fees.

CARIAD is an Equal Opportunity Employer.  We welcome and encourage applicants from all backgrounds, and do not discriminate based on race, sex, age, disability, sexual orientation, national origin, religion, color, gender identity/expression, marital status, veteran status, or any other characteristics protected by applicable laws.

Our company is dedicated to adhering to these regulations to ensure the lawful and ethical conduct of our business activities. jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description:
Role Summary

We are looking for a strong Data Engineer with an analytical and Data Science mindset to help transform large-scale product, customer, telemetry, behavioral, and operational data into trusted datasets, actionable insights, and predictive intelligence.

This role will initially focus on Data Engineering, including building, optimizing, and maintaining scalable data pipelines, transformations, and analytical datasets. With our core data pipelines and datasets increasingly established, the role is expected to quickly expand into Data Science, statistical analysis, machine learning, and predictive modeling.

This is a Hybrid position based in Frisco, TX. We are only considering candidates within a commutable distance to the Frisco office. You will be required to be onsite on an as-needed basis; when not working onsite, you will work from your home office. We are not offering relocation assistance.

Position Details

About The Role

Design, build, optimize, and maintain scalable data pipelines and analytical datasets supporting analytics, machine learning, and AI use cases.
Build reliable data ingestion, transformation, and feature pipelines across large-scale product telemetry, customer, behavioral, feedback, and operational datasets.
Establish strong practices around data quality, observability, reliability, performance, and governance to ensure datasets are trusted and ready for analysis and modeling.
Use Python, SQL, Spark, and modern cloud data technologies to process, transform, analyze, and derive insights from large-scale datasets.
Analyze product telemetry, usage, behavioral, customer feedback, support, and operational datasets to identify trends, patterns, anomalies, friction points, and opportunities.
Develop meaningful features, metrics, cohorts, and customer segments that enable deeper understanding of customer behavior and product performance.
Progressively develop statistical and machine learning models to understand customer behavior, product usage, engagement, friction, and customer outcomes.
Apply techniques such as regression, classification, clustering, segmentation, anomaly detection, time-series analysis, forecasting, and predictive modeling based on the problem being solved.
Develop and test hypotheses using statistical analysis and experimentation to understand the factors driving customer and product outcomes.
Build predictive approaches that help identify emerging customer issues, behavioral changes, product friction, performance issues, and other signals before they become broader problems.
Apply NLP, embeddings, LLMs, and Generative AI where appropriate to extract insights from unstructured customer signals such as feedback, surveys, reviews, and support interactions.
Evaluate analytical and machine learning models using appropriate statistical and ML techniques and ensure conclusions are supported by the underlying data.
Partner closely with Engineering and Product teams to translate ambiguous customer and product questions into measurable data problems, analytical hypotheses, and actionable recommendations.
Move beyond dashboards and descriptive reporting by translating data into insights, predictions, recommendations, and measurable product outcomes.
Develop scalable approaches for operationalizing successful models against production datasets, including model monitoring and retraining where appropriate.
Measure whether insights and resulting product or engineering changes produce the expected impact, creating a continuous learning loop between data, insights, actions, and customer outcomes.

About You

5+ years hands-on experience in Data Engineering, with experience building and supporting scalable data pipelines, transformations, and analytical datasets.
Advanced proficiency in Python and SQL with experience working with large-scale structured and unstructured datasets.
Experience with data processing technologies such as Apache Spark and modern ETL/ELT frameworks.
Experience working with cloud data platforms and services in environments such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
Strong understanding of data modeling, data quality, data transformations, performance optimization, and building reliable analytical datasets.
Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset, with a demonstrated interest in moving beyond data engineering into Data Science, Machine Learning, and advanced analytics.
Working knowledge of statistics, probability, hypothesis testing, regression, classification, clustering, and predictive modeling.
Hands-on exposure to Data Science and ML libraries such as pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, XGBoost, TensorFlow, or PyTorch.
Ability to move from raw data → hypothesis → analysis/model → conclusion → recommendation → measurable outcome.
Exposure to behavioral analytics, anomaly detection, segmentation, forecasting, predictive analytics, or other applied Data Science techniques is highly desirable.
Familiarity with NLP, LLMs, embeddings, vector databases, RAG, and Generative AI for extracting insights from structured and unstructured datasets is beneficial.
Coursework, certification, specialization, or a degree in Data Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related discipline is preferred.
Demonstrated ability and motivation to rapidly develop deeper Data Science and Machine Learning expertise while continuing to apply strong Data Engineering fundamentals.
Ability to convert loosely defined product or customer questions into measurable analytical problems and communicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Company Overview

McAfee is a leader in personal security for consumers. Focused on protecting people, not just devices, McAfee consumer solutions adapt to users’ needs in an always online world, empowering them to live securely through integrated, intuitive solutions that protects their families and communities with the right security at the right moment.

We're serious about our commitment to diversity which is why McAfee prohibits discrimination based on race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation or any other legally protected status.
