jobs.description:
### **About Vital Lyfe**

Vital Lyfe is a tech company redefining water autonomy through innovation, creating a new category of personal water making technology built to scale where infrastructure can’t.

### **The Mission**

We’re looking for a Software Engineer to help build the software behind a high-demand consumer hardware product. We’re spinning up manufacturing from scratch, scaling fast, and the software you work on will directly affect how we build, track, and deliver thousands of units.

This is the first full-time hire on our software team. You’ll work directly with our Head of Software, take ownership of a substantial area of our backend and data systems, and contribute across the tools and infrastructure that power our operations and help us scale.

### **What You’ll Do**

* Build and maintain data pipelines that bring test and production data off the manufacturing line, validate and store it, and turn it into views our teams use to track yield and failures
* Build, extend, and maintain backend services and system integrations on our established cloud platform, keeping data reliable across the company
* Own what you build end to end: design, test, ship, debug, and keep it running in production
* Help shape design and implementation decisions that advance our technical roadmap
* Build and improve internal tools that give our engineering and operations teams real-time visibility into production and manufacturing workflows
* Contribute across the rest of our software, including our manufacturing execution system (MES) and the handheld app our floor teams use

Our stack includes TypeScript, Python, React, and AWS.

### **What We’re Looking For**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience
* 2 to 4 years building software professionally
* Experience building and maintaining backend services or APIs in production
* Strong programming fundamentals and comfort learning new systems quickly
* Deep experience with at least one modern language, such as Python or TypeScript
* Working knowledge of SQL and structured data
* Comfortable in a codebase you didn’t write, and able to debug problems on your own
* Practical and curious, with a habit of taking ownership and following through
* Able to break down a problem, work through it, and know when to ask for help
* Excited to work where software and hardware intersect

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience building data pipelines, including validating and cleaning messy real-world data
* Background in building user-facing interfaces with React or a similar frontend framework
* Experience with dashboards or data visualization tools
* Experience with AWS, especially serverless and infrastructure as code
* Experience with ERP, MES, or other manufacturing systems
* Interest in manufacturing, hardware-software integration, or IoT systems

### **Why Join Vital Lyfe?**

* Be the first full-time hire on a new software team, with a hand in shaping how the team works
* Work on high-impact problems with global relevance
* Help scale breakthrough technology in water security and climate resilience
* Early ownership in a high growth, engineering led startup
* Join a tight knit, mission driven team in a fast-paced environment
* Build long term career equity as we grow

Location Requirement: Ability to work 100% onsite in Torrance, CA (remote or hybrid work will not be considered)

Vital Lyfe is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with Vital Lyfe is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

Compensation Range: $120K - $150K

jobs.description:
**What Makes Us Stand Out:**

Granum is the leading software company devoted to serving landscapers and arborists across North America, providing intuitive, industry-specific solutions designed to help them improve and grow their businesses while impressing their customers. Granum brings together three of the most trusted software names in the industry — LMN, SingleOps, and Greenius — into one powerful software ecosystem. More than just a software company, Granum works alongside its clients to implement systems for estimating, scheduling, crew training, invoicing, and payments, blending technology with hands-on onboarding and human support. The company's mission is to help industry professionals unlock their potential and achieve their most important goals, all united by the belief that its clients' success is not just a milestone, but a shared mission.

As a team, we're on a mission to reshape an age-old industry, and we're looking for people who thrive on challenging and meaningful work. Our environment is highly collaborative, innovative, and supportive, with a shared commitment to having fun while making an impact. We live by our core values: **We Before Me, Bias to Act, The Extra 1%, Accountable to Outcomes, Unconditional Transparency, and Forgiveness**. If this resonates with you, we'd love to meet you and explore how you can help us build the future of the green industry!

Our culture and growth has been recognized with multiple awards, it's a great time to join!

* Comparably 2024 #23/100 Best (small/ medium sized companies) Leadership Teams
* Comparably 2024 #63/75 (small/ medium sized companies) Happiest Employees
* #9 Atlanta Business Chronicle's 2024 Best Places to Work (Our second year in a row!)
* #6 of Built In's 2024 Best Places to Work: Top 50 start-ups in Atlanta (Our second year in a row!)
* Inc Magazine's 2023 Best Places to Work
* Inc. 5000: #131 of 2024 Southeast Regional America's Fastest Growing Companies. (Our third year in a row!)
* Inc 5000 America's fastest-growing private companies (Our third year in a row!)
* Certified Great Place to Work Canada 2024

**The Role**

We're hiring a Software Engineer 3 (P3) for the LMN Estimates product pod. LMN is the platform our customers run their entire business on, with the Estimates pod focusing on how our customers create profitable and winning bids. You'll work in a pod of 2–4 engineers with a Product Manager, Designer, and Test Engineer, shipping to production continuously.

You will build and improve critical services end-to-end. You'll design, build, ship, and operate, partnering closely with the Product Manager and Designer to turn customer pain into shipped product. At Granum, we measure success by customer outcomes, not pull requests.

**Outcomes You'll Drive**

* Partner hand in hand with your PM and Designer to shape *what* gets built and how it gets built.
* Own critical services and make them noticeably more reliable, performant, and pleasant to work in.
* Build complex systems end-to-end.
* Make the engineers around you better with thoughtful reviews and clear documentation.
* Anticipate failure modes, build guardrails, and follow through on post-incident learnings.
  

**How We Work**

Our 2026 Engineering operating principles:

* Customer Focus: Every decision ladders back to "did this help the landscaper?"
* Shipping: Small changes, low risk, fast feedback; velocity *with* robust process.
* Efficiency: Every tool at our disposal, from AI agents to scripts, to make work repeatable.
* Simplicity: Start simple, prefer boring industry-standard tech.
* Get Good at AI: Every engineer is expected to use, improve, and help shape our AI-assisted development practices.
* Performance & Reliability: Clear, measurable bars for performance, uptime, and time-to-restore; regressions are first-class work.

  

Engineering always aligns with Product's operating principles — *Be the Partner, Raise the Bar, Big Vision Small Scope, Shipping is Discovery*. All of our engineers treat product partners as teammates.

  

**Tech Stack**

* Backend: C# / .NET, multi-tenant service architecture, Azure SQL Server, Azure Functions
* Frontend: Angular, TypeScript, Shared Component Libraries
* Agentic AI development: Internal orchestration layer that enhances Claude and Cursor across the dev lifecycle
* Cloud / Delivery: Azure, Terraform, Cloudflare, GitHub Actions, LaunchDarkly
* Observability: Datadog (APM, RUM, logs)

**Does this sound like you?**

* AI-forward in practice - you use coding assistants and agentic workflows today, can speak credibly about where AI helps and where it hurts, and are willing to grow adoption on the team.
* Strong communication and collaboration - clear writing, useful reviews, low ego in disagreements.
* Highly curious – you want to know how things work: our code, our company, and our customers.
* Systems thinking - you reason about latency, consistency, and scale trade-offs and write the design doc that aligns your pod on a hard call.
* ~4+ years of professional software engineering experience (depth of impact matters more than the number).
* Shippable experience with C#/.NET and Angular (or a closely related modern framework). Comfortable in Azure SQL Server and a modern cloud.
* Operational ownership - you're comfortable on-call, you instrument what you ship, and reliability is part of the feature.
* Values fit - you have bias to action, you're transparent about trade-offs, and you're accountable to outcomes.
* Eligibility - legally eligible to work in the US or Canada.

**A Few Ways to Stand Out**

* You've shipped AI-enabled features or engineering workflows and have opinions on guardrails and evaluation.
* You've worked in multi-tenant SaaS and know the operational realities.
* You love building real solutions for users collaboratively.

**What You'll Get From Us**

* A clear career track from P3 P4 P5 with concrete expectations for promotion to Senior and beyond.
* A small, focused engineering org

**About Extend:**

Extend is revolutionizing the post-purchase experience for retailers and their customers by providing merchants with AI-driven solutions that enhance customer satisfaction and drive revenue growth. Our comprehensive platform offers automated customer service handling, seamless returns/exchange management, end-to-end automated fulfillment, and product protection and shipping protection alongside Extend's best-in-class fraud detection. By integrating leading-edge technology with exceptional customer service, Extend empowers businesses to build trust and loyalty among consumers while reducing costs and increasing profits.

Today, Extend works with more than 1,000 leading merchant partners across industries, including fashion/apparel, cosmetics, furniture, jewelry, consumer electronics, auto parts, sports and fitness, and much more. Extend is backed by some of the most prominent technology investors in the industry, and our headquarters is in downtown San Francisco.

We are looking for an exceptional Software Engineer II to join the Extend Fulfillments team, a core pillar driving our company's growth and customer satisfaction. This role offers a unique opportunity to build impactful software used by some of the largest ECommerce and Brick and Mortar merchants in the industry, and directly influencing how our merchants make their customers whole.

You’ll partner closely with cross-functional teams in product, design, operations, delivery and the broader engineering organization - contributing significantly to a culture of innovation, continuous improvement, and excellence.

* Build and ship features across all aspects of fulfillment and servicing, including refunds, replacements, reverse logistics, and more, taking on ambiguous problems with growing independence.

* Communicate clearly with product, design, solutions, and other engineering teams so your work lines up with business goals.

#### **What We’re Looking For:**

* 4+ years of full-stack experience
* Hands-on experience building production systems on AWS, including serverless
* Demonstrated experience shipping AI/LLM features to production
* A solid grasp of API design, versioning, idempotency, and backwards compatibility — and why they matter where events drive money movement or fulfillment

**Expected Pay Range:** $140,000 - $160,000 per year salaried\*

Extend does not provide immigration-related sponsorship for this role.

**Life at Extend:**

* Competitive salary based on experience, with full medical and dental & vision benefits.

Mathnasium Careers

Software Developer

Software Developer

Help Us Build What's Next at Mathnasium

Applicants must be located in the Los Angeles metropolitan area.

At Mathnasium, we believe every child has the ability to succeed in math—and we're passionate about helping them get there. Through our personalized approach to math learning, we help children build confidence, develop critical thinking skills, and discover what they're capable of.

Behind that mission is a dedicated corporate team working to support our franchise network, strengthen our technology, and help Mathnasium continue to grow. We're looking for a Software Developer who wants to be part of that work.

If you enjoy solving problems, building useful solutions, exploring new technologies, and seeing your work make a real impact, this could be a great next step in your career.

The Opportunity

As a Software Developer at Mathnasium, you'll join a collaborative, hands-on engineering team where your contributions matter. You'll work on applications and services that support our business, deliver meaningful improvements to our users, and help shape how our technology evolves.

Our team works across a mature C# and ASP.NET Framework application and newer TypeScript services.

We're looking for someone with a solid foundation in software development who is ready to take the next step: owning meaningful work, growing their technical capabilities, and becoming more independent over time. You'll have support from an experienced team, opportunities to contribute ideas, and room to expand your responsibilities as your skills develop.

You don't need to know everything on day one. If you're strong in .NET and excited to learn more about AWS serverless development, automation, and AI-powered tools, we're ready to help you grow.

What You'll Work On

Build Features That Matter: Develop and enhance applications that support Mathnasium's business operations and customer needs using C#, ASP.NET MVC, Web API, and serverless TypeScript services.
Help Modernize Our Technology: Improve existing applications, reduce technical debt, and move functionality into modern services where it makes sense.
Make Releases Faster and Smarter: Help evolve our software delivery process from monthly releases to two-week releases and, ultimately, continuous deployment using GitHub Actions and related tools.
Explore Cloud Development: Build and support services using AWS Lambda, API Gateway, and other cloud technologies as you develop your serverless skills.
Automate and Improve Quality: Write automated tests, expand test coverage, and identify opportunities to eliminate repetitive work through better tooling and automation.
Work With Data: Build and maintain functionality that interacts with Microsoft SQL Server, Aurora SQL, and DynamoDB.
Explore What's Next in AI: Help evaluate emerging AI tools and experiment with AI-powered features and agentic workflows that could improve how we build software and support our business.
Keep Our Applications Running Well: Help troubleshoot production issues, improve monitoring and alerting, and address root causes to keep our systems reliable.
Learn and Collaborate: Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and documentation while sharing ideas and learning from teammates.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for a developer who brings technical fundamentals, curiosity, and a willingness to take ownership. You should be comfortable contributing independently while knowing when to ask questions, collaborate, and learn from others.

Required Qualifications

3+ years of professional software development experience.
Strong experience with C#, ASP.NET MVC or Web API, and object-oriented programming principles.
Experience with TypeScript or modern JavaScript, including Node.js, along with HTML and CSS.
Solid SQL skills and experience working with Microsoft SQL Server.
Hands-on experience with AWS or another cloud platform.
Experience working in an Agile development environment with Git/GitHub, code reviews, and automated testing.
Strong problem-solving skills, clear communication, and the ability to manage assigned work independently.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

Skills We'd Love to See

You don't need to check every box. We're interested in your foundation, your curiosity, and your ability to learn.

Experience with AWS serverless technologies, including Lambda, API Gateway, and DynamoDB.
Familiarity with infrastructure as code using Terraform and/or the Serverless Framework.
Experience with Aurora SQL.
Exposure to Amazon S3, Redis, or Valkey.
Experience designing REST APIs with Express, NestJS, or similar frameworks.
Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, particularly GitHub Actions, as well as Docker and monitoring tools such as Amazon CloudWatch.
Experience with LLM APIs, agent frameworks, or AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot or Claude.
Exposure to migrating .NET Framework applications to modern .NET or breaking functionality into independent services.

How You'll Grow Here

At Mathnasium, we want you to build more than features—we want you to build your skills and confidence as a developer.

You'll begin with clearly scoped projects, collaboration, and support from the team. As you become familiar with our systems and development practices, you'll have opportunities to take on more complex challenges, contribute to technical decisions, and own larger pieces of work.

You'll also have room to explore new tools and technologies. Our approach to AI-assisted development and agentic workflows is still evolving, and you'll have an opportunity to help evaluate tools, share ideas, and influence how we incorporate these capabilities into our engineering practices.

We're looking for someone who is eager to keep learning, comfortable with change, and excited to grow into greater technical ownership over time.

Our Technology Environment

Our engineering team works across established applications and evolving cloud-based services, including:

Application Development: C#, ASP.NET Framework, MVC, Web API, Node.js, and TypeScript
Cloud & Serverless: AWS Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, Aurora SQL, and Amazon S3
Data: Microsoft SQL Server and cloud-based databases
Development & Delivery: GitHub, GitHub Actions, automated testing, Terraform, and the Serverless Framework
Emerging Technology: AI coding assistants, LLM integrations, and agentic workflows

You won't be expected to master every technology before joining us. We value a strong technical foundation, adaptability, and the ability to learn new tools as our environment evolves.

Where You'll Work

This is a hybrid position based at Mathnasium's corporate headquarters in the Los Angeles metropolitan area.

Monday, Wednesday, and Thursday: Work onsite with the team at our headquarters.
Tuesday and Friday: Work from home.

We're looking for someone located in the Los Angeles metro area who can regularly collaborate with the team in person and participate in our hybrid work schedule.

Why Mathnasium?

Mathnasium is more than a network of learning centers. We're a team committed to helping children build confidence in math and develop skills that can serve them throughout their lives.

At our corporate headquarters, every department plays a part in supporting that mission. As a Software Developer, your work will help strengthen the systems, tools, and technology that support our business and franchise network.

You'll join a collaborative environment where your ideas matter, your contributions reach real users, and you can continue developing your skills while helping build what's next.

If you're ready to take ownership, solve meaningful problems, and grow alongside a supportive team, we'd love to hear from you.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. This role is part of Blue National Security (BNS), where our focus is the design, development, and delivery of launch and spacecraft systems for national security missions. This role is part of the Blue National Security unit and supports Blue Origin’s Quartz program. Quartz is building out a global network of Blue Origin owned and operated ground infrastructure. Quartz will be used by Blue Origin businesses and external customers providing reliable, flexible, and cost-effective communications services between Earth and space.

jobs.title: Engineering Tools & Design Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
The Opportunity

Join Hitachi Energy as an Engineering Tools & Design Automation Engineer and help transform the way transformer components are designed, configured, and delivered. In this role, you’ll serve as a key contributor to the development, maintenance, and continuous improvement of engineering configuration tools, design automation systems, and digital engineering processes supporting our North America Transformer Components business.

You’ll collaborate with engineering, manufacturing, product management, and IT teams to improve engineering efficiency, standardize design practices, and capture critical product knowledge in scalable digital solutions. Your work will directly support the design and manufacture of bushings, tap changers, fuses, switches, and other transformer components while enabling faster product development, greater consistency, and improved customer responsiveness.

This position offers a unique combination of engineering, software development, and continuous improvement responsibilities. Much of the role will focus on engineering tools and design automation, while also supporting Design to Value (DtV), product standardization, New Product Introduction (NPI), and continuous improvement initiatives that drive long-term business success.

How You’ll Make An Impact

Develop, maintain, and enhance engineering configurators, design automation tools, and digital engineering applications used across the transformer components portfolio.
Create and maintain product rules, calculations, configuration logic, engineering databases, templates, and automated workflows.
Collaborate with product experts to capture engineering knowledge and translate design requirements into scalable and maintainable digital solutions.
Improve engineering productivity through automation, standardization, digitalization, and process improvement initiatives.
Support the integration of engineering tools with CAD, PLM, ERP, and other enterprise systems.
Validate and test engineering applications to ensure accuracy, reliability, and alignment with product requirements.
Develop technical documentation, training materials, and user guides for engineering systems and processes.
Provide technical support and training to engineering teams utilizing design tools and configurators.
Support New Product Introduction (NPI) activities by deploying new products and engineering knowledge into configuration and automation systems.
Contribute to Design to Value (DtV) initiatives through product standardization, process optimization, and cost-reduction projects.
Drive continuous improvement of engineering processes, data quality, and design governance practices.
Stay current with emerging technologies in design automation, engineering software development, AI-enabled engineering tools, and digital engineering methodologies.
Support the development of long-term digital engineering roadmaps and best practices.
Responsible to ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines.

Your Background

Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
Experience developing, supporting, or enhancing engineering software tools, configurators, automation systems, or technical applications.
Experience working with CAD, PLM, ERP, product data management, or engineering configuration platforms.
Working knowledge of programming or scripting languages such as Python, C#, VBA, SQL, JavaScript, or similar technologies.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate engineering requirements into practical digital solutions.
Experience working with engineering calculations, product structures, configuration rules, technical specifications, or product development processes.
Ability to work effectively across engineering, manufacturing, IT, and business functions.
Strong communication and documentation skills.
Self-driven, collaborative, and results-oriented work style.
Preferred: experience with product configurators, design automation tools, CPQ systems, or rule-based engineering applications.
Preferred: experience with Creo, Windchill, SAP, or similar engineering platforms.
Preferred: experience supporting industrial products, power equipment, transformer components, or manufacturing environments.
Preferred: experience with Design to Value (DtV), Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, DFM/DFA, or continuous improvement methodologies.
Preferred: experience with database development, systems integration, reporting tools, or engineering data governance.

More About Us

We empower our people with opportunities to innovate, grow, and build expertise within a global engineering organization.
We invest in digital engineering capabilities that improve customer value, product quality, and operational performance.
We foster an inclusive, collaborative, and flexible work environment where diverse perspectives drive innovation.
We are committed to advancing a sustainable energy future by developing technologies that improve the reliability and efficiency of the world’s power infrastructure.

Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology.

jobs.description:
Embedded Software Engineer – Autonomous Vehicle Platform
Location: San Diego, CA
Schedule: Full-time, on-site
Compensation: $140,000–$165,000 + equity

About Our Client:

Our client is developing a universal, plug-and-play compute and vision platform for vehicles. Its mission is to bring advanced driver-assistance and connected-vehicle technology to the 1.5 billion cars already on the road—making them safer, smarter, and software-defined.

The company is moving from initial units toward mass production and needs a hands-on engineer to help design and build the systems that make that possible.

The Opportunity:

Our client is hiring its first Embedded Software Engineer to design, build, and own the embedded software architecture that powers its hardware platform—from drivers and middleware through CI/CD, OTA, and vehicle validation.

This is a greenfield, build-from-scratch role
: you'll be writing new embedded Linux drivers, architecting middleware services, and standing up the tools, test frameworks, and quality standards the company doesn't have yet, as it scales across multiple vehicle platforms. This is not a role for someone looking to maintain an existing codebase—you'll be creating the core systems from the ground up.

What You'll Do:

Architect and develop Embedded Linux drivers for UART, SPI, I2C, timers, LEDs, IMUs, CAN bus, and related peripherals
Design and build middleware services for OTA updates, diagnostics, and real-time data and video streaming
Design, build, and stand up CI/CD pipelines for embedded software builds, testing, artifact management, and releases—from scratch
Architect integration environments for embedded software, HIL systems, test benches, vehicles, and data logging
Build automated deployment systems across HIL, bench, production, and vehicle environments
Engineer system compatibility across multiple vehicle makes, models, ECUs, and CAN bus architectures
Design and build regression test frameworks for firmware, CAN interfaces, ADAS functions, and system releases
Build test harnesses, simulators, and automated validation frameworks from the ground up
Develop production flashing systems and processes to ensure every shipped device meets requirements
Engineer OTA update mechanisms for reliability, safety, rollback, and recovery
Lead root-cause analysis and architect long-term fixes for complex hardware/software defects
Define and build the quality metrics, release criteria, and system-level test plans this platform will run on
Partner with engineering and manufacturing to design quality into the product from the ground up
Use field performance data to drive new software, hardware, and process designs

What We're Looking For:

Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field
3+ years of experience developing embedded systems, platform software, or system integration solutions (not purely support/maintenance/QA)
Strong hands-on experience building software for Linux-based embedded systems
Experience developing, integrating, and debugging on Yocto-based Embedded Linux, Ubuntu, or Debian
Driver-level development experience with UART, SPI, I2C, timers, LEDs, IMUs, or similar I/O peripherals
Proficiency in C/C++ for embedded software development
Proficiency with Python, Bash, or similar scripting and automation tools
Experience designing and building CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms
Hands-on experience with CAN bus and tools such as CANalyzer, SavvyCAN, or SocketCAN
Strong hardware/software integration and debugging skills
Experience building bootloaders, flashing tools, firmware deployment, and OTA systems
Experience architecting and executing structured, multi-level test plans
Comfort building systems and tools from zero in a fast-moving startup environment

Nice to Have:

Automotive, Tier 1, retrofit, connected-vehicle, or ADAS experience
AI model integration and optimization on real-time embedded devices
Experience validating cameras, radar, IMUs, or other vehicle sensors
Experience building HIL systems, test rigs, or vehicle simulators
Familiarity with ISO 26262, ASPICE, or automotive safety standards
Experience with Git, Git LFS, Docker, and release-management tools
Knowledge of cloud microservices and connected-device architectures

Compensation and Benefits:

Base salary of $140,000–$165,000, depending on experience
Meaningful equity in a venture-backed automotive technology company
Medical, dental, and vision coverage
The chance to architect and build a platform from the ground up as it moves from prototype to mass production
Collaborative, mission-driven team based in San Diego

If you're excited about building Embedded Linux systems from scratch, architecting automotive software, and creating reliable technology at the intersection of hardware and software—not just keeping existing systems running—we'd like to hear from you.

jobs.description:
WE ARE HIRING!

Data Engineer II

About Us

At Lewis Energy Group, we are a vertically integrated exploration and production (E&P) company and a leading natural gas producer in South Texas and across the nation. With operations in South Texas and Mexico, we take pride in our long-standing commitment to excellence, innovation, and community engagement.

What sets us apart is our family-oriented work culture, built over decades of dedication and teamwork. This culture drives the passion we bring to our work and the positive impact we strive to make in the communities where we operate.

The Data Engineer II
will be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining the organization’s data platform on Microsoft Fabric. This includes developing data pipelines using Data Factory, Dataflows Gen2, and PySpark notebooks; writing and optimizing T-SQL. Assists with the migration of on-premises SQL Server databases and ETL/ELT processes to Fabric. Build semantic models that support Power BI reporting, ensuring data quality and governance, and managing changes through source control and deployment pipelines. Works closely with business users and stakeholders, communicating technical information in a clear and accessible way.

Data Pipeline Development

Design, build, and maintain data pielines in Microsoft Fabric using Data Factory pipelines, Dataflows Gen2, and notebooks to move data from source systems into Lakehouses and Warehouses.
Develop data transformation and processing logic in Python and Pyspark within Fabric notebooks, including working with Delta tables and handling large or complex datasets.
Develop and optimize T-SQL code, including stored procedures, views, and transformation logic, to support data processing and reporting needs.
Apply data modeling best practice, such as medallion architecture and star schema design, to organize data in OneLake for performance and ease of use.
Monitor pipeline runs, troubleshoot failures, and put alerting and error handling in place so that data is delivered on time and accurately.

SQL Server to Fabric Migration

Assess existing on-premises SQL Server databases, SSIS packages, and scheduled jobs to plan their migration to Microsoft Fabric.
Rebuild or refactor legacy ETL processes as Fabric-native pipelines and PySpark notebooks, improving performance and maintainability.
Coordinate with the team and stakeholders on migration timelines to minimize disruption to reporting and operations.

Semantic Model Support

Build and maintain semantic models that serve as the foundation for PowerBI reports, including relationships, measures, ontology, and Direct Lake or Import configurations.
Partner with report developers and business users to understand reporting requirements and turn them into well-structured datasets.
Tune data models and queries to improve report performance and refresh reliability.
Communicate technical concepts, data limitations, and project status clearly to non-technical stakeholders, helping them understand and make effective use of available data.

Data Quality, Governance, and Operations

Implement data quality checks and validation rules to catch issues before they reach end users.
Manage workspace organization, access permissions, and security settings in Fabric in line with company data governance standards.
Use source control (Azure DevOps/Git) and deployment pipelines to manage changes across development, test, and production environments.
Create and maintain clear documentation of data sources, pipelines, models, dictionaries, and business logic.

Education and Experience

Bachelor's degree from a four-year college or university; minimum two years of related experience and/or training; or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

Required Technical Skills

Demonstrated ability to design relational and dimensional data models, including fact and dimension tables, keys, relationships, referential integrity, and historical changes.
Strong T-SQL skills for complex joins, transformations, query tuning, and troubleshooting.
Hands-on experience building and supporting integrations across databases, APIs, or file-based sources, including scheduling, incremental processing, and recovery.
Ability to validate data completeness and accuracy, reconcile source and target results, and investigate duplicates and broken relationships.
Experience using Python or a comparable scripting language for data processing or automation, and version control for maintainable development.
Ability to translate business requirements into documented models and explain technical decisions clearly; willingness to learn unfamiliar platforms.

Preferred Experience (Preferred)

Power BI semantic models, Power Query, DAX, or comparable business intelligence tools.
Microsoft SQL Server, SSIS, SSAS, or comparable database and integration technologies.
Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake Storage, Azure SQL, Synapse Analytics, Databricks, or Azure DevOps.
Oil and gas production data, SCADA, telemetry, time-series data, IoT or Streaming data.

Your Benefits

Lewis Energy Group appreciates the hard work and dedication you bring to our team every day. To do our part, we are committed to keeping your benefits affordable and beneficial for you and your eligible family members. Lewis Energy Group strives to provide benefits that meet your needs, are easy to understand and use, and provide excellent value for affordable costs.

Retirement 401K with immediate matching contribution

jobs.description:
The Role

Pilot is hiring a Senior Software Engineer to join our Bookkeeping Automation team.

The team builds systems that transform financial data into accurate, reviewable bookkeeping at scale. Our work includes reconciliation tools, integrations with third-party financial systems, and the platform capabilities needed to operate deterministic automation and agent-assisted workflows safely and reliably in production.

As a Senior Software Engineer on the team, you'll own projects end to end – from shaping ambiguous problems and writing technical designs through implementation and rollout. You'll partner closely with engineers, product managers, designers, and bookkeeping experts to deliver systems that improve the accuracy, efficiency, and reliability of Pilot's bookkeeping workflows.

This is a strong fit for someone who enjoys solving complex automation problems. The work spans data matching and reconciliation, evaluation, auditability, and production observability.

Pilot's backend is written in fully typed Python, and our frontend stack includes JavaScript, TypeScript, and Vue.js. We use Terraform to manage infrastructure, deploy containerized services on AWS, and rely on Postgres and modern observability tooling in production.

Location: San Francisco, CA (3 days/week in office—Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays).

Key Responsibilities

Own projects end to end, from problem definition and technical design through implementation, rollout, and measurement
Build, test, and deploy well-structured, well-tested software continuously
Design reliable workflows across services, internal tools, and human operational processes
Build observability and evaluation into automation systems so teams can measure quality, investigate failures, and improve performance over time
Contribute to the security, auditability, and reliability of systems that handle sensitive financial data
Partner with Product Managers, Designers, and bookkeeping and operations experts to turn ambiguous problems into practical solutions
Investigate production issues, support the services you own, and address systemic reliability problems
Mentor and sponsor teammates and contribute to engineering standards through technical designs and thoughtful code reviews

About You

Even if you don't have experience with every part of our stack, we'd still love to talk.

We're looking for someone who has:

4+ years of experience as a software engineer
Strong software-engineering fundamentals and the ability to write clean, maintainable, well-tested code
Experience with Python in production
A track record of owning and shipping customer-facing or business-critical systems end to end
Experience designing, operating, and debugging reliable production systems
Strong product and systems judgment, especially in ambiguous or evolving problem spaces
Strong written, verbal, and technical communication skills and comfort working cross-functionally
Demonstrated ability to mentor and teach others

Nice to Have

Experience with fintech, accounting, or financial operations tooling
Experience integrating with third-party APIs and external systems
Experience with system security, permissions, or handling sensitive data

About Pilot

Pilot launched in 2017 to bring the back office into the modern era. Pilot provides small businesses with dedicated finance experts - which Pilot hires as full-time, U.S.-based employees - who learn the ins-and-outs of their business. Pilot integrates directly with the billing, banking, expense, and payroll systems customers already use. With a special blend of custom software and expert bookkeepers, Pilot delivers accurate, consistent bookkeeping and financial management and tax services that give entrepreneurs the freedom to focus on their business.

Pilot has over 3,000 customers and has raised over $170 million in financing from Sequoia, Index Ventures, Stripe, Bezos Expeditions, and Whale Rock. Our investors also include a long list of world-class entrepreneurs, including Patrick and John Collison, Drew Houston, and Diane Greene. Our most recent funding round doubled our valuation to $1.2 billion – Meet Fintech’s Newest Unicorn.

We invest in our employees’ development and happiness because our employees are the keys to our success and ensuring happy customers

All federal holidays are observed

jobs.description:
COMPANY SUMMARY

At Impyrian, our commitment to excellence, client-centric approach, and deep industry expertise set us apart. We strive to be a trusted partner for organizations seeking to embrace digital transformation, bolster cybersecurity, streamline operations, leverage advanced audio-visual technologies, drive successful engineering and construction projects, and harness the power of AI and robotics to stay ahead in today's dynamic business landscape.

Impyrian knows the most important factor in our success is the excellence of our personnel—if we take care of our people, our people take care of our clients. This philosophy helps ensure a work-life balance, competitive compensation and benefits, and opportunities for professional growth.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

Impyrian is seeking a Junior-Level Full Stack Developer to support the development, enhancement, and maintenance of enterprise applications. The role develops and supports Java-based applications using modern frameworks, relational databases, and automated testing tools in an Agile environment, collaborating with developers, technical leads, business analysts, and stakeholders.

Project Scope

The Enterprise Reference Data Service is the authoritative source of truth for geographical, regulatory, and operational reference data across U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP). The team is building and maintaining a centralized, auditable platform using Java/Spring Boot microservices, bitemporal PostgreSQL data models, Liquibase migrations, Apache Kafka event streaming, and accessible USWDS-compliant Angular interfaces.

Design, develop, and maintain RESTful APIs and microservices using Java and Spring Boot.

Build and optimize data access layers, entity mappings, and database interactions using Spring Data JPA and PostgreSQL.

Implement bitemporal data models supporting historical auditing, point-in-time retrieval, and preservation of historical records.

Develop asynchronous event publishers using Apache Kafka and Apache Avro schemas for reliable downstream message delivery.

Develop responsive, accessible single-page applications using Angular and TypeScript.

Analyze requirements with technical and functional stakeholders and translate business needs into technical solutions.

Maintain automated test suites using JUnit 5, Vitest, Playwright, or equivalent frameworks.

Write clean, efficient, maintainable, and documented code in accordance with software development best practices.

Troubleshoot defects, identify root causes, and implement effective solutions.

Participate in peer code reviews and improve application architecture, code quality, and development practices.

Use Google Gemini and AI-assisted development workflows to accelerate feature development, code reviews, refactoring, and test generation.

Participate in Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog refinement, and retrospectives.

Track development activities, defects, and user stories in Jira or similar tools.

Support releases, deployments, enhancements, and production maintenance.

Conduct live feature demonstrations and architectural walkthroughs covering APIs, the web portal, and Kafka event feeds for internal stakeholders, program leaders, and prospective downstream consumers.

Share technical guidance and knowledge with less experienced team members, as appropriate.

Perform other duties as assigned by the supervisor.

Required Qualifications

Education and Work Experience:

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, plus at least 3 years of relevant professional experience.

At least 3 years of experience developing and/or supporting Java applications.

Strong experience with Java frameworks, including Spring and Spring Boot.

Experience working in an Agile software development environment.

Experience using Jira or a similar issue-tracking and Agile development tool.

Experience developing applications integrated with relational databases such as Oracle or PostgreSQL.

Experience writing and maintaining automated unit tests using JUnit or a comparable framework.

Understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC), object-oriented programming, and modern software development practices.

Skills and Competencies:

Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.

Good written and verbal communication skills.

Ability to collaborate with developers, technical leads, business analysts, and other stakeholders.

Ability to write maintainable code, participate in code reviews, and support application releases and production maintenance.

Corporate Values Alignment:

Passionate - Demonstrates enthusiasm for the work, the company and client's mission, and the impact it has on others through dedication, team motivation, continuous learning, and ownership.

Selfless - Puts the needs of others, the team, and the company first through knowledge sharing, teamwork, inclusivity, and humility.

Trailblazer - Leads by example, fosters innovation, mentors others, and encourages experimentation.

Impactful - Strives to make a meaningful and measurable difference for the company, clients, and community, with a focus on results and continuous improvement.

Innovative - Thinks creatively, improves processes, and adopts technologies that drive business and client success.

Physical Requirements:

Ability to sit for extended periods while working at a desk or workstation.

Prolonged use of a computer and keyboard, including typing and using a mouse.

Frequent use of manual dexterity for computer-based work and detailed tasks.

Ability to walk or stand occasionally to attend meetings or move around the office.

Ability to maintain focus and attention to detail throughout the workday.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Overview

Beyond New Horizons, LLC (BNH) has an exciting opportunity for an Instrumentation, Data and Controls (ID&C) Software Engineer, supporting TOS II, at Arnold Air Force Base in Tullahoma, TN. The ID&C Software Engineer will be working as a member of an integrated team responsible for design, implementation and configuration management of system software associated with test support and data acquisition systems in an aerospace ground test environment.

Open to internal and external candidates.

This position requires occasional scheduled extended hours and/or weekend work to meet critical contractual requirements and occasional unscheduled night or weekend support in emergency situations.

Job Summary

The successful candidate will apply programming, design, configuration management, and testing skills to develop complex systems and applications to perform the above functions, while assisting in system/application deployment, installation, maintenance, and support.

Job Duties

Performance of work, generally within Software Engineering, involves the design, development and maintenance of data acquisition, data processing, data mining, and data storage systems developed and maintained at the AMSC.
Participate in one or more of the following:
Develop system requirements and design systems that are configurable and modifiable to interface with existing and future hardware and software
Design, develop and maintain software and systems to meet system requirements
Perform software testing and verification
Support software configuration management practices to ensure system integrity
Apply system security to meet Federal Information Assurance requirements
Support preparation of engineering studies and reports
Use modern design, development, testing, and configuration management tools for software systems

Participates in and fosters a work environment that is based upon openness, trust, communication, teamwork, empowerment, innovation, and satisfaction.

Perform other duties as required.

Scripting Languages: Bash, Shell, Batch and Powershell.
IDEs: CLion, PyCharm, and Xcode.
Operating Systems: Microsoft Windows, and Redhat Linux.

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, computer engineering or a related scientific discipline from an accredited college or university
L07: Minimum of 2 years of relevant experience.
L08: Minimum of 5 years of relevant experience.
Relevant work experience or college coursework in software engineering including design, coding, configuration control and maintenance will be considered for experience.
Must be able to obtain and maintain security clearance and the AEDC local area network.
Current U. S. Citizenship required.

Preferred Qualifications

B.S. degree or post-graduate coursework in a relevant field is preferred.
A strong aptitude for problem-solving and a demonstrated passion for learning new technologies.
Familiarity with Agile development methodologies (e.g. Scrum, Kanban) and concepts like sprints.
Experience programming real-time applications is a plus.
Experience or academic coursework in Graphical User Interface (GUI) development.
Experience or academic coursework creating software design documentation, including UML diagrams (e.g., class, sequence, or case diagrams).
CompTIA Security+ Certification, or higher-level security certification, is preferred.
Knowledge of The Software Development LifeCycle (SDLC).
Knowledge of Object-Oriented Programming concepts.
Knowledge of major industry or regulatory standards and design criteria pertinent to Instrumentation, Data, and Controls (ID&C) Software engineering discipline. Active DoD Security Clearance.

Competitive salaries

Paid time off (PTO) along with a federally recognized holiday schedule

Beyond New Horizons (BNH) is a fully populated joint venture of Astrion and Fluor Federal Services, Inc. formed to provide unmatched Test Operations and Sustainment services for the Arnold Engineering Development Complex.

We chose our name to serve as an enduring reminder of our commitment to AEDC’s rich aerospace research and development legacy anchored in AEDC’s Toward New Horizons founding study and the unprecedented opportunities to greatly expand AEDC’s capabilities and capacity Beyond those existing today. Leveraging the capabilities of our parent companies, BNH specializes in testing and evaluation for military and space systems combined with proven capability in large-scale Government program management, integration, engineering, and construction services for specialized and technically advanced high-hazard facilities.

Enterprise Architecture Is An Organization Within The Chief Technology Office At American Express And It Is a Key Enabler Of The Company’s Technology Strategy. The Four Pillars Of Enterprise Architecture Include

Architecture as Code: this pillar owns and operates foundational technologies that are leveraged by engineering teams across the enterprise.
Architecture as Design: this pillar includes the solution and technical design for transformation programs and business critical projects which need architectural guidance and support.
Governance: this pillar is responsible for defining technical standards, and developing innovative tools that automate controls to ensure compliance.
Colleague Enablement: this pillar is focused on colleague development, recognition, training, and enterprise outreach.

Responsibilities

Design, develop, and deliver scalable, high-quality software solutions across the full stack, leveraging Java and Python for enterprise-grade platforms and services
Lead the architecture and implementation of distributed systems, ensuring performance, reliability, and maintainability
Own end-to-end delivery of features—from design and development to deployment, monitoring, and support in production environments
Act as a senior member of an Agile team, driving best practices in coding standards, testing, documentation, and continuous delivery
Mentor and guide junior engineers, providing technical leadership through code reviews, design discussions, and knowledge sharing
Collaborate closely with architects, product managers, and cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions
Build and evolve RESTful APIs, microservices, and event-driven systems, ensuring strong service contracts and backward compatibility
Champion engineering excellence by improving CI/CD pipelines, test automation, and developer productivity
Proactively identify system bottlenecks, debug complex issues, and drive root-cause analysis with long-term fixes
Design systems for scalability, resilience, and observability, including monitoring, logging, and alerting strategies
Contribute to cloud-native adoption, including containerization, infrastructure-as-code, and auto-scaling architectures
Influence technical direction and challenge the status quo by proposing innovative, pragmatic solutions
Take ownership and accountability for delivering high-impact outcomes aligned with team and organizational goals

6+ years of professional software development experience with strong expertise in Java and working knowledge of Python for backend or data-driven applications
Deep experience with Java ecosystems and frameworks such as Spring, Spring Boot, or equivalent
Proven experience in full-stack development, including backend services and modern frontend frameworks (e.g., React, Angular, or similar)

Experience with API design standards, OpenAPI/Swagger, versioning, and contract-driven development

Proficiency in Agile/Scrum methodologies and modern software development lifecycle practices

Job Description

About Enterprise Architecture:

Enterprise Architecture Is An Organization Within The Chief Technology Office At American Express And It Is a Key Enabler Of The Company’s Technology Strategy. The Four Pillars Of Enterprise Architecture Include

Architecture as Code: this pillar owns and operates foundational technologies that are leveraged by engineering teams across the enterprise.
Architecture as Design: this pillar includes the solution and technical design for transformation programs and business critical projects which need architectural guidance and support.
Governance: this pillar is responsible for defining technical standards, and developing innovative tools that automate controls to ensure compliance.
Colleague Enablement: this pillar is focused on colleague development, recognition, training, and enterprise outreach.

Responsibilities

Design, develop, and deliver scalable, high-quality software solutions across the full stack, leveraging Java and Python for enterprise-grade platforms and services
Lead the architecture and implementation of distributed systems, ensuring performance, reliability, and maintainability
Own end-to-end delivery of features—from design and development to deployment, monitoring, and support in production environments
Act as a senior member of an Agile team, driving best practices in coding standards, testing, documentation, and continuous delivery
Mentor and guide junior engineers, providing technical leadership through code reviews, design discussions, and knowledge sharing
Collaborate closely with architects, product managers, and cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions
Build and evolve RESTful APIs, microservices, and event-driven systems, ensuring strong service contracts and backward compatibility
Champion engineering excellence by improving CI/CD pipelines, test automation, and developer productivity
Proactively identify system bottlenecks, debug complex issues, and drive root-cause analysis with long-term fixes
Design systems for scalability, resilience, and observability, including monitoring, logging, and alerting strategies
Contribute to cloud-native adoption, including containerization, infrastructure-as-code, and auto-scaling architectures
Influence technical direction and challenge the status quo by proposing innovative, pragmatic solutions
Take ownership and accountability for delivering high-impact outcomes aligned with team and organizational goals

Qualifications

6+ years of professional software development experience with strong expertise in Java and working knowledge of Python for backend or data-driven applications
Deep experience with Java ecosystems and frameworks such as Spring, Spring Boot, or equivalent
Proven experience in full-stack development, including backend services and modern frontend frameworks (e.g., React, Angular, or similar)
Strong experience building RESTful APIs, microservices architectures, and service-to-service integrations
Solid understanding of distributed systems, concurrency, scalability, and performance optimization
Hands-on experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle) and/or NoSQL databases (Cassandra, DynamoDB, MongoDB)
Experience with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes)

Preferred: Basic understanding of AI/ML concepts and Generative AI technologies, including LLMs, prompt engineering, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
Experience with API design standards, OpenAPI/Swagger, versioning, and contract-driven development
Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines and tools (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, etc.)
Proficiency in Agile/Scrum methodologies and modern software development lifecycle practices
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience (advanced degree is a plus)

jobs.title: Associate Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Build digital health products that improve millions of lives.

As an Associate Software Engineer
, you'll help create modern digital health experiences that support patients and healthcare providers around the world. You'll join a collaborative engineering team building cloud-native applications and services that power customer-facing healthcare products and platforms. Working alongside engineers, product managers, designers, and cross-functional partners, you'll turn real-world problems into software that is reliable, secure, scalable, and meaningful.

This is an opportunity for someone who is curious, adaptable, and excited by the future of software engineering. We are looking for engineers who want to understand the problem behind the code, take ownership of outcomes, and explore how AI is transforming the way software is designed, built, tested, and operated. If you're eager to learn, enjoy experimenting with new ideas, and want your work to have a direct impact on customers, we'd love to hear from you.

What You'll Do

Design, build, test, deploy, and operate reliable, secure, and scalable cloud-native applications and services.
Contribute to features from idea through production, helping solve real customer problems and measuring outcomes after release.
Use AI-assisted development tools and coding agents to support development, testing, debugging, documentation, code review, and learning.
Experiment with emerging AI-enabled engineering workflows and share learnings with teammates.
Develop clean, maintainable software and APIs using modern engineering practices.
Build applications with performance, security, privacy, reliability, and scalability in mind.
Participate in technical design and architecture discussions while learning from experienced engineers.
Collaborate with Product, UX, Quality, Security, and Engineering teams to deliver practical customer-focused solutions.
Use data, telemetry, and customer feedback to improve products and software experiences.
Identify opportunities to automate repetitive work, simplify systems, and improve developer productivity.
Participate in code reviews, automated testing, deployments, production support, and incident learning activities.
Continuously learn new technologies and contribute ideas that improve how the team works.

What You Bring

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
2+ years of software development experience.
Strong programming fundamentals and experience with at least one modern programming language.
Understanding of APIs, testing, version control, debugging, and core software engineering principles.
Ability to collaborate effectively, communicate technical ideas, and learn from feedback.
Curiosity, adaptability, and a willingness to learn new technologies.
Ownership mindset with a genuine interest in understanding customer and business problems.
Interest in AI-assisted software engineering and how emerging tools can improve software development.

Nice to Have

Experience with AWS or another cloud platform.
Familiarity with Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, Java, Kotlin, Swift, or similar languages.
Experience using AI coding tools or agents such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or similar technologies.
Exposure to APIs, automated testing, CI/CD, or modern software delivery practices.
Interest in AI, automation, and emerging technologies.

What Sets You Apart

Product Curiosity: You want to understand the customer problem and business outcome, not just the technical requirements.
Growth Mindset: You actively seek feedback, embrace new ideas, and continually look for opportunities to learn.
Ownership: You take responsibility for outcomes and follow through on commitments from start to finish.
Experimentation: You enjoy testing new approaches, learning from results, and sharing insights with others.
Adaptability: You stay open to changing technologies, evolving ways of working, and new challenges.
Collaboration: You build strong relationships, contribute positively to team discussions, and support those around you.

Why Join Resmed

At Resmed, our mission is to improve lives through better health technology. You'll be part of a team developing products that help people live healthier, higher-quality lives while working at the intersection of healthcare, cloud technology, and AI.

You'll join an environment that values curiosity, learning, and innovation. We encourage engineers to explore emerging technologies, challenge assumptions, and find better ways to solve problems. You'll have the opportunity to work on meaningful products, collaborate with talented colleagues, and contribute to technology that makes a real difference for customers around the world.

If you don't meet every requirement listed above but believe you could be a great fit for this role, we encourage you to apply. We know that talent, potential, and perspective come in many forms, and we'd love to hear your story.

We are shaping the future at Resmed, and we recognize the need to build on and broaden our existing skills and continue to attract and retain the world’s best talent. We work hard to offer holistic benefits packages, provide flexible work arrangements, cultivate a workforce culture that allows employees to grow personally and professionally, and deliver competitive salaries to our team members. Employees scheduled to work 30 or more hours per week are eligible for benefits. This position qualifies for the following benefits package: comprehensive medical, vision, dental, and life, AD&D, short-term and long-term disability insurance, sleep care management, Health Savings Account (HSA), Flexible Spending Account (FSA), commuter benefits, 401(k), Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP), Employee Assistance Program (EAP), and tuition assistance. Employees receive Flexible Time Off (FTO), 11 paid holidays plus 3 floating days and are eligible for 14 weeks of primary caregiver or two weeks of secondary caregiver leave when welcoming new family members.

Individual pay decisions are based on a variety of factors, such as the candidate’s geographic work location, relevant qualifications, work experience, and skills.

At Resmed, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range for this position is: $90,000 - $113,000 USD.

Joining us is more than saying “yes” to making the world a healthier place. It’s discovering a career that’s challenging, supportive and inspiring. Where a culture driven by excellence helps you not only meet your goals, but also create new ones. We focus on creating a diverse and inclusive culture, encouraging individual expression in the workplace and thrive on the innovative ideas this generates. If this sounds like the workplace for you, apply now! We commit to respond to every applicant.

jobs.title: Full Stack Software Engineer (MERN)
jobs.description:
As part of the Reailize and B-Yond group, you’ll be joining a team that is redefining how technology powers businesses worldwide. We combine global expertise in AI, automation, and network transformation with a culture that values innovation, creativity, and impact. Here, you’ll have the opportunity to work on groundbreaking projects, grow your skills, and be part of a group that’s shaping the future of technology.

About The Role

We are looking for a Full Stack Software Engineer to join our DevOps team to primarily design, develop and test applications for internal software systems. You will work with the customer’s industry leading automation and technology Subject Matter Experts for the 5G core network to automate deployment and upgrades of 5G Core Network Functions. You will be working with state-of-the-art technology in containerized applications, Azure, CI/CD, workflow engines and software. These systems automate the process of capturing customer’s mobility services design, and network design to aid in the planning, design, deployment, configuration, and management of the network functions that are part of each service definition.

This opportunity requires onsite presence twice a week out of any of these locations

:

Texas: Austin, Dallas, Plano
New Jersey: Middletown, Bedminster
Georgia: Lenox/Atlanta, Alpharetta
Washington: Bothell, Redmond

Responsibilities

Design, develop, and maintain full-stack web applications using the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express.js, React, Node.js)
Build and maintain scalable, secure, high-performance RESTful APIs and backend services.
Develop responsive, reusable UI components in React, emphasizing usability and maintainability.
Design and optimize MongoDB data models, indexes, and queries to support application performance and scalability.
Collaborate with product managers, designers, and engineers to translate business requirements into well-scoped technical solutions.
Ensure high-quality deliverables through testing, code reviews, performance tuning, and security best practices.
Integrate and maintain third-party APIs and internal services.
Troubleshoot and resolve issues across the stack (frontend, backend, database, CI/CD).
Contribute to technical documentation, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement.
Participate in Agile ceremonies (planning, standups, retrospectives) and deliver iteratively.

Required Qualifications

Proven experience building production web applications using the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express.js, React, Node.js)
Strong JavaScript fundamentals (ES6+), including writing clean, modern, maintainable code.
Solid experience designing and implementing RESTful APIs using Node.js + Express.js.
Strong React skills including hooks, component architecture, and practical state management patterns.
Working knowledge of TypeScript (able to read/write TS in a React/Node codebase).
Experience integrating backend services with MongoDB (schemas, query optimization, indexing).
Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines, including Azure DevOps (ADO) YAML pipelines for React/Node services.
Strong troubleshooting and debugging skills; able to quickly read and improve existing code.
Strong understanding of authentication/authorization (e.g., JWT, OAuth/OIDC) and secure API patterns.
Proficiency with Git and collaborative workflows (PRs, reviews, branching strategies).
Familiarity with cloud fundamentals—especially Azure concepts relevant to deploying and operating web services.
Ability to work effectively in an Agile, cross-functional environment with strong ownership and communication.

Nice To Have

Experience with Next.js or other React frameworks.
Experience with one or more React state libraries (Redux, Zustand, etc.)
Experience with Docker and container-based workflows.
Deeper experience with DevOps tooling beyond pipelines (infra-as-code, monitoring/observability, release automation).
Experience with workflow/BPM engines (e.g., Camunda (BPMN)) or similar orchestration platforms (including Pronghorn).
Experience with alternative clouds (AWS/GCP) in addition to Azure.

Don’t meet every requirement?

Studies show that many qualified candidates, especially women and underrepresented groups may hesitate to apply unless they meet 100% of the criteria. If you meet around 50% of the requirements and are excited about this role, we strongly encourage you to apply. We value potential, learning ability, and diverse perspectives as much as direct experience.

Interview Integrity

During the interview process, we're evaluating your individual problem-solving skills, creativity, and approach to challenges. While AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude, and Cursor are part of your daily toolkit once you join B-Yond, all interviews, assessments, and take-home assignments must be completed independently.

You may not use AI tools, third-party services, coaching platforms, or content-farming services during any part of the interview process unless we explicitly permit it. We will clearly communicate when AI tools are allowed for specific assessments.

Any indication of third-party assistance or AI-generated responses will result in immediate disqualification.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Platform Engineering
jobs.description:
Digital Health Technology team powers digital experiences and engagement to enhance the lives of millions of people every day through connected care. We build, deliver and manage a portfolio of data management platforms and mobile offerings in support of our core businesses. We thrive on simple and elegant architecture and agility. You’ll be immersed in a dynamic high-growth environment and empowered to excel, take informed risks, and drive ingenuity across the enterprise.

This is a remote
position, however, the candidate must live in San Diego, CA or surrounding areas.

Our mission is to empower ResMed's developer community with an opinionated, yet empathetic developer experience that avoids surprise, is a joy to use, and abstracts the complexities of modern development to accelerate the pace of ResMed’s next generation Healthcare Informatics platform.

As a Software Engineer, you must possess world class technical skills and a strong sense of empathy for your fellow developers. You will work closely with other talented engineers, architects and stakeholders to architect, implement, and deliver on our roadmap.

Microsoft Entity Framework

N/A

Job Description:

Software Engineer III - Robotics

Redmond, WA
(Hybrid - 3 days in-person)

Join our team at Genie and embark on an exciting opportunity as we seek a skilled and dedicated senior robotics engineer to contribute to the software controls systems team.

At Genie we believe in fostering a vibrant and inclusive work culture where every person is empowered to thrive. We’re dedicated to driving quality, innovation, embracing diversity, and creating an environment where everyone feels valued and respected. We’re committed to excellence in everything we do, and we’re seeking talented individuals who share our passion and values to join our team.

In this Software Engineer III role, you will own significant technical deliverables and drive implementation of control systems for Genie’s equipment. You will collaborate across multidisciplinary teams to develop scalable, real-time solutions for industrial applications. This role requires strong expertise in robotics, control theory, and embedded systems.

What You'll Do

Vehicle Control Development

Contribute to the design and implementation of the vehicle control architecture.
Implement logic on the central high-performance embedded computer running Linux and distributed real-time microcontrollers.

ROS2 Control Implementation

Implement ros2_control hardware interfaces that abstract complex custom hardware into standard interfaces.
Develop firmware and drivers to interface ROS2 with low-level custom hardware boards via:
CAN-FD (J1939 / CANopen)
I2C
SPI
UART

Algorithm Design

Design and tune closed-loop control algorithms (PID, MPC, LQR) to manage vehicle dynamics.
Actuate multi-DOF systems with precision and implement controllers within ROS2.

Hardware Interface, Sensor Fusion & Instrumentation

Integrate sensors including IMUs, encoders, LiDAR, GPS, and pressure transducers.
Create accurate vehicle state estimates through sensor fusion.

Hydraulic Systems Control

Model and control complex non-linear hydraulic systems (valves, pumps, cylinders).
Convert digital control commands into fluid power actions.

What You'll Bring

Required Qualifications:

Education: BS or MS in Robotics, Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, or similar field.
Control Theory Expertise: Strong understanding of classical and modern control theory, including vehicle kinematics and dynamics.
ROS2 Experience: Proven experience with ROS2, particularly ros2_control, hardware interfaces, and node lifecycle management.
Embedded Systems Experience: Experience contributing to distributed control architectures for mobile robots, automotive systems, or heavy machinery.
Embedded Protocols: Hands-on experience with:
CAN bus (J1939 or CANopen)
I2C
SPI
RS485

C/C++ Proficiency: Strong real-time C++ skills (C++20/23) for constrained embedded environments.

Preferred Qualifications (Highly Desirable)
:

Hydraulics Experience: Electro-hydraulic control experience in heavy machinery, agriculture, or construction equipment.
Safety-Critical Systems: Knowledge of functional safety standards or safety-critical RTOS implementations.
Simulation: Experience with URDF and simulators such as Gazebo or Isaac Sim.
Microcontrollers: Experience with real-time microcontrollers and application processors, including Yocto Linux.

Salary
: The salary for this role is $135k - 165k. The salary range will vary based on relevant experience. All eligible Team Members will be offered health insurance (medical, dental, vision, Rx), life insurance, accidental death & dismemberment (AD&D), short-term and long-term disability, extended leave options, paid time off, company holidays, 401k matching, employee stock purchase plan, legal assistance, wellness programs, tuition reimbursement and discount programs.

Why Join Us

Tangible Impact: Your work will directly control multi-ton industrial machinery in the real world.
Growth Opportunity: Work alongside experienced engineers on challenging robotics problems.
We are a global company, and our culture is defined by our Values — Integrity, Respect, Improvement, Servant Leadership, Courage, and Citizenship. Check out this video! The Terex purpose

Our top priority is creating an inclusive environment where every team member feels safe, supported, and valued.

We are committed to helping team members reach their full potential.
Through innovation and collaboration, our vision remains forward-looking, and we aim to be a catalyst for change, inspiring others to build a better world for generations.
