jobs.description:
**ABOUT ROCKET LAB**

Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity's reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us.

**SOFTWARE ENGINEER II - PRODUCTION AUTOMATION**

Based onsite at our global headquarters in Long Beach, CA, the Software Engineer will join the Production Automation team where you will work with a supportive, international team of software developers with diverse engineering backgrounds. A typical day consists of collaborating with avionics and manufacturing engineers to develop, improve and support software-applications to functionally test spacecraft-components and systems for our launch vehicles (Electron, Neutron) and Space-System programs. You will work closely with our stakeholders during both the development phase of new components and when those components move to a production line. Our team is involved in the test rig bring-up process and rig maintenance and assists the engineering teams with evaluating test result data.

We're after developers willing to take on new challenges. Even if you don't have our tech stack fully covered, we'd still want to hear from you!

**WHAT YOU'LL GET TO DO:**

* Develop, improve, and support software applications for production automation, including avionics production acceptance testing, vehicle component acceptance testing, and vehicle integrated systems testing.
* Integrate computerized production systems and support software applications within a production environment.
* Develop software and unit tests according to bug-fix and feature requests.
* Create and maintain documentation for the operation of software products.
* Participate in code reviews and facilitate software architecture meetings.
* Document software architecture designs and refine product backlog items.
* Facilitate and participate in agile activities (e.g., stand-ups, retrospectives) and keep tickets up-to-date.
* Actively interact with stakeholders to investigate issues, understand requirements, and drive solutions.
* Deploy operational software and ensure adherence to business processes.
* Take ownership of tasks and projects, delivering results and driving solutions.
* Support cross-functional teams and proactively acquire necessary knowledge to assist other groups.
* Domestic and international travel may be required.
* Perform additional duties as reasonably required.

**YOU'LL BRING THESE QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or Software/Electrical/Mechatronics Engineering (4+ years of work experience will be considered in lieu of a degree).
* 2+ years of experience within a software engineering related discipline.
* Experience working with source control and issue trackers (e.g., git, jira, redmine).

**THESE QUALIFICATIONS WOULD BE NICE TO HAVE:**

* Experience with Python, C++, or similar programming languages.
* Experience working in a Linux development environment.
* Experience working with different interfaces/protocols (e.g., TCP/UDP, serial, CAN).
* Experience with embedded systems and basic electronics.
* UI/UX development experience.
* Experience in a manufacturing or production environment.
* Experience using Qt or PyQt.
* Ability to apply and identify engineering and industry concepts and theories.
* Able to research and provide solutions to engineering challenges.

*This position may require prolonged periods of sitting, standing, walking, computer work, and occasional exposure to moderate levels of noise, dust, and fumes in production areas.*

**WHAT TO EXPECT**

We're on a mission to unlock the potential of space to improve life on Earth, but that's not an easy task. It takes hard work, determination, relentless innovation, teamwork, grit, and an unwavering commitment to achieving what others often deem impossible. Our people out-think, out-work, and out-pace. We pride ourselves on having each other's backs, checking our egos at the door, and rolling up our sleeves on all tasks big and small. We thrive under pressure, work to tight deadlines, and our focus is always on how we can deliver, rather than dwelling on the challenges that stand in the way.

About Us

Fashion Nova is the world’s leading trend-to-market fashion and lifestyle brand with high-growth categories across its Women, Men, Kids and Beauty divisions. Renowned for delivering the most-wanted styles to millions worldwide, Fashion Nova earned the title of the Top 5 Most-Searched Fashion Brand on Google in 2022, alongside Louis Vuitton and Nike.

Founder & CEO Richard Saghian launched the brand in 2006, from a retail location in Los Angeles. After multiple store openings, Saghian launched the e-commerce website for Fashion Nova in 2013, pioneering a disruptive social commerce model of affordable, on-trend, size-inclusive clothing online– powered by an innovative, social media-first marketing strategy.

Today, Fashion Nova has amassed over 40 million social media followers, with annual sales of approximately $2 billion!

The brand’s name has been featured in chart-topping hit songs by Cardi B, Drake, 21 Savage, Saweetie, The Game, Tyga and Offset and its styles have been worn by many celebrities, artists and athletes including Meg The Stallion, Ice Spice, Chris Brown, Floyd Mayweather, Rick Ross, Kourtney Kardashian, and Kylie Jenner.

with strong React Native

Experience building testable, maintainable codebases and APIs
Solid understanding of third-party dependencies and conflict resolution

We are, and we seek to maintain, a diverse workforce to match a diverse county.

Develop and build software systems components, Web APIs and Services.
Understand existing design patterns in the software and follow existing code in implementing new features.
Contribute to front end design using TypeScript, SASS, Bootstrap and with backend development.
Troubleshoot front-end software issues using browser debugging and monitoring tools.
Build intermediate level SQL queries, Stored Procedures, and help generate reports.
Maintain scheduled tasks on the server and scheduled jobs on the database.
Add intermediate level features into software systems.
Ensure software features continue to work properly after maintenance and testing.
Investigate and resolve software errors in the application using various troubleshooting tools.
Troubleshoot software issues that may arise in the development and testing environment.
Work closely with department representatives in the development of software programming applications and testing of new features.
Maintain software configurations, library publishing packages, NuGet packages and repositories.

Minimum Qualifications

Education:
Graduation from an accredited college or university with a bachelor's degree in computer science,computer/software engineering, information technology, or related technical fields. Applicants who have completed atleast three years of college education (90 semester units or 135 quarter units) in one of the mentioned fields maysubstitute additional qualifying experience in system analysis, software programming, or software engineering for theremaining required education on the basis of one year of relevant, full-time experience equaling 30 semester units or 45quarter units of education.

Experience:
Two years of software engineering in web front end and backend development. Experience must be recent and continuous including hands-on experience in a diverse array of programming languages such as .Net Core, C++, C#, TypeScript, SQL and frameworks including NodeJS, Angular. Additionally, proficiency in essential technologies such as SASS, Bootstrap, Web API, Shared Libraries, MSSQL, T-SQL, and Stored Procedures is required. Intermediate level experience in DevOps is preferred.

Knowledge of:
The principles, methods, and techniques in software engineering in web front end and backend development; data structures; algorithm analysis; computer organization and architecture; compiler (front-end parser); relational databases; operating systems; backend development in an object-oriented language; automata and formal languages or computational theory; systems configurations, library publishing packages, NuGet packages and repositories; networking or distributed computing; source control and NuGet packages.

Ability to:
Build user friendly software systems; employ a systematic and structured approach to software engineering; monitor and troubleshoot software errors; communicate technical details clearly and succinctly; take initiatives to learn new technologies; understand technical requirements and follow detailed technical instructions; work in a fast paced but flexible environment; collaborate and work as part of a team.

Code that saves lives.

As a partner to all of the major automobile manufacturers, as well as key players in the aerospace and industrial sectors, we offer you many development opportunities.

Your Key Responsibilities

DevOps Engineer to builds and owns the Continuous Integration / Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) and test-automation infrastructure for our embedded motor-control products. You'll partner with firmware and hardware engineers to turn a largely manual build-and-test process into fast, repeatable, automated pipelines — from commit to validated firmware image.

Design, build, and maintain CI/CD pipelines for embedded firmware (build, static analysis, unit test, integration test, artifact management, and release).
Automate the build toolchain for cross-compiled embedded targets and keep builds reproducible across developer machines and CI runners.
Stand up and maintain test-automation infrastructure, including unit testing, and hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) test rigs where applicable.
Integrate static analysis, code-quality, and coverage tooling into the pipeline and make results visible to the team.
Manage artifact versioning, release packaging, and traceability from source to deployed firmware.
Improve build and test speed, reliability, and developer feedback loops.
Document the pipeline and test infrastructure so the team can use and extend it.
Collaborate with firmware engineers to make code testable and to triage pipeline/test failures.

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering or related engineering field, with 3+ years experince in Embedded Software Devlopment.
Proven experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or similar).

jobs.description:
Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn’t work together.

So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.

Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We’re building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.

The Role

You will join the Recon and Reporting team, which owns our post-transaction systems: the platform responsible for reconciling money, tracing the end-to-end flow of funds, and meeting our tax and regulatory reporting obligations to merchants, customers, and authorities worldwide. Reconciliation and financial reporting are essential to running a payments business, and given our transaction volume, the projects you own will have direct, measurable impact on financial accuracy and trust.

You will help build and operate the systems that ingest and integrate global card-network settlement and report files (Visa, Mastercard, and equivalents), along with data from acquirers, processors, and banks, and reconcile them against internal payment data to power settlement, dispute, cost, tax, and regulatory reporting. You will own well-scoped projects within this platform end-to-end, with guidance from more experienced engineers. Our vision is to make reconciliation and reporting accurate, automated, and near real-time.

You Will

Own small, well-bounded projects end-to-end with guidance available: clarify requirements, design, build, test, ship, and follow up.
Build and maintain features within the ingestion and reconciliation pipelines that match card-network and partner reports against internal transaction data.
Contribute to tooling that provides end-to-end traceability of money throughout the system.
Develop features for reporting and reconciliation products that are accurate, reliable, timely, scalable, and user-friendly for both internal finance teams and external merchants.
Produce standardized journals and summaries that feed downstream accounting, audit, and analysis.
Contribute to our large-scale tax and regulatory reporting systems, including US IRS information returns (the 1099 family, issued at the scale of tens of millions of forms annually to merchants and customers) and international regimes such as EU-wide CESOP and country-specific reporting for Australia, Ireland, and Spain.
Support broader regulatory and compliance obligations (AML, KYC, and similar), with careful handling of sensitive and PII data, including TIN validation and secure form generation and filing.
Validate your work before calling it done, using code review, tests, small experiments, or usage signals, including for AI-assisted changes.
Take agency in debugging and escalating production issues across services, giving the team clear context on what changed, when it changed, how it changed, and what risk remains.
Collaborate with engineers, product managers, data analysts, and finance, tax, and compliance partners, contributing to technical design and product decisions that shape feature outcomes.
Review peers' work, apply their feedback to your own, and document learnings, including AI workflows the team can reuse.
Opportunistically improve the systems you touch when it fits your project scope, replacing manual and redundant work with automation, and route larger issues to the right owner.

You Have

3+ years of professional software or data engineering experience.
A Bachelor's degree in a technical field (Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or similar) or equivalent technical experience.
Experience building or maintaining batch- or event-driven data pipelines, with exposure to workflow-orchestration technologies (e.g., Airflow, Temporal, Spark, or equivalent) and a working understanding of distributed systems.
Proficiency in at least one major programming language (e.g., Java, Python, Go) and solid SQL.
Experience delivering well-scoped projects or features end-to-end (design, build, test, ship, operate), with guidance from more experienced engineers.
Strong communication skills: you surface concerns alongside a concrete proposal, and you give teammates clear context when debugging and escalating.
Care for engineering quality, including maintainable and testable code, code review, CI/CD, and observability, appropriate for a complex, high-stakes financial environment.
Proficiency in using AI tools throughout the software development lifecycle, with the judgment to recognize where they accelerate work and where output needs additional validation.

Nice to Have

Exposure to financial, tax, regulatory, or payments reporting and reconciliation products.
Familiarity with the payments ecosystem (merchants, acquirers, card networks, and issuers/processors), including authorization, clearing, and settlement, card-network settlement file formats, or ISO-8583.
Understanding of accounting principles, double-entry bookkeeping, and financial reconciliation processes.
Experience with cloud data warehouses (e.g., BigQuery, Snowflake) or distributed data systems and tools such as Spark/PySpark, Delta Lake, Kafka, and Hadoop.
Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS, Kubernetes) and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform).
Interest in financial products and markets.

If you want to be part of a dynamic team delivering cutting-edge cyber training solutions, this is the place for you. Amentum is seeking a Software Engineer to join the DevOps team in Hanover, MD. The team develops, deploys, and supports mission-focused cyber training solutions used across multiple locations.

Team members work in a collaborative, multidisciplinary environment supporting the entire software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, software development, testing, deployment, infrastructure management, and operational support. Engineers work closely with instructors, developers, and system administrators to deliver reliable, realistic training capabilities.

Unlike many software organizations where engineers are assigned to a single product or technology stack, members of the DevOps team contribute across a diverse portfolio of applications, services, and supporting infrastructure. This provides opportunities to build broad technical expertise while collaborating with teammates to deliver integrated solutions throughout the software development lifecycle.

This position is ideal for software engineers who enjoy solving complex technical challenges, learning new technologies, and applying their skills across a diverse portfolio of software, infrastructure, and operational systems. you. 

Work Schedule:
The courses being supported are active from 0700-1800 M-F. Contract core hours are 1000-1400. The DevOps team is flexible on arrival and departure time however there are occasions where one or more DevOps team members will be needed to support testing and maintenance before or after course hours.

Essential Responsibilities:

The Software Engineer will contribute to the design, development, deployment, and maintenance of software applications and supporting infrastructure. Team members are expected to broaden their experience across multiple areas of the software development lifecycle while developing technical expertise in one or more areas.

Responsibilities include:

Design, develop, troubleshoot, and maintain software applications supporting cyber training environments.
Analyze requirements and develop technical solutions that support mission and customer needs.
Develop user interfaces, backend services, APIs, automation tools, and data processing solutions.
Contribute to the implementation and maintenance of software development pipelines.
Configure, deploy, and maintain applications in virtualized and containerized environments.
Develop and maintain databases, dataflows, scripts, and automation solutions.
Support the creation and maintenance of realistic cyber training environments and simulations.
Perform software testing, debugging, validation, and analysis of results.
Evaluate new technologies and contribute recommendations for improving applications and development processes.
Document software designs, configurations, processes, and operational procedures.
Collaborate with instructors, developers, system administrators, and other technical teams to improve training capabilities.
Identify opportunities to improve existing applications, workflows, and user experiences.

TS/SCI with Poly

Minimum Education:

Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or related field and two (2) years of relevant experience;

OR Associate's degree (or 18 semester hours of military coursework/training in a computer-related field) and seven (7) years of relevant experience;

OR High school diploma/GED and nine (9) years of relevant experience.

Experience developing using one or more of the following languages: Ruby, Ruby on Rails, Java, or C++.

     Experience using SQL/NoSQL and relational databases (MySQL/MongoDB preferred) required.
     A working knowledge of both Windows and Linux platform is required.

Preferred Qualifications:

As a team we implement and support all stages of the Software Development Lifecycle and recognize the benefit of having team members that specialize in specific stages of that cycle. As a team member you should be able to fit into at least one of the following specializations (UI/UX, Backend Services, DevOps/Integration) with a desire or ability to expand into at least one other specialization.

 develop aesthetically pleasing and user-friendly front ends using frameworks like react, angular, and svelte

interface with API endpoints, databases, and other dataflow solutions 
 perform trend analysis of student activities and identify potential improvements to course delivery systems and interfaces. 

Backend Service specialist: Focus on creating dataflow components to collect, parse, and provide information to other services or for exfiltration and deliverables. You will need the following skills at a minimum: 

develop services, APIs and dataflow solutions using various languages and frameworks such as Python Flask, JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.JS, Express/Hono, PHP, Ruby on Rails, and Go. 
design and implement database schemas across multiple systems with and without replication using SQL and NoSQL solutions 
develop scripts, scrapers and parsers in support of automated grading and course delivery

 design and implement flexible and robust CI/CD pipelines to enhance the software development lifecycle using solutions such as GitLab

perform HTTPS certificate management 
design service, application, and network architectures to support deployment and data flow 
 develop and implement test beds and use test suites such as jUnit or PyTest for robust testing practices 

All team members regardless of their specialization will be expected to: 

demonstrate the ability to parse and understand existing code bases, contributing to the continued development of class management tools

 develop software solutions using languages such as Python, Shell scripting or Node.js

jobs.title: Analysis Software Engineer II - Chemical Insights Research Institute
jobs.description:
Job Description

We have an exciting opportunity for an Analysis Software Engineer II
at UL Research Institutes, based in our Morrisville, North Carolina office.

The Analysis Software Engineer II designs, develops, and maintains high-quality software applications and data pipelines in support of Underwriters Laboratories Research Institutes’ (ULRI) Chemical Insights mission to provide unbiased research on chemicals and their risks to people’s health.

The Analysis Software Engineer II is a key contributor on project teams to define specifications for complex software programming applications and modifies existing applications. The role requires strong proficiency in data science tools and web technologies for building durable data pipelines and full-stack software applications. The role requires a collaborative mindset, and the ability to turn complex scientific requirements into scalable, high-quality software solutions.

UL Research Institutes

At UL Research Institutes (ULRI), we expand the boundaries of safety science to create a more secure and sustainable world. For more than a century, we have studied the unintended consequences of innovation, designed solutions to mitigate risk and shared our findings with academia, scientists, manufacturers, and policymakers across industries. We identify critical safety and sustainability issues, asking the tough questions because we believe a safer world begins with knowledge.

Build a safer, more secure, and sustainable future with us. Join us and work with our Chemical Insights teams who conduct the research required to produce that knowledge and put into practice.

Chemical Insights Research Institute (CIRI)

The Chemical Insights Research Institute (CIRI) contributes to the protection of public health and well-being by conducting scientific research. Our research and initiatives let people around the world know what chemicals are in the air we breathe and how they affect human health and the planet. We share our research and knowledge through information and application tools with leaders in the scientific, business, and policy communities to raise awareness of human health risks stemming from emerging technologies. To learn more, visit: chemicalinsights.org/.

What You’ll Learn And Achieve

As the Analysis Software Engineer II, you will play a key role in the rapid growth of UL as you:

Design, build, and maintain Python-based data pipelines for ingesting, cleaning, transforming, and validating scientific data, as well as web-based applications and REST APIs for scientific data curation and evaluation.
Collaborate with scientific technical experts, UX/UI designers, software engineers, and other developers to deliver features that meet user needs and research goals.
Integrate applications with databases, APIs, laboratory information systems, high-performance computing (HPC) systems, and external scientific data sources.
Design and implement programmatic REST APIs for seamless integration between services.
Write unit and integration tests for reliable, durable software applications.
Assist internal scientists and engineers in using data pipelines and applications; maintain effective documentation of these systems for internal users.
Stay up to date with emerging technologies, industry trends, and best practices in software engineering.
Plan and prioritize project activities, ensuring on-time and on-budget delivery.
Communicate project status, risks, and technical challenges to stakeholders and senior management.
Mentor colleagues in software engineering best practices.

Perform code reviews and provide constructive feedback on findings, both verbal and in writing.

Perform other duties as directed.

What you’ll experience working at UL Research Institutes:
We have pursued our mission of working for a safer, more secure, and sustainable world for nearly 130 years, embedding conscientious stewardship into everything we do.

People: Our people make us special. You’ll work with a diverse team of experts respected for their independence and transparency and build a network, because our approach is collaborative. We collaborate across disciplines, organizations, and geographies to build the global scientific response that today’s global challenges require.
Interesting work: Every day is different for us here. We see what’s on the horizon and use our expertise to build the foundations of a safer future. You’ll have the opportunity to push the boundaries of human understanding as part of a team working to advance the public good.
Grow and achieve: We learn, work, and grow together through targeted development, reward, and recognition programs.
Values. Four core values guide our work: collaboration, respect, integrity, and beneficence. By living our values, we inspire the trust essential to fulfilling our mission and foster the partnerships that enable us to pursue a beneficent future in which we all can thrive.
Total Rewards: All employees at UL Research Institutes are eligible for bonus compensation. We offer comprehensive medical, dental, vision, and life insurance plans and a generous 401k matching structure of up to 5% of eligible pay. Moreover, we invest an additional 4% into your retirement saving fund after your first year of continuous employment. Depending on your role, you may be able to discuss flexible working arrangements with your manager. We also provide employees with paid time off, including vacation, holiday, sick, and volunteer days.

What Makes You a Great Fit

While no one candidate will embody every quality, the successful candidate will bring many of the following professional competencies and personal attributes :

Advanced technical knowledge of software development, version control, and agile development practices.
Proficiency with Python data-science stack (e.g., Polars, Pandas, Numpy, Scipy) and web-application frameworks (e.g., Django, Flask, FastAPI), cloud services (AWS or Azure), and relational databases (PostgreSQL).
Familiarity with JavaScript (e.g., React, Vue, Plotly), R, Java, Go, and containerization (Docker), and orchestration tools for production deployment is preferred but not required.
Strong project management, organizational and problem-solving skills.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Strong management, initiative, and influence skills to create alignment with multiple stakeholders and deliver results in a scientific research organization.
Positive and collaborative attitude and interpersonal skills to work effectively with leaders and colleagues across the organization.
Must be a self-starter and possess excellent leadership qualities.

Professional Education And Experience Requirements For The Role Include

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology, computer programming, or a related field and minimum of 4 years of professional full stack development experience; or
Master’s degree in computer science, information technology, computer programming, or a related field and minimum of 2 years of professional full stack development experience.
Prior experience in developing online applications in a scientific research environment.

About UL Research Institutes And UL Standards & Engagement

UL Research Institutes and UL Standards & Engagement are nonprofit organizations dedicated to advancing safety science research through the discovery and application of scientific knowledge. We conduct rigorous independent research and analyze safety data, convene experts worldwide to address risks, share knowledge through safety education and public outreach initiatives, and develop standards to guide safe commercialization of evolving technologies. We foster communities of safety, from grassroots initiatives for neighborhoods to summits of world leaders. Our organization employs collaborative and scientific approaches with partners and stakeholders to drive innovation and progress toward improving safety, security, and sustainability, ultimately enhancing societal well-being.

To learn more, visit our websites UL.org and ULSE.org.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Ads Tooling
jobs.description:
Responsibilities

The ads system at TikTok operates on a massive scale and serves millions of advertisers, clients and influencers across the world. The quality of the ads system depends heavily on the underlying infrastructure that handles massive data. The USDS Ads team empowers TikTok's global monetization by efficiently delivering ads and content on TikTok.

Tooling is what makes changing that system fast — and safe. Ads correctness cannot be asserted by comparing an expected string to an actual one: ranking outputs are probabilistic, behavior is driven as much by configuration as by code, and a silent regression in a prediction pipeline costs revenue long before it triggers an alert. Off-the-shelf test frameworks don't cover this, so we build our own. You will build the platforms and tooling that let every engineer on the team validate their changes — automated validation across ads pipelines, and continuous system-health monitoring that protects business metrics. Just as importantly, you'll go looking for the manual, repetitive, and error-prone workflows our engineers live with today, and replace them with automation.

You'll join a team that invests in your growth — with mentorship from senior engineers, ownership of real surfaces from early on, and a clear path toward technical leadership.

Responsibilities:
- Build and own the internal tooling and platforms that power ads system validation — test frameworks, environment and data provisioning, assertion libraries, and self-service harnesses that let engineers validate changes without hand-rolling infrastructure each time.
- Identify inefficient engineering workflows and automate them away. Audit how the team actually works today — manual verification steps, repeated debugging rituals, slow feedback loops, high-toil release procedures — quantify the cost, and build the tooling that eliminates it.
- Build quality infrastructure for ads systems, including training/serving consistency checks, prediction-service invariant and fallback validation.
- Build automated system-health monitoring that surfaces regressions in business and quality metrics, routes findings to the owning engineer with enough context to act, and shortens time-to-detection.
- Integrate tooling into CI/CD as release gates, so validation runs by default rather than by remembering to run it.
- Treat internal engineers as your users — measure adoption, gather feedback, and iterate on developer experience rather than shipping tools and walking away.
- Bring in new ideas and tooling, including applying LLM and agent-based approaches to test generation, failure triage, and coverage analysis.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree or above, major in computer science or related technical disciplines.
- 3+ years of hands-on experience in software engineering, developer tooling, quality engineering, or test infrastructure for complex and scalable distributed systems.
- Track record of building tooling or frameworks used by other engineers — not only authoring tests within an existing framework.
- Hands-on authorship of CI/CD pipelines including release-gating logic.
- Demonstrated instinct for spotting repetitive or manual engineering work and replacing it with automation, with measurable results.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience in the Ads domain — auction mechanics, bidding, ranking, attribution, or billing.
- Experience building internal developer platforms, engineering-efficiency tooling, or test infrastructure adopted across a team or org.
- Experience testing or validating large-scale ranking and machine learning infrastructure, including model evaluation, A/B experiment correctness, or online/offline consistency.
- Applied LLM/agent tooling for engineering workflows, including structured-output schema design.

About USDS

TikTok USDS Joint Venture LLC is dedicated to the safety and security of millions of Americans who create, discover, and connect with what they love on the apps we operate. The Joint Venture has been established in compliance with the Executive Order signed by President Trump on September 25, 2025. Our foundation is a comprehensive data privacy and cybersecurity program we operate under defined safeguards to protect national security and secure U.S. user data, apps and the algorithm. We safeguard the U.S. content ecosystem, holding decision-making authority for trust and safety policies and moderation. USDS Joint Venture helps ensure Americans can continue to express their creativity, discover new hobbies and interests, and build thriving communities and businesses on a global scale.​
​
On-site presence across teams allows the company to operate with greater speed, alignment, and agility — especially in areas like real-time decision-making, team development, and integrated execution. As such, the company is shifting from a hybrid work model to a fully in-person schedule up to 5 days a week.​

Why Join Us

Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.​
We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.​

Diversity & Inclusion​
TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. This role is open at both junior and senior levels.

Build Automation Tooling: Design and ship the plugins, skills and MCP servers the Solutions team runs — tenant creation, configuration copying, onboarding flows, on-call helpers — in Python and shell.

Experience: At least 1 year of full-time professional software engineering experience building and shipping production systems. Internships are not counted toward this minimum. We are open on level — we care more about what you have built than how long you have been building.

1–3 years of hands‑on web development experience

Ability to collaborate effectively with external vendors and internal business stakeholders
Eagerness to learn, take feedback well, and grow into greater ownership of tasks and technical challenges over time
Working knowledge of relational databases (plus)
Experience with SAP Commerce Cloud Composable Framework (plus)
Familiarity with IDEs such as Eclipse or Visual Studio Code

jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description:
About Clinically AI

Clinically AI is a rapidly scaling healthcare AI company transforming how behavioral health and healthcare organizations manage clinical documentation, compliance workflows, chart auditing, and operational efficiency through artificial intelligence.

Our platform helps clinicians, compliance teams, administrators, and healthcare organizations reduce administrative burden, improve documentation quality, strengthen audit readiness, and operate more efficiently. We operate at the intersection of AI, healthcare operations, workflow design, and real-world clinical execution, where adoption, trust, usability, and measurable outcomes matter.

The Opportunity

This opportunity places you at the center of a rapidly scaling engineering organization tackling some of the most ambitious challenges in healthcare technology.

We are seeking a Full-Stack Engineer to help build and scale the full technology ecosystem behind our platform — React front-ends, Node services, mobile apps, browser extensions, and high-performance AI systems — with state-of-the-art developer-focused AI tools that dramatically increase your velocity and technical reach.

This is a critical role for someone who can ship across the full stack, partner directly with clinicians and administrators to see firsthand how their work improves care, and take on ownership quickly as the team scales. You will work closely with product, design, AI/ML, and customer-facing teams to translate real clinician needs into high-impact solutions.

This is not a narrowly-scoped, single-stack engineering role. You should be comfortable moving across front-end, back-end, mobile, and AI-driven systems, leveraging modern AI developer tools to move fast, and operating with real autonomy in a fast-growing, high-velocity environment.

We believe successful engineers here are defined not by narrow specialization, but by ownership, technical judgment, and the real-world impact of what they ship — whether that's leading a single feature or, over time, owning an entire product area. Whether your path leads toward principal engineering, staff IC, or future team leadership, you'll have the autonomy, resources, and AI-enabled leverage to get there faster.

What You'll Own

Ship across the stack.
Architect, develop, and ship new features across our full technology ecosystem — React front-ends, Node services, mobile apps (iOS/Android), browser extensions, and AI-driven infrastructure — owning major components from design through deployment with a focus on scalability, maintainability, and user experience.
Partner cross-functionally.
Collaborate directly with product, design, AI/ML, and customer-facing teams to translate real clinician needs into high-impact solutions.
Accelerate with AI.
Leverage advanced developer-focused AI tools to speed up development, improve code quality, and strengthen system reliability.
Drive innovation.
Contribute to internal hackathons, rapid prototyping, and stay ahead of industry trends to identify technologies and opportunities that set the standard.
Shape technical strategy.
Lead technical decisions, contribute to architectural strategy, and help define engineering patterns as we grow the platform.
Mentor and elevate the team.
Mentor other engineers, raise the bar on best practices, and help build a strong, supportive engineering culture.
Own end-to-end.
Drive end-to-end ownership of key product areas and help build and scale new teams as the company grows.

What We're Looking For

Full-Stack Range.
You move comfortably across front-end, back-end, mobile, and browser-extension code, and you don't need to be told which layer a problem lives in.
Sharp Technical Judgment.
You design clean, scalable architecture, anticipate problems before they get expensive, and make pragmatic tradeoffs under real constraints.
AI-Accelerated Execution.
You use modern AI developer tools as real leverage to build faster and better, not as a crutch.
Ownership & Autonomy.
You drive your own work forward in a fast-growing, high-velocity environment without waiting to be told what's next.
Cross-Functional Fluency.
You partner naturally with product, design, and customer-facing teams, translating real clinician needs into shipped solutions.
Mentorship & Craft.
You raise the technical bar for the people around you, whether that's one engineer or an entire team.

Required Qualifications

4+ years of full-stack development experience, with a strong history of delivering production-grade systems from concept to launch.
Proficiency in our core stack — TypeScript, React, Node.js, MongoDB — with deep front-end fundamentals (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, DOM manipulation, Fetch/XHR) and expertise in browser extensions or similar browser-integrated technologies.
Expertise designing, building, and consuming RESTful APIs, with strong familiarity across NoSQL data models.
Sharp problem-solving skills with the ability to design clean, scalable architecture and anticipate technical challenges.
Excellent communication, collaboration, and product intuition — comfortable partnering with both technical and non-technical teams.
Familiarity with CI/CD (GitHub Actions), version control best practices, and modern DevOps workflows.
A strong sense of ownership and the ability to drive work with autonomy in a fast-growing, high-velocity environment.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience working with AI/ML pipelines, LLMs, model evaluation, or data processing workflows.
Knowledge of Kubernetes, container orchestration, GCP, Helm, Terraform, and distributed systems.
Background developing mobile applications (iOS/Android) or integrating with cross-platform frameworks.
Experience in fast-paced startup environments, especially where engineers hold significant ownership.
History of building projects independently — open source, side projects, research, or entrepreneurial work.
Familiarity with healthcare, clinical documentation workflows, or regulated environments (HIPAA, SOC2, NIST, ISO frameworks, etc.).
Experience designing systems that balance usability, accuracy, and performance at scale.

Compensation & Benefits

Base salary: $110,000–$140,000 (based on experience) + equity

Actual compensation will depend on experience, scope, and overall alignment with the role. Equity participation is an important component of our compensation philosophy.

We offer competitive compensation, stock options, unlimited PTO, medical, dental, and vision coverage, and a 401(k) with company match and Roth option.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Clinically AI provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetics, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

The Role at a Glance

The Agentic Platform Engineer builds the shared cloud platform and engineering foundations that enable AIDA teams to deliver secure, scalable AI agents and agentic applications. This role focuses on the runtime, tooling, and guardrails that agents depend on: model access, tool and context integration, orchestration frameworks, evaluation, observability, and DevSecOps on AWS.

What You'll Be Doing

Build and maintain shared platform services that support agent runtimes, LLM gateways, model routing, prompt/context management, and tool integration.
Standardize agentic delivery patterns including tool/function calling, MCP-style tool servers, retrieval pipelines, memory and state management, and multi-agent orchestration.
Implement guardrails for agent safety: input/output filtering, prompt injection defenses, human-in-the-loop approval paths, sandboxed execution, and least-privilege agent identities.
Improve developer productivity through CI/CD, environment templates, agent scaffolding, SDKs, and platform automation.
Build observability and evaluation for agentic systems: tracing, token and cost telemetry, latency, quality/eval harnesses, and regression testing of prompts and agent behavior.
Manage cost-aware model consumption, rate limits, caching, and secure secrets/access patterns across environments.
Partner with architecture, security, risk, and engineering leaders to apply AI controls, interoperability standards, and governance guardrails.
Document platform standards and help delivery teams adopt agentic patterns consistently.

5+ years of experience in platform engineering, cloud infrastructure, DevOps, or SRE, with hands-on work building or operating AI/LLM-based applications.
Strong experience with AWS, including services supporting AI workloads (Bedrock, SageMaker, containers, serverless).
Practical experience with agent frameworks and LLM tooling such as LangChain/LangGraph, MCP, vector databases, and RAG architectures.
Strong coding ability in Python; Java or NodeJS is a plus.
Experience enabling engineering teams through CI/CD, GitLab, observability, reusable services, and platform standards.
Experience with API infrastructure, containers, deployment pipelines, and operational tooling.

Nice to Haves

Experience with agent evaluation and LLM observability tooling (LangSmith, LangFuse, Arize, or similar).
Experience supporting production systems, data platforms, and AI/ML workloads.
Exposure to regulated enterprise environments, identity/access controls, AI risk frameworks, and audit logging.

Detailed Job Description :

As a Consulting Data Engineer, you will architect, build, and optimize the next generation of our real-time healthcare data platforms and event-driven architectures. You will play a foundational role in moving our clinical, operational, and financial data away from legacy batch processing toward high-throughput, near-zero-latency streaming pipelines.
In this role, you will champion modern data engineering practices, design highly scalable cloud-native pipelines, and mentor a growing team of engineers. You will bridge the gap between complex electronic health records (EHR) and data consumer-enabling data scientists, software engineers, and clinical analysts to securely access, stream, and query compliant data at scale to improve patient outcomes and operational efficiency.
Core Responsibilities

Architect Real-Time Pipelines: Design, implement, and monitor high-throughput, fault-tolerant streaming pipelines that ingest and process millions of concurrent healthcare data events (e.g., live telemetry, HL7 feeds, ADT messages).
Scale Google Cloud Infrastructure: Build and maintain scalable, secure, and cost-effective cloud data infrastructure using Google Cloud healthcare-native tools and Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
Enforce Healthcare Compliance & Security: Uphold strict data security protocols (HIPAA, HITRUST, SOC2) by building robust data lakehouse architectures that enforce PHI/PII masking, role-based access control (RBAC), and encryption at rest and in transit.
Enable Self-Service Data & Interoperability: Build out streaming data ecosystems that support modern healthcare interoperability, managing real-time data catalogs and schema registries.
Promote Code Excellence: Write modular, highly reusable, and performance-tested code; lead code reviews and establish standardized CI/CD automated deployment workflows.
Optimize Data Reliability: Set and champion strict SLAs for clinical data delivery, establish automated data-quality testing, and implement proactive system monitoring and alerting.
Collaborate & Mentor: Work closely with Data Architects, Clinical Product Managers, and AI/ML teams to translate healthcare requirements into technical blueprints while mentoring mid-level engineers.

Required Qualifications

Experience & Education

13+ years of experience in dedicated data engineering, data architecture, or distributed systems software engineering roles.
4+ years of experience specifically within the healthcare domain (payer, provider, digital health, or health tech).
Google Cloud Certified Professional Data Engineer (or equivalent proven expert-level architecture experience on GCP).

True Streaming Focus

Advanced Event-Driven Architecture: Mastery of high-volume streaming technologies including Apache Kafka and Google Cloud Pub/Sub for decoupled, real-time message routing.
Stream Processing: Deep hands-on experience with Apache Flink or Google Cloud Dataflow (Apache Beam) for real-time streaming, complex event processing (CEP), windowing, and streaming data transformations.

Healthcare-Specific Tech Stack

Interoperability Standards: Deep expertise working with FHIR (Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources) JSON structures, HL7 v2/v3 messaging, and DICOM imaging standard streams.
GCP Healthcare Tools: Hands-on experience implementing and scaling the Google Cloud Healthcare API (specifically FHIR stores and HL7v2 stores).
EHR Integration: Experience integrating streaming pipelines with major EHR systems (such as Epic, Cerner, or Meditech).

Cloud Ecosystem & Modern Tooling

Google Cloud Ecosystem: Technical mastery of BigQuery (including partitioning, clustering, and streaming inserts), Cloud Storage, Dataproc, and Cloud Composer (Apache Airflow).
Programming Languages: Proficiency in Python, Scala, or Java, with a strong focus on writing optimized code for distributed computing platforms (like Spark or Beam).
Modern Data Stack & Modeling: Mastery of modern analytics engineering frameworks (such as dbt), dimensional data modeling, and lakehouse architectures (e.g., Iceberg, Delta Lake).
DevOps & Automation: Robust experience building automated CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI) and managing infrastructure using Terraform.

Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work effectively in a collaborative team environment.

Experience setting up test automation within CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitLab CI, Jenkins, Docker).

jobs.title: Software Engineer I, Marketplace Makers
jobs.description:
Company Description

Etsy is the global marketplace for unique and creative goods. We build, power, and evolve the tools and technologies that connect millions of entrepreneurs with millions of buyers around the world. As an Etsy employee, you will tackle unique, meaningful, and large-scale problems alongside passionate coworkers, all the while making a rewarding impact and Keeping Commerce Human.

We believe exceptional companies are built by exceptional teams, and we're intentional about it. That means hiring great people, setting them up for success from day one, and giving them real reasons to grow their careers here. We invest in development that goes beyond promotions, and we foster the trust and relationships that help people do their best work together.

What’s the Role?

Etsy is looking for a Software Engineer I to join the Marketplace Makers team. Marketplace Makers are the sellers who create the best buyer experiences on Etsy, and our team builds the programs and tools that recognize and grow them. We work across experiences such as the Star Seller program as well as seller tooling in Shop Manager.

As a Software Engineer I, you will build and ship full-stack web features in PHP and React/TypeScript, learn how Etsy's platform works end to end, and grow your craft with support from a team that pairs, reviews, and teaches. This is an early-career role: we are looking for someone with a solid programming foundation who is eager to learn how production software is built at scale.

This is a full time role reporting to the Engineering Manager of Marketplace Makers.

What’s this team like at Etsy?

We are a multi-functional product team distributed across the US and Mexico. The team is composed of software engineers, a product manager, a product designer, a researcher, an analyst, and a copywriter.
We work on problems that directly affect millions of sellers: how they earn and keep Star Seller status, and how we motivate the practices, like fast responses and on-time shipping, that create great buyer experiences.
We ship in small increments behind feature flags, run A/B experiments to validate changes, and use data to decide what to build next.
At Etsy, we believe that code is craft and that small, empowered, self-motivated teams can do big things. We take advantage of our continuous deployment system and cultivate a blameless culture based on trust and a commitment to learning. Learn more on our engineering blog: Code as Craft.

What does the day-to-day look like?

Build and maintain well-scoped product features across our PHP backend and React/TypeScript frontend, with guidance from senior engineers.
Translate designs and product requirements into production-ready code, and write tests that keep it working.
Participate in code review, both giving and receiving feedback.
Help instrument and analyze A/B experiments on seller-facing features such as the Star Seller dashboard and seller inbox.
Investigate bugs and support issues, and communicate clearly about what you find and how you fixed it.
Collaborate with product, design, research, and analytics partners in planning, standups, and retrospectives.
Of course, this is just a sample of the kinds of work this role will require! You should assume that your role will encompass other tasks, too, and that your job duties and responsibilities may change from time to time at Etsy's discretion, or otherwise applicable with local law.

Qualities that will help you thrive in this role are:

A foundation in software engineering, from a degree in computer science or a related field, a bootcamp, or equivalent self-directed experience.
Some experience building web applications, through internships, co-ops, personal projects, or professional work, in languages such as PHP, Python, Ruby, Java, Go, or JavaScript/TypeScript.
Curiosity about how things work and the persistence to debug until you understand the root cause.
Comfort asking questions, taking feedback, and learning in the open.
An interest in solving user problems and in writing code that is readable and maintainable.
Clear written and spoken communication with both technical and non-technical teammates.

Compensation & Benefits

In addition to salary, you'll be eligible for an equity package, an annual performance bonus, and our competitive benefits that support you and your family. Base salary is determined by your location, skills, and experience.

Etsy uses two geographic pay zones to reflect the labor markets where we compete for talent: one called Geo-1, covering the New York City metropolitan area, San Francisco Bay Area, and Seattle metropolitan area, and one called Geo-2, covering all other U.S. locations. Salary ranges for this role vary by zone and are listed below.

Location

We prioritize candidates based within commutable distance of Etsy’s Brooklyn Office. Depending on proximity, we ask team members to come in once or twice per week. Remote candidates outside commutable distance may be considered on a case-by-case basis, with the expectation of occasional travel to the office. Learn more details about our work modes and workplace safety policies here.

Salary Range

Geo-1: 120,000.00 - 162,000.00 USD Annual
Geo-2: 108,000.00 - 146,000.00 USD Annual

What's Next

If you're interested in joining the team at Etsy, please share your resume with us and feel free to include a cover letter if you'd like. As we hope you've seen already, Etsy is a place that values individuality and variety. We don't want you to be like everyone else -- we want you to be like you! So tell us what you're all about.

Our Promise

At Etsy, we believe that a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace furthers relevance, resilience, and longevity. We encourage people from all backgrounds, ages, abilities, and experiences to apply. Etsy is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, national origin, religion or creed, sex, pregnancy (including childbirth and related medical conditions), gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, citizenship or immigration status, marital or familial status, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, military or veteran status**, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law**. If, due to a disability, you need an accommodation during any part of the interview or hiring process, please let your recruiter know and we will work with you to meet your needs. jobs.title: Electrical Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
Company Description
SIEMAG TECBERG Inc. is part of a global engineering group that delivers specialized mechanical and electrical solutions for industrial applications. The company focuses on advanced hoisting, material handling, and automation technologies that support safe, efficient, and reliable operations. Team members collaborate across disciplines to design, implement, and maintain high-performance systems for a wide range of customers. SIEMAG TECBERG Inc. offers opportunities to work with modern automation and control technologies while contributing to complex, technically challenging projects.
Role Description
The Electrical Automation Engineer is a full-time, on-site position based in Newburgh, IN. This role is responsible for designing, programming, and commissioning automation and control systems for industrial equipment and processes. Daily tasks include developing electrical schematics, configuring PLCs and HMIs, integrating sensors and drives, and ensuring proper functionality and safety of automated systems. The engineer will diagnose and resolve control and electrical issues, optimize process performance, and provide technical support during installation, testing, and maintenance. Collaboration with mechanical engineers, project managers, and external partners is expected, along with preparing documentation, reports, and user instructions for installed systems.
Qualifications

Candidates should possess strong Electrical Engineering skills, including familiarity with industrial power distribution, control circuits, and relevant standards.
Candidates should possess Automation and Process Control skills, such as PLC and HMI programming, drive and motion control configuration, and system integration.
Candidates should possess Troubleshooting skills, including systematic fault diagnosis, root cause analysis, and resolution of electrical and control issues.
Candidates should possess Robotics-related skills, including understanding of robotic interfaces, programming basics, and integration into automated production or handling systems.
Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Automation Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
Experience with industrial communication protocols (e.g., Ethernet/IP, Profibus, Modbus) and safety systems is highly beneficial.
Ability to read and create electrical schematics and technical documentation. AutoCad Electrical and/or EPlan experience is a plus.
Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills, with the ability to work safely on-site and collaborate in multidisciplinary teams.

jobs.description:
Forward Deployed Engineer (TS/SCI)

Location: Norfolk / Virginia Beach, VA (on-site, 20 to 30% travel)

Salary: $180,000 to $220,000 base depending on level, plus competitive equity

Our client builds software and hardware that help people on the front lines deter and de-escalate conflict with America's adversaries. Their tools support maritime vigilance, counter misinformation and collect non-traditional intelligence, across all U.S. service branches, multiple combatant commands, partner nations and the intelligence community. They have been profitable since 2021.

The team is mission-driven and believes in public service, and they put serious effort into improving the technology the government uses.

The Role

Our client is hiring a Forward Deployed Engineer to be the technical owner for mission-critical national security software deployments. You will sit between engineering and the customer, turning operator requirements into production-grade software deployed directly into government environments. This is hands-on, high-stakes engineering work that shapes U.S. defense outcomes.

What you'll own

Deploying and sustaining production software inside government and DoD IT environments, end to end from requirements through fielding
Acting as the primary technical contact for mission owners, operators and intel analysts, turning ambiguous field requirements into shipped software
Scoping and building low-cost pilots with government mission teams (pre-sales) and running full technical deployments after contract close (post-sales)
Writing hands-on backend code (Python preferred) across customer use cases, including large-scale text, multimedia and geospatial data
Navigating government IT ecosystems (RMF, IdAM, SIEM, CDSs) and working with product, design and platform engineering teams

What We're Looking For

Active TS clearance with SCI eligibility (candidates eligible and willing to obtain clearance may be considered if technically exceptional)
4 to 6 years of experience in software engineering, solutions architecture or forward deployed roles within government or DoD environments
Full-stack engineering experience with strong backend fundamentals, Python preferred (assessed through a backend coding and algorithms interview)
Proven experience deploying software inside government or DoD IT environments (RMF, IdAM, SIEM, CDSs)
Ability to own a project end to end in a field-facing or customer-embedded context with minimal oversight
Willingness to travel 20 to 30% to customer and classified operational sites

Tech stack

Python, React, PostgreSQL, Redis, AWS S3, DoD RMF, Government IT systems (IdAM, SIEM, CDS)

If you are open to finding out more about this position, please apply below and I will be in contact to discuss the position further.

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in software engineering, logical reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.

Ideal Background:

This role is ideal for engineers who have built production systems at companies like Google, Microsoft, Apple, Amazon, Meta, or similar high-scale engineering organizations. We especially welcome graduates from top computer science programs such as Stanford, MIT, Carnegie Mellon, UC Berkeley, Georgia Tech, and comparable institutions — though exceptional experience and skill always take precedence over pedigree.

Project Overview:

As a Software Engineering evaluator, you will create cutting-edge datasets for training, benchmarking, and advancing large language models, collaborating closely with researchers. This includes curating code examples, providing precise solutions, and making corrections — with a primary focus on Python across backend services, data pipelines, and ML infrastructure, alongside JavaScript (including ReactJS), C/C++, Java, Rust, and Go. You will evaluate and refine AI-generated code for efficiency, scalability, and reliability, and work with cross-functional teams to enhance enterprise-level AI-driven coding solutions.

What Does a Typical Day Look Like?

Work on AI model training initiatives by curating code examples, building solutions, and correcting code — primarily in Python, with additional work in JavaScript (including ReactJS), C/C++, Java, Rust, and Go.
Evaluate and refine AI-generated code to ensure that it is efficient, scalable, and reliable.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to enhance AI-driven coding solutions against industry performance benchmarks.
Build agents and automated verification tools in Python that can verify the quality of code and identify error patterns.
Hypothesize on steps in the software engineering cycle (prototyping, architecture design, API design, production implementation, launch, experiments, monitoring, operational maintenance) and evaluate model capabilities on them.
Design verification mechanisms that can automatically verify a solution to a software engineering task.

Required Skills:

Several years of software engineering experience (3 years or more)
Strong expertise in Python with deep knowledge of frameworks, tooling, and best practices for building production-grade software.
Experience building full-stack applications and deploying scalable software using modern languages and tools.
Deep understanding of software architecture, design, development, debugging, and code quality/review assessment.
Excellent oral and written communication skills for clear, structured evaluation rationales.

Engagement Details:

Commitment: flexible engagement, minimum 10 hrs/week, up to 40 hrs/week
Type: Contractor (no medical/paid leave)
Duration: 1 month (potential extensions based on performance and fit)
Location: Candidates must be based in the United States

Evaluation Process:

The application process takes 15–30 minutes.
Completion of an AI video interview is required.

jobs.title: Software Engineer 2
jobs.description:
Become a part of our caring community

The Software Engineer 2 contributes to the technology platforms that support the secure exchange of healthcare transactions between providers, payers, and business partners. This role helps deliver reliable, scalable, and efficient solutions while supporting the organization's modernization journey from legacy applications to cloud-native technologies. The ideal candidate enjoys solving technical challenges, demonstrates ongoing technical development through coursework, projects, internships, or hands-on experience, and contributes to the delivery and support of business-critical applications and services.

The Software Engineer 2 develops, enhances, and supports applications, integrations, and platform capabilities that enable healthcare transaction processing and business operations. Working closely with engineers, architects, product teams, and operations partners, this role contributes to both cloud modernization initiatives and ongoing enhancements of existing platforms.

This position provides hands-on experience across software development, system integration, automation, operational support, and cloud technologies. The engineer is expected to independently investigate technical challenges, identify improvement opportunities, and apply sound engineering practices to deliver secure, maintainable, and reliable solutions.

This position follows a hybrid work arrangement in Louisville, KY or Nashville, TN, with an expectation of 1-2 days per week onsite.

Use Your Skills To Make An Impact

Solution Development & Delivery

Develop, test, enhance, and support application, integration, batch, and API solutions across modern and legacy platforms.
Partner with engineers, architects, and product teams to deliver enhancements and modernization initiatives.
Troubleshoot application, processing, and integration issues and contribute to continuous improvement efforts.

Modernization & Engineering Excellence

Contribute to cloud modernization efforts, platform simplification initiatives, and reduction of technical debt.
Develop or enhance automation and tooling that improve operational efficiency and solution reliability.
Continuously learn and apply new technologies, engineering practices, and development approaches.

Collaboration & Operational Support

Collaborate with technology and business partners to deliver secure and reliable solutions.
Support production stability through monitoring, testing, troubleshooting, and incident resolution activities.
Participate in code reviews, knowledge sharing, and team discussions to strengthen engineering practices.

Required Qualifications

This is an entry-level opportunity
open to candidates with relevant software development knowledge and hands-on experience gained through internships, coursework, projects, technical training, or other practical learning experiences. Professional work experience is not required.

Associate's degree in Computer Science
Foundational software development knowledge gained through education, internships, projects, or professional experience.
Hands-on use of .NET/C# and SQL through coursework, internships, projects, technical training, or professional work.
Evaluating technical challenges, investigating root causes, and recommending solutions.
Demonstrated application of new technologies, tools, and processes through coursework, projects, internships, or other hands-on experiences.
Communicates technical information effectively and collaborates with team members and business partners to support solution delivery.

Preferred Qualifications

Exposure to Java, C#, Python, JavaScript, or similar programming technologies through coursework, projects, internships, technical training, or other hands-on learning opportunities.
Exposure to cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, APIs, system integrations, or enterprise applications.
Familiarity with Git, CI/CD, automated testing, or DevOps practices.
Exposure to healthcare technology, EDI transactions, or regulated environments.
Interest in cloud-native technologies, automation, and modern software engineering practices.

Scheduled Weekly Hours

40

Pay Range

The compensation range below reflects a good faith estimate of starting base pay for full time (40 hours per week) employment at the time of posting. The pay range may be higher or lower based on geographic location and individual pay will vary based on demonstrated job related skills, knowledge, experience, education, certifications, etc.

$80,900 - $110,300 per year

This job is eligible for a bonus incentive plan. This incentive opportunity is based upon company and/or individual performance.

Description Of Benefits

Humana, Inc. and its affiliated subsidiaries (collectively, “Humana”) offers competitive benefits that support whole-person well-being. Associate benefits are designed to encourage personal wellness and smart healthcare decisions for you and your family while also knowing your life extends outside of work. Among our benefits, Humana provides medical, dental and vision benefits, 401(k) retirement savings plan, time off (including paid time off, company and personal holidays, paid parental and caregiver leave), short-term and long-term disability, life insurance and many other opportunities.

About Us

About Humana: Humana Inc. (NYSE: HUM) is a leading U.S. healthcare company. Through our Humana insurance services and our CenterWell healthcare services, we make it easier for the millions of people we serve to achieve their best health – delivering the care and service they need, when they need it. These efforts are leading to a better quality of life for people with Medicare and Medicaid, families, individuals, military service personnel, and communities at large. Learn more about what we offer at Humana.com and at CenterWell.com.

jobs.title: Remote Software Engineer - Python/Typescript
jobs.description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world's leading AGI infrastructure companies, working with frontier AI labs to accelerate model development through high-quality training data, evaluations, and engineering talent.

About the Role:

We're looking for a high-taste engineer with a strong eye for quality — someone who's worked hands-on with preference data and rubric creation, and knows what separates a good example from a great one. You communicate clearly and can synthesize complex technical work the way a strong MAI dev would: concise, structured, and easy for others to act on. You're comfortable in ambiguous, fast-moving environments and default to shipping over deliberating.

What does day-to-day look like:

Design, refine, and iterate on rubrics and evaluation criteria for preference data
Review and label data with a high bar for quality, catching subtle issues others might miss
Build and maintain pipelines/infra that support data generation, collection, and evaluation workflows
Synthesize findings from data work into clear write-ups, updates, or recommendations for the team
Collaborate closely with researchers/engineers to translate qualitative judgment into scalable processes

Required Skills:

Proficiency in Python (especially building/maintaining pipelines and infra) or Typescript (experience contributing to or navigating large codebases like VSCode a plus)
Hands-on experience with preference data collection and/or rubric creation
Strong written and verbal communication — able to distill technical work into clear, actionable summaries
Demonstrated high-taste judgment — able to articulate why something is good, not just that it is.

Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

Work in a fully remote environment.
Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.

Engagement Details:

Compensation:
Market rate. Please share a specific rate expectation (rather than a range) so we can quickly assess mutual fit
Availability:
40 hours/week preferred, with a minimum 6-hour overlap with Pacific Time. If you're unable to commit to 40 hours, please share your available hours and overlap window
Employment Type: Independent contractor (does not include medical or paid leave benefits

3 months, with an expected start date as soon as possible

jobs.title: AI Platform Engineer, 2027 New Grad
jobs.description:
Our Mission

Rebuild how the world works, to make institutions work better for the people they serve.

About Brain Co.

Brain Co. builds AI-native operating systems for large, regulated institutions. Each system is built for a specific industry, powered by agents that push real workflows forward. Underneath it all is Atlas, our proprietary platform that keeps customers in control, secure by design, and never locked into one model.

Why Now

Brain Co. is entering its next phase of production deployments on a national scale with an elite team built from Palantir, Google, Meta, and Nvidia, and a growing footprint across government, insurance, health, and financial services.

Joining now means shaping both the company and a new category of applied AI. Every project here ships to production and is expected to create measurable customer value and impact.

You'll work alongside exceptional peers on some of the hardest problems in applied AI. It’s the kind of work you'll still be proud of in ten years from now.

At Brain Co., new-grad engineers contribute to real production systems and see their work deployed at global scale.

About The Role

As an AI Platform Engineer at Brain Co., you’ll help build the backend services and shared capabilities behind our AI products. You’ll solve technical problems, develop reliable software, and collaborate with Product and ML teams to bring AI applications to enterprise and government customers.

This full-time, entry-level role is designed for candidates completing a bachelor’s degree in Spring 2027. You’ll turn cutting-edge AI into systems that important institutions can depend on, taking ownership of clearly scoped projects involving APIs, distributed services, and developer tooling. You’ll work closely with experienced engineers, with support through code reviews, design discussions, and ongoing collaboration.

What You’ll Work On

Design and build backend services and data pipelines that power Brain Co.’s AI products. Own scoped projects across implementation, testing, and maintenance, with guidance from experienced engineers.
Build tools that accelerate AI product development, including ML experiment tracking, artifact management, and automated training and evaluation pipelines.
Help build reliable systems for enterprise and government customers, with attention to testing and handling common failure cases.
Design modular, reusable components and clean APIs (REST, gRPC). Use profiling to improve application latency and throughput.
Partner with engineering, Product, and ML teams to build shared platform capabilities that remove bottlenecks and reduce the time it takes to ship new AI products.

You Might Be a Great Fit If You…

Expect to complete a bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Machine Learning, Data Science, or a related field in Spring 2027.
Have solid foundations in data structures, algorithms, and databases, with familiarity with API design and testing.
Are comfortable writing and debugging code in at least one language such as Python, Go, TypeScript, Rust, Java, or C++.
Have built a backend service, API, data-intensive application, or developer tool through an internship, research, coursework, or a personal project.
Are curious about how systems work under the hood and eager to learn distributed-systems concepts such as consistency, failure handling, retries, and idempotency.
Care about building intuitive, well-documented, and maintainable APIs and shared tools for internal ML and product teams.
Enjoy breaking down open-ended problems into clear technical designs, reasoning from first principles, and communicating your ideas.
Take ownership of your work, care about its quality over time, and actively seek feedback and guidance when needed.

Job Details & Benefits

Eligibility: Completing a bachelor’s degree in Spring 2027.
Competitive full-time compensation and benefits
Support and feedback from experienced platform engineers
Opportunity to work on real production systems used globally
Meaningful ownership from day one, with room to grow alongside the team
Daily lunches (if onsite)
