jobs.description:
Overview

Being good neighbors – helping people, investing in our communities, and making the world a better place – is who we are at State Farm. It is at the core of how we operate and the reason for our success. We're moving with urgency to become a Next Gen Good Neighbor, with technology that strengthens human connections and enhances the customer experience. As an employee, you'll spend less time navigating systems and more time applying judgment, empathy, and expertise in the moments that matter most.

Responsibilities

Grow Your Skills, Grow Your Potential

The Claims-Engineering team within Enterprise Technology is building the future-state delivery system for one of the largest Claims applications at State Farm. Working in the Engineering department on a DevOps and Infrastructure team, you'll work directly with engineering and business partners to make decisions and drive pace. Your work is the automation that gets application code into the right place, in the right shape, and running the right way. As a member of the Claims-Engineering team you'll be challenged and empowered to grow professionally.

If you're curious about infrastructure, this role puts a lot of it in front of you quickly. The system spans CI/CD pipelines, deployment configuration managed as code and the tooling that generates it, container images and manifests, and the observability and secrets tooling around them, all running on the enterprise's Kubernetes and Red Hat OpenShift on AWS (ROSA) platforms. We’re just getting started on a new platform that you’ll help us build out while working closely with the teams that own the application build process, the application framework, and the underlying infrastructure. jobs.title: Software Engineer II
jobs.description:
About The Role

What we do

Delphi, Uber's Lever Efficiency team, builds the system Uber uses to recommend how to invest billions of dollars per year across its marketplace supply and demand levers: courier pricing (supply), courier incentives (supply), delivery and service fees (demand), user promotions (demand), etc. Starting with Uber's Delivery Marketplace business, we turn experiment results into a measure of each lever's incremental value in a common currency and publish it in a dashboard that refreshes automatically. We're also building a budget allocation tool that recommends how to move budget between levers. We work day to day with data scientists, product, operations, and finance.

Why it matters

Today each lever spends against its own budget target, even after it starts hitting diminishing returns. A trusted, comparable measure of what each lever returns lets Uber move money to where it does the most good: more reliable deliveries for customers, more earning opportunities for couriers, and more long-term growth for every dollar spent. The hard part is making the numbers trustworthy enough that Operations and Finance leaders act on them. Then the recommendations have to be proven with well-designed experiments. That's the system you'll help build.

Basic Qualifications

Experience with software engineering best practices

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to document architectures and algorithms

Direct ownership of analysis workflows (A/B, quasi-experimental, marketplace simulations) at scale.

Jupyter Notebooks

Fullstack development experience (BE, FE, Data Pipelines), this project involves a full suite of development surfaces across UI, backend, and data.
Experience developing internal tooling used by Ops, Engineers, Finance, Scientists, etc.

What the Candidate Will Do

Build and own data pipelines (Spark, Hive, scheduled workflows) that recompute lever-efficiency estimates from experiment and marketplace data every week. Include data-quality checks, freshness alerts and backfills.
Build backend services and APIs in Go that store and serve efficiency estimates and budget recommendations.
Ship full-stack features in the web app: interactive dashboards and a budget allocation tool used by Operations, Finance, Product, and Science.
Work with data scientists to turn notebook prototypes into production code. This includes confidence intervals, corrections for network effects, forecasts, and an optimizer that moves budget between levers within real constraints, such as fixed total spend and capped weekly changes.
Work with Uber's experimentation platform to run experiments that test budget moves (switchbacks, geo experiments, synthetic control), and automate reading their results into the dashboard.
Take features from design to launch: write design docs, review code, test, monitor production, and take part in on-call.
Document methodology and system design so partners can trust and reuse the numbers.

Software Engineer

Job Description

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Develop embedded software for new and legacy products within the Robotics Automation Group to control robot motion, interface with vacuum chamber sub-systems, and perform self-diagnostics.
Collaborate with cross-functional engineering team, product management, and customer to define new product features to support Design-in-Wins.
Develop and communicate software requirements and design changes to peers; participate in design reviews.

Experience with embedded real-time systems under a multi-threading and interrupt driven environment, such as QNX or Real-Time Linux.
Experience with BSP and low-level hardware interface development, including FPGA integration, hardware abstraction layers (HAL), interrupt handling, and board bring-up.
Experience applying object-oriented design best practices.
Experience working as part of a team following modern software development practices (SDLC), working with revision control tools, using remote debuggers, and following software release processes, ideally in an Agile environment.
Experience in one or more of following would be a plus,
Experience working with customers to address field issues.
Experience with robotics, kinematics/dynamics, or motion planning.
Experience with EtherCAT software stack.
Familiarity with Machine Learning.
Familiarity with Python, JavaScript, MATLAB, or similar scripting languages a plus

jobs.description:
About Astra

Astra is building mission-critical infrastructure for moving money at scale. Our platform processes billions in annual transaction volume with 99.9%+ uptime, powering real-time transfers, bank debits, card disbursements, and complex financial compliance systems. We provide APIs and automation tools that enable businesses to move money programmatically while maintaining strict regulatory requirements.

The Role

We're looking for a Backend Engineer to build and ship features across the financial systems that move real money every day. You'll join a small team of experienced engineers working on our distributed microservices architecture, taking on features across payments, fraud detection, compliance, and user management from design through production.

This role is for an engineer who already delivers independently and is ready to take on broader scope. You'll work on larger, cross-domain problems, get real exposure to architecture decisions, and grow quickly in a domain where correctness and reliability matter.

What You’ll Do

Own features end to end: Design, build, test, and deploy backend features and services across payments, fraud, compliance, and user management, then run and monitor what you ship
Integrate with financial partners and APIs: Build and maintain integrations with banks, card networks, and other third-party services, handling the edge cases that money movement demands
Contribute to design: Write and review technical designs for your own work, participate in architecture discussions, and learn how our domain-driven, event-driven approach fits together
Improve performance and reliability: Find and fix bottlenecks and failure modes across our microservices, and help raise the quality of our tests and observability
Collaborate across teams: Work closely with product and compliance to turn business and regulatory requirements into working software

Required Experience

What We’re Looking For

3+ years of professional software engineering experience building production backend systems
Track record of delivering features independently, from ambiguous requirements to production, with sound judgment on when to ask for help
Solid foundation in algorithms, data structures, and computer science fundamentals
Working experience with distributed systems, event-driven architectures, or microservices
Ability and willingness to travel up to ~15% annually

Education

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. We care more about demonstrated ability than credentials.

Technical Skills

Backend development: Python 3 and web frameworks and APIs (we use Flask)
Databases: Experience with SQL and NoSQL databases
Cloud infrastructure: Google Cloud Platform, or similar cloud platforms
Architecture patterns: Familiarity with domain-driven design, clean architecture, and CQRS is a plus

Preferred Experience

Financial systems: Payment processing, fraud detection, or compliance systems
Financial regulations: Familiarity with AML, KYC, PCI DSS, or similar regulations
Banking integrations: Experience with financial APIs and money movement systems (ACH, card networks)
Third-party integrations: Experience building and maintaining integrations with external services
Scale and reliability: Experience with systems processing high transaction volumes

Why This Role Matters

Direct impact: You'll be a big part of a small engineering team building systems that power a growing fintech platform
Complex problems: Work on sophisticated challenges that few engineers get to solve
Room to grow: A path to broader scope and, over time, technical leadership as the team scales
Financial innovation: Build systems that enable new financial products and services

What We Offer

Competitive compensation with equity in a growing fintech company.
Remote-first culture with flexible working arrangements
Small team, big impact — your work directly supports Astra’s ability to scale responsibly
Mission-driven — build infrastructure that powers financial innovation while meeting the highest regulatory standards

Remote Work and Culture

Astra is a remote-first company hiring only within the U.S. We value thoughtful collaboration, clarity, and initiative. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team.

How To Apply

We're looking for engineers who are excited by complex systems problems and have the educational background and experience to handle sophisticated challenges.
If you're passionate about building mission-critical financial infrastructure and want to have a direct impact on our technical direction, we'd love to hear from you.

Compensation Range: $125K - $160K

Job Summary:
The Software Engineer is responsible for developing, programming, and optimizing building automation and energy management systems. This includes creating and enhancing control system software, graphics, and databases; customizing applications for building performance; and providing system reporting, diagnostics, and tuning. The position supports installation, startup, and commissioning teams, troubleshooting mechanical and control issues, and ensuring proper documentation, backups, and transition to service. Additionally, the role collaborates with contractors, sales, and internal teams, delivers ongoing system support to facilities, and contributes to accurate project design, estimation, and execution.

Responsibilities

Provide Controls database, graphics, programming, etc. for sequences as provided by the Design Specialist, project specifications, or other applicable sources.
Develop the specialized software required for a complete integrated building automation system or energy management system.
Use specialized software to write custom applications for building performance or provides automation for system backup for ongoing building management.
Use reporting software to follow-up on building performance and make adjustments to enhance the performance and tuning of the system.
Use existing software and develop enhancements to provide additional functionality for energy reporting and graphic interfaces for customer dashboards.
Develop custom scripts to query existing databases for service upgrades.
Develop enhancements to existing applications to enhance functionality and efficiency.
Support installation and startup personnel with adjustments to software as required.
Provide information and support for other contractors on project site.
Debug mechanical and installation issues that can come up when executing the static and dynamic start up and commissioning of building controls.
Provide support to Bosch Building Technologies and other contractors to solve building operating issues that go beyond the Bosch Building Technologies controls or special systems operation.
Provide input to others as requested or required to assist in the accurate estimation, design, installation, start up, commissioning, and training for building systems.
Provide start up documentation including, check out logs, commissioning documents, etc. as required for assigned projects.
Ensure timely software backups are created for projects and software development.
Provide service support on existing systems ensuring their proper and efficient operation as well as providing ongoing support to the facilitys building engineers.
Complete time sheets, service work orders, and other paperwork required for this position in an accurate and timely manner.
Assist in preparing of submittal documents, as-built drawings and Operation & Maintenance Manuals.
Initiate the transition from Operations Team to Service Team. Verify that proper backups, as built and facility performance software is in place.
Assist Sales team during estimating phase including potential product or system demonstrations.
Other duties as assigned.

Bachelors degree in mechanical, electrical, computer science or HVAC Controls engineering, or 5+ years of related BMS industry experience.

Other technical experience such as military training or on-the-job training programs, as determined by local management.

Understanding of HVAC system operations and mechanical & electrical systems within a facility.
Proficiency with computer operating systems, including MS Office Suite.

Experience with programming.

Working understanding of AC power circuitry, including breakers and multi-phase power (120VAC and greater).
Clear and concise verbal and written communication skills.
Empathy and problem-solving skills to understand and address the issues and perceptions of others effectively.

Minimum of 7 years of experience in a related field.
Additional technical certifications or coursework related to HVAC Controls engineering, Electrical engineering, or Building Management Systems.
Deep understanding of DDC or special systems that control buildings.
N4 Certification.

As an Applied AI Engineer III , you will actively engage in your engineering craft, taking a hands-on approach to building and enhancing high-visibility, full-stack products that serve the business and its users. Your expertise will be pivotal in delighting customers and users, while driving tangible value across Deloitte's product and AI investments. You will leverage your extensive engineering craftsmanship across full-stack software engineering and modern frameworks-together with applied AI fluency that lets you build GenAI and agentic capabilities directly into the products you deliver-consistently demonstrating your strong track record in delivering high-quality, outcome-focused solutions. The ideal candidate will be a dependable team player, collaborating with cross-functional teams to design, build, and ship products end to end, from concept through production.

Key Responsibilities:

Outcome-Driven Accountability: Embrace and drive a culture of accountability for customer and business outcomes-and for the cost of achieving them. Develop engineering solutions that solve complex problems with valuable outcomes, ensuring high-quality, lean designs and implementations, and owning the inference, token, and cloud cost of what you build.
Technical Leadership and Advocacy: Serve as the technical advocate for products, ensuring code integrity, feasibility, and alignment with business and customer goals. Lead requirement analysis, component design, development, testing, integrations, and support.
Engineering Craftsmanship: Maintain accountability for code-design integrity, implementation fidelity to architecture and tech stack, quality, data, and ongoing maintenance and operations. Be hands-on, self-driven, and continuously learn new approaches, languages, and frameworks. Create technical specifications, and write high-quality, supportable, scalable code ensuring all quality KPIs are met or exceeded. Demonstrate collaborative skills to work effectively with diverse teams.
Customer-Centric Engineering: Develop lean engineering solutions through rapid, inexpensive experimentation to solve customer needs. Engage with customers and product teams before, during, and after delivery to ensure the right solution is delivered at the right time.
Incremental and Iterative Delivery: Adopt a mindset that favors action and evidence over extensive planning. Utilize a leaning-forward approach to navigate complexity and uncertainty, delivering lean, supportable, and maintainable solutions.
Cross-Functional Collaboration and Integration: Work collaboratively with empowered, cross-functional teams including product management, experience, and delivery. Integrate diverse perspectives to make well-informed decisions that balance feasibility, viability, usability, and value. Foster a collaborative environment that enhances team synergy and innovation.
Advanced Technical Proficiency: Possess expertise in modern software engineering practices and principles, including AI and Agentic SSDLC to deliver daily product deployments using full automation from discovery to production to operations with all quality checks through SSDLC lifecycle. Strive to be a role model, leveraging these techniques to optimize solutioning and product delivery. Be a valuable, flexible, and dedicated team member, supportive of teammates, and focused on quality and tech debt payoff.

Excellent interpersonal and organizational skills, with the ability to handle diverse situations, complex projects, and changing priorities, behaving with passion, empathy, and care.

Qualifications:

Required

A bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, data science, machine learning, or related discipline. Experience is the most relevant factor.
5+ years of experience with most of the following: Angular, React, NodeJS, Python, C#, .NET, Java, SQL/NoSQL, PyTorch, TensorFlow, LangChain, LangGraph, as well as unit testing frameworks.
3+ years of experience building AI/ML and agentic applications, with hands-on GenAI experience across LLM integration (OpenAI, Anthropic, or open-source models), RAG pipelines, prompt engineering, vector databases, evaluations, and AI agent orchestration.
3+ years of experience with cloud-native engineering, using FaaS, PaaS, or micro-services on any of the cloud hyperscalers such as Azure, AWS, or GCP, including their AI/ML services such as Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, or Vertex AI, plus application-level infrastructure-as-code and cost-aware engineering (FinOps accountability).

Prior experience using methodologies & tools such as XP, Lean, DevSecOps, SRE, ADO, GitHub, SonarQube, MLflow, and agentic AI frameworks (e.g. LangFuse, LangSmith, or equivalent multi-agent orchestration tools) etc. to deliver high-quality products rapidly.

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Agentic
jobs.description:
About Xage

Cyberattacks on critical infrastructure, government, and private enterprises are at an all time high – and only growing more urgent with AI. Xage is a global leader in zero trust access and protection at the forefront of solving this pressing issue. We are pioneering a secure tomorrow by empowering organizations worldwide to connect anyone to anything, while delivering unparalleled defense against every cyber threat.

We have built tremendous momentum across governments and commercial enterprises around the world, and it’s just the beginning. Recognized by Forbes as one of America’s Best Startup Employers, Xage prioritizes creativity, collaboration, and innovation in pursuit of our mission.
We are headquartered in Palo Alto, CA and have global teams across North America, EMEA, and APJ.

We’re passionate about solving problems that have positive, real-world consequences for the lives of everyday people. We hope you’ll join us in the fight against cyberattacks and safeguarding critical systems.

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced and visionary Senior Software Engineer
to design and build our next-generation Zero Trust for Agentic AI
platform. As AI agents evolve from sandboxed pilots into autonomous systems capable of executing real-world actions, invoking APIs, and accessing sensitive databases across hybrid cloud and operational technology (OT) environments, security must evolve with them.
In this role, you will build the critical security fabric that moves past simple prompt/output monitoring and into deterministic runtime visibility and control
. You will engineer the gateways, proxies, and identity management systems that protect autonomous AI agents, Large Language Models (LLMs), and enterprise resources from prompt injection, rogue behavior, data leakage, and privilege escalation.

Key Responsibilities

Architect AI Gateways & Sentries:
Design and develop the runtime components (like Xage Agent Sentry and Resource Gateway) to encapsulate AI agents, intercepting and inspecting inputs, outputs, tool calls, and API interactions.
Implement Deterministic Access Controls:
Build jailbreak-proof, identity-based permissioning models and agent entitlements to enforce strict least-privilege access across APIs, SaaS applications, Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, and databases.
Analyze Behavioral Anomalies:
Build intelligent monitoring systems that establish a baseline for normal agent behavior and leverage ML to flag deviations, catching rogue agent actions or privilege escalation attempts before they hit critical infrastructure.
Develop Agent Identity Management:
Create robust, centralized frameworks for agent registration, lifecycle management, and automated credential rotation to eliminate hardcoded secrets and shared service account vulnerabilities.
Build End-to-End Visibility Pipelines:
Engineer high-throughput, tamperproof logging mechanisms to capture and audit every prompt, action, tool call, and resource access for comprehensive governance.
Scale a Distributed Security Fabric:
Ensure security controls deploy seamlessly across multi-cloud, on-premises, and edge/OT environments via a unified, resilient platform.

Required Skills and Qualifications

Technical Requirements

Backend & Systems Engineering:
3-5+ years of experience building high-performance, distributed, and scalable enterprise software (preferred languages: Go, Python, C or C++).
Machine Learning & AI Security:
Strong hands-on experience deploying ML models in production environments. Familiarity with NLP, LLM alignment/guardrails (e.g., Llama Guard, NeMo Guardrails), and implementing low-latency inference at the proxy/gateway level.
AI/LLM Integration & Protocols:
Deep understanding of the Agentic AI lifecycle, tool-calling mechanisms, and emerging integration protocols like MCP (Model Context Protocol)
and REST APIs.
Security & Zero Trust Architecture:
Solid foundation in application security, API gateway design, proxy architectures (e.g., Envoy), identity access management (IAM), and credential management/rotation.
Infrastructure & Edge:
Experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) and deploying applications across hybrid environments (Cloud, SaaS, and Edge/OT).

Soft Skills & Experience

Experience in cybersecurity product development, specifically in AI Security (Securing LLMs/Agents, prompt injection mitigation) is highly preferred.
Strong systems-level thinking with the ability to build predictive boundaries around dynamic, runtime AI behaviors.
Strong communication skills to collaborate with AI researchers, security analysts, and enterprise architecture teams.

Key Business Impacts You Will Deliver

Enable High-Stakes AI Deployment:
Turn risky, sandboxed AI experiments into secure, production-ready enterprise tools.
Mitigate Modern Threats:
Directly block harmful agent behaviors and data exfiltration before they impact the business.
Simplify AI Complexity:
Provide enterprises with a “single pane of glass” view to trust, govern, and audit their autonomous AI workforces.

Location: Palo Alto, CA
Salary Range: $140K - $190K

jobs.description:
Company Description

It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at Intuitive
. As a global leader in robotic-assisted surgery
and minimally invasive care
, our technologies—like the da Vinci surgical system
and Ion
—have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide.

We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world.

The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life.

If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help transform the future of healthcare
, you’ll find your purpose here.

Job Description

Job Duties

Platform Development

Design, build, and maintain both the frontend and backend of a new internal AI-powered platform — taking ownership of features from development through production deployment
Build and maintain integrations between the platform and cloud services, AI APIs, and internal data sources
Write clean, tested, and well-documented code across the full stack (Python backend + React/TypeScript frontend)
Contribute to architectural discussions with guidance from senior engineers — learning to think beyond the feature and consider system design

AI & Automation

Integrate generative AI and LLM capabilities into the platform to help business teams find information faster, answer questions, and automate repetitive workflows
Begin applying agentic and tool-calling patterns with growing independence — supported by senior engineers

Collaboration & Requirements

Partner with business teams to understand workflows and translate them into working software features — with some guidance on scoping and prioritization
Participate actively in design reviews, sprint planning, and retrospectives
Communicate progress, blockers, and tradeoffs clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

Security & Governance

Implement secure authentication and access control (OAuth 2.0 / OIDC) appropriate for sensitive business data
Follow and contribute to data governance practices to ensure the platform handles information responsibly

Engineering Practices

Contribute to and follow team engineering best practices — unit testing, integration testing, code reviews, and documentation
Work confidently within CI/CD pipelines to build, test, and deploy features to production
Use observability and monitoring tools to diagnose issues and understand platform health in production

Iteration & Improvement

Gather and act on real user feedback to iterate on features over time
Balance speed and reliability — shipping incrementally while maintaining production quality standards

Qualifications

Level:
Level:
Junior / Early-Career (1–2 years of professional experience)

Education

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field
Relevant coursework or self-study in: Web Development, Cloud Computing, Databases, Software Engineering, or AI/ML
Equivalent practical experience considered in lieu of degree

Technical Skills

Languages & Frameworks

1–2 years of hands-on Python experience — professional or project-based; exposure to FastAPI or a comparable async framework is a plus
React + TypeScript — has shipped or contributed to UI features in a real or production-like environment
Solid understanding of REST API design and client-server architecture

Cloud & Infrastructure

Working experience with at least one major cloud provider (Azure preferred; AWS or GCP considered) — has deployed or managed cloud resources in a real project

Veza is the pioneer in identity security, purpose-built to answer the fundamental question enterprises face: who can and should take what action on what data. Veza's Access Graph platform maps an organization's entire identity ecosystem across users, groups, roles, policies, permissions, and resources providing deep visibility and control over human, non-human, and agentic identities across SaaS, cloud, on-prem, and custom applications. With over 30 billion access permissions under management, global enterprises including Blackstone, Expedia, and Wynn Resorts trust Veza to manage privileged access monitoring, non-human identity security, access entitlement management, and next-generation identity governance.

Founded in 2020 and headquartered in Redwood City, California, Veza is now part of the ServiceNow family, with the acquisition closing in March 2026. The combination brings together Veza's AI-native Access Graph with ServiceNow's AI Control Tower and agentic workflows, enabling organizations to enforce end-to-end identity security rooted in the principle of least privilege across applications, data, cloud environments, and AI agents. For engineers joining Veza today, this means the scale and resources of an enterprise platform company, with the product velocity and mission-driven focus of a security innovator at a pivotal moment in the industry.

We are looking for a passionate Senior Software Engineer, Backend who will play a key role in designing, developing, and maintaining the next frontier of Agent Identity Security. The team is advancing Agent Identity Security as AI agents and copilots rapidly expand across enterprise systems. Its work includes discovering agents, tracking their actions, and defining access management and runtime authorization capabilities to maintain a strong security posture.

In this role, you will tackle the unique access risks posed by AI agents, contributing to a high-impact startup at the cutting edge of Identity and Access Management. This is an exciting opportunity where your key responsibilities will include:
Architect and Build: Design, develop, and scale a comprehensive identity security solution for AI agents, ensuring it can manage a diverse landscape of agents deployed across different applications and systems.

jobs.description:
Job Summary

General Atomics Aeronautical Systems, Inc. (GA-ASI), an affiliate of General Atomics, is a world leader in proven, reliable remotely piloted aircraft and tactical reconnaissance radars, as well as advanced high-resolution surveillance systems.

This position within Avionics Software is responsible for independently developing real-time embedded software for Remotely Piloted Aircraft. Avionics software applications include distributed real-time fault-tolerant control architectures, electro-mechanical control systems, engine and propulsion system management, power electronics, control networks, datalinks, and other aircraft subsystems and related support equipment.

DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITES:

Independently design, develop, test, and maintain software for flight-critical real-time embedded systems in accordance with appropriate development processes and standards
Independently track status, risks, and issues for assigned tasks
Independently communicate with subject matter experts, cross-functional teams, users, and management throughout the software development lifecycle
Maintain the strict confidentiality of sensitive information
Perform other duties as assigned

We recognize and appreciate the value and contributions of individuals with diverse backgrounds and experiences and welcome all qualified individuals to apply.

Job Qualifications

Typically requires a bachelors or masters degree in computer science, information systems or related discipline and two or more years progressive software development experience with a bachelors degree. May substitute equivalent experience in lieu of education.
Must have a complete understanding of software development concepts, principles, and theory and demonstrate complete understanding and application of programming and analysis concepts.
Must possess the ability to understand new concepts quickly and apply them accurately throughout an evolving environment.
Proficiency with C/C++ is required. Python is desired.
Embedded systems concepts; preemption, multitasking, bare-metal and real-time operating system architectures, compilers, computer processor architectures and memory management
Real-time systems, fault-tolerant systems, control systems, motor control, power electronics
Reading and understanding electrical schematics and datasheets
Embedded communications: SPI, I2C, USART, CANbus, ARINC-429, MIL-STD-1553
Ethernet networks and protocols
Audio and video processing and communications
Development tools and electronic test equipment including in-circuit debuggers/emulators, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, power supplies, and signal generators
Software configuration management tools, such as subversion or git, as well as defect tracking tools, and peer review
Requirements-based software verification at the unit, integration, and system level
Automated software testing tools and continuous integration
Formal software development and test processes; RTCA DO-178C and related standards
Ability to obtain and maintain DoD security clearance is required.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Overview

Being good neighbors – helping people, investing in our communities, and making the world a better place – is who we are at State Farm. It is at the core of how we operate and the reason for our success. We're moving with urgency to become a Next Gen Good Neighbor, with technology that strengthens human connections and enhances the customer experience. As an employee, you'll spend less time navigating systems and more time applying judgment, empathy, and expertise in the moments that matter most.

Responsibilities

Grow Your Skills, Grow Your Potential

The Claims-Engineering team within Enterprise Technology is building the future-state delivery system for one of the largest Claims applications at State Farm. Working in the Engineering department on a DevOps and Infrastructure team, you'll work directly with engineering and business partners to make decisions and drive pace. Your work is the automation that gets application code into the right place, in the right shape, and running the right way. As a member of the Claims-Engineering team you'll be challenged and empowered to grow professionally.

If you're curious about infrastructure, this role puts a lot of it in front of you quickly. The system spans CI/CD pipelines, deployment configuration managed as code and the tooling that generates it, container images and manifests, and the observability and secrets tooling around them, all running on the enterprise's Kubernetes and Red Hat OpenShift on AWS (ROSA) platforms. We’re just getting started on a new platform that you’ll help us build out while working closely with the teams that own the application build process, the application framework, and the underlying infrastructure. We're hiring for aptitude as much as current depth. If you're early in your infrastructure career and want to learn, this team has the scope and the senior engineers to get you there.

Area of Focus:

Build the CI/CD pipelines that deploy containerized Java applications across environments
Write and maintain Kubernetes and OpenShift manifests and deployment configuration
Work on infrastructure as code and on the in-house deployment tooling written in Go, Python, and Bash
Help move deployment configuration toward a GitOps model
Build and patch container base images and application images
Diagnose and fix deployment and environment problems, picking up production support responsibilities as you go
Write runbooks, decision records, and team documentation
Apply skills, tools, security processes, applications, environments, and programming languages to complete assignments with guidance and direction from experienced engineers
Maintain and develop understanding of software engineering topics including version control, CI/CD, containers, and compute environments including Linux and Public Cloud
Leverage inner source best practices to encourage code discoverability and collaboration across the enterprise

Qualifications

We Are Seeking Candidates With:

Containers and Kubernetes: images, pods, services, and deployment configuration (OpenShift or ROSA a strong plus)
CI/CD pipeline experience
Linux fundamentals
Scripting and automation in Python, Bash, or Go
Git and version control workflow
Comfortable reading Java application code and application server logs

Additional Skills:

A real willingness to learn. We're investing in this role, and we care more about where you're headed than about the length of your résumé.
ArgoCD or other GitOps tooling
Infrastructure as code (Terraform)
Observability tooling (Dynatrace, Splunk, Prometheus/Grafana)
Secrets management
AWS fundamentals
Curious. Willing to dig into unfamiliar code and infrastructure, ask questions, and follow a problem all the way down
Collaborative. Works well with cross-functional teams and senior engineers, and says clearly where things stand
Takes ownership of work from development through production
Writes things down. Contributes to runbooks, decision records, and documented processes
Takes code review feedback well and wants to learn from the senior engineers around you

Work Locations
: Bloomington, IL-Corporate, Dunwoody, GA-Park Center Hub, Richardson, TX-CityLine Hub or Tempe, AZ-Marina Heights Hub locations.

Hybrid Work Arrangement:
A “Hybrid” position means selected candidates will be assigned to a facility and will spend some time working both in the office and from home. For Enterprise Technology, a hybrid work arrangement will require approximately 40% in-office time each month, beginning in late 2027.

SPONSORSHIP
: Applicants for this position are required to be eligible to lawfully work in the U.S. immediately; employer will not sponsor applicants for U.S. work authorization (e.g. H-1B visa) for this opportunity.

Our Benefits

Because work-life balance is a priority at State Farm, compensation is based on our standard 38:45-hour work week!

Stay Well! Focus on you and your family’s health with our robust health and wellbeing programs. All medical plans provide 100% coverage for in-network preventative care, AND you and your family have access to vision, dental, telemedicine, 24/7 mental health professionals, and much more!
Develop and Grow! Take advantage of educational benefits like industry leading training programs, top-notch tuition assistance programs, employee resource groups, and mentoring.
Plan Ahead! Plan for those big moments in life with benefits like fertility/IVF/adoption assistance, college coaching, national discount programs, interactive monthly financial workshops, free financial coaching, and more. Build and deliver high-impact software that powers digital experiences for millions of users.

jobs.description:
About The Role

What if the code you write could directly power the AI systems shaping how millions of people interact with technology? We're looking for Back End Developers to design, build, and optimize the server-side systems and APIs that drive cutting-edge AI products — from data pipelines and model-serving infrastructure to scalable microservices that handle real-world traffic at scale.

This is a fully remote, flexible contract role open to engineers across the US. Whether you're a seasoned engineer looking for meaningful project work or a strong developer ready to apply your skills to AI-adjacent infrastructure, this is your chance to build things that matter.

Organization: Alignerr
Type: Hourly Contract
Location: Remote
Commitment: 10–40 hours/week

What You'll Do

Design, develop, and maintain robust back end services, APIs, and data pipelines
Build scalable, high-performance server-side architecture to support AI training and inference workloads
Write clean, well-documented, and testable code following engineering best practices
Integrate with databases, message queues, cloud services, and third-party APIs
Optimize system performance, reliability, and scalability as usage grows
Collaborate asynchronously with distributed teams of engineers, researchers, and product leads
Troubleshoot production issues, conduct code reviews, and contribute to architectural decisions
Work independently on task-based and project-based assignments on your own schedule

Proficient in one or more back end languages — Python, Go, Java, Node.js, Rust, or similar
Solid understanding of RESTful API design, microservices architecture, and distributed systems

Comfortable working with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure
Familiar with version control (Git), CI/CD pipelines, and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes)
Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to debug complex systems independently
Self-motivated, reliable, and effective when working asynchronously without close supervision
Clear communicator who can document decisions and collaborate across time zones

Experience building infrastructure for machine learning or AI systems

Background in performance optimization, caching strategies, or high-throughput systems
Knowledge of authentication, authorization, and security best practices
Experience with serverless architectures or event-driven design patterns
Contributions to open-source projects or a strong portfolio of personal/professional work

Work on cutting-edge AI infrastructure projects alongside leading research labs
Fully remote and flexible — set your own hours and work from anywhere
Freelance autonomy with access to meaningful, technically challenging work

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

Salesforce is hiring Database Distributed Systems Software Engineers. You will work on highly concurrent, distributed systems that support Salesforce's growth. We're looking for people with a strong background in database internals, systems programming, and software engineering.

In this role, you will design and build scalable, resilient software products. You will own work from start to finish, including architecture, design, implementation, monitoring, testing, and product support for large, mission-critical systems. Your work will shape the future of Salesforce.

Key Responsibilities

Lead the design and implementation of complex database features. Focus on advanced transaction management that delivers performance, scalability, consistency, and reliability in distributed systems..
Solve SQL execution challenges to enable transactionally consistent DDL on distributed database systems. Oversee schema evolution and versioning, with consistency and minimal disruption in highly concurrent environments..
Optimize database operations at very large scale. Develop patterns for data integrity, consistency, and efficient data manipulation across distributed datasets..
Build database services on AWS, GCP, or other public cloud platforms..
Take part in the team's on-call rotation to resolve complex problems and keep services available..
Troubleshoot and resolve complex database issues in demanding production environments, with fast recovery and minimal disruption..
Contribute to the roadmap for core database technologies and frameworks, and influence future architectural decisions..

Required Qualifications

BS or higher in Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience.
Strong computer science fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, and distributed systems.
7+ years of software development experience, with significant focus on large-scale, database-intensive, distributed applications.
Deep knowledge of database transaction management, including concurrency control, isolation levels, and distributed transactions.
Experience designing database applications for high-volume, complex data operations, including query tuning and performance analysis for highly concurrent systems.
Strong programming skills in at least one relevant language (for example, Java, Python, or PL/SQL), with a focus on systems-level programming for database interactions.

Preferred Qualifications

MS or PhD in databases or distributed systems.
PostgreSQL development experience, including open-source community contributions.
Experience with the operational challenges and lifecycle management of large-scale distributed database systems.
Familiarity with cloud platforms (for example, AWS, Azure, GCP) and containerization (for example, Docker, Kubernetes) in production, database-focused settings.
Knowledge of database performance tuning, monitoring tools, and observability patterns for distributed database systems.
Experience with database-as-a-service platforms and their underlying distributed architecture.

Join us and help shape the future of our database infrastructure. If you need an accommodation during the application process, let us know and we'll work with you.

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

jobs.description:
About Xage

Cyberattacks on critical infrastructure, government, and private enterprises are at an all time high – and only growing more urgent by the day. Xage is a global leader in zero trust access and protection at the forefront of solving this pressing issue. We are pioneering a secure tomorrow by empowering organizations worldwide to connect anyone to anything, while delivering unparalleled defense against every cyber threat.

We have built tremendous momentum across governments and commercial enterprises around the world, and it’s just the beginning. Recognized by Forbes as one of America’s Best Startup Employers, Xage prioritizes creativity, collaboration, and innovation in pursuit of our mission. We are headquartered in Palo Alto, CA and have global teams across North America and EMEA.

We’re passionate about solving problems that have positive, real-world consequences for the lives of everyday people. We hope you’ll join us in the fight against cyberattacks and safeguarding critical infrastructure.

About the Role

We are seeking a Senior Runtime & Systems Engineer
to build the runtime security layer powering Agent Sentry
, the enforcement plane of our Zero Trust AI Gateway platform.

While traditional AI security focuses on inspecting prompts and responses, Agent Sentry provides runtime visibility and control for autonomous AI agents wherever they execute—across Linux, macOS, and Windows environments. It monitors and governs agent activity including prompts, tool calls, API requests, generated outputs, filesystem access, process execution, shell/PowerShell activity, and agent-to-agent communications.

In this role, you will design and productionize OS-level interception, runtime monitoring, sandboxing, identity controls, and tamper-resistant audit infrastructure to secure AI agents operating across enterprise environments.

You will work across systems engineering, operating system security, distributed infrastructure, and zero-trust architecture to build the foundation for secure autonomous AI deployments.

Key Responsibilities

Cross-Platform Runtime Security & Sandboxing

Build runtime monitoring and interception across Linux, macOS, and Windows using technologies such as eBPF, Endpoint Security Framework, ETW, and OS-level security APIs.
Capture and analyze process execution, filesystem activity, network events, and agent behaviors.
Develop secure agent isolation using containers, OS-native sandboxes, and lightweight virtualization (containerd, runc, Firecracker, Wasm).
Design runtime controls to prevent unauthorized agent actions and reduce security risks.

Agent Identity, Lifecycle & Policy Enforcement

Build agent identity infrastructure supporting registration, authentication, cryptographic attestation, short-lived credentials, and automated credential rotation.
Develop lifecycle governance for agent onboarding, authorization, monitoring, and decommissioning.
Integrate runtime telemetry with policy engines to enable real-time access decisions, inline enforcement, and automated containment.

Required Qualifications & Expertise

3-5+ years
building production security, systems, or infrastructure software.
Strong programming skills in Go, C/C++
with experience developing high-performance, security-critical systems.
Experience with OS internals, runtime security, kernel instrumentation, security telemetry, sandboxing, or container isolation.
Strong understanding of host security, privilege escalation, runtime exploitation, and endpoint threats.
Experience with eBPF, Linux kernel development, Windows Kernel, or macOS security frameworks.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience building EDR/XDR, runtime security, endpoint protection, or cloud workload security platforms.
Experience securing AI agents, LLM applications, or autonomous systems.
Familiarity with Kubernetes security, service mesh, and cloud-native security.
Familiarity with zero-trust architectures, identity systems, PKI, mTLS, SPIFFE/SPIRE, OAuth/OIDC, and credential management.

Perks

Salary Range: $140,000 – $170,000 p/yr + Equity
Full health, dental, vision insurance
We will process visa transfers and immigration

Work with founders and executives closely and participate in all aspects of company building
Early stage opportunity in a massive sized market with proven traction and growing rapidly

YOUR OPPORTUNITY

We have an exciting Automation Engineering Supervisor opportunity in our Guymon processing facility. In this highly impactful role, you will lead a team of automation specialists who are responsible for supporting all automation equipment installations, routine preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, and repairs in a fresh pork processing facility that processes over 22,000 animals per day. This position provides oversight and supervision to ensure activities and tasks are completed and improved and maximizes department efficiencies, workflow optimization, and staffing deployment. Ensures all maintenance and preventive maintenance activities conducted by the automation team adhere to all workplace and food safety protocols.

About Us

At Seaboard Foods, we create the most sought-after pork. A top U.S. pork producer/processor and leading exporter to 30+ countries, we are committed to bringing excellence to the table, seeking a better way to produce wholesome pork, and connecting every step between our farms and family tables. More than 5,400 employees in five states work on our farms, feed mills, and processing plant to produce Prairie Fresh® pork, ensuring the well-being of our animals, the environment, our employees, and the communities we call home. Our commitment to sustainability is reflected in our renewable gas projects on our farms creating renewable energy. Owned by Seaboard Corporation, a Fortune 500 company, and nominated as one of the “Best Places to Work” by Kansas City’s Business Journal, we have a dynamic culture where our employees can contribute and understand why they matter.

Responsibilities

Supervise, lead, and develop a team of Automation Technicians responsible for maintaining, troubleshooting, repairing, and supporting industrial automation, electrical control, and robotic systems throughout the facility.
Provide technical leadership and hands-on troubleshooting support for complex equipment failures involving programmable logic controllers (PLCs), human-machine interfaces (HMIs), industrial robotics, variable-frequency drives (VFDs), servo systems, instrumentation, industrial communication networks, and associated electrical and electronic control systems.
Direct, coordinate, and verify the completion of preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance activities on automated equipment and control systems to ensure safe, reliable, and efficient operation.
Investigate recurring equipment failures, automation-related downtime, and process-performance issues. Lead root-cause analysis and coordinate the implementation of corrective actions to improve equipment reliability and reduce unplanned downtime.
Provide technical oversight of PLC programming, HMI configurations, robotic systems, control-system modifications, and automation-related troubleshooting to ensure work is performed accurately, consistently, and in accordance with established engineering standards.
Ensure Automation Technicians maintain accurate maintenance records, troubleshooting documentation, equipment configurations, program backups, and other technical documentation necessary to support reliable system operation and future maintenance activities.
Ensure all automation maintenance, troubleshooting, and installation activities comply with applicable electrical codes, machine-safety requirements, established procedures, and company safety policies, including lockout/tagout and electrical safe-work practices.
Maintain effective communication with plant operations, maintenance leadership, engineering personnel, and management regarding equipment conditions, maintenance priorities, operational disruptions, and corrective-action progress.
Manage employee work schedules, staffing requirements, attendance, timekeeping, and overall work performance to ensure adequate technical coverage and effective utilization of departmental resources.
Promote accountability, technical excellence, continuous reliability improvement, and a proactive maintenance culture within the Automation Department.

CORE COMPETENCIES FOR SUCCESS IN ALL ROLES:
instills trust, communicates effectively, action-oriented, ensures accountability, and drives results.

Technical Leadership

Demonstrates strong technical knowledge of electrical, automation, PLC, robotic, and industrial control systems. Provides effective technical guidance, supports complex troubleshooting activities, and develops the technical capabilities of team members to ensure safe, reliable, and efficient equipment operation.

Decision Quality & Problem Solving

Makes sound, timely decisions using technical knowledge, analytical thinking, and systematic troubleshooting methods. Evaluates complex equipment failures, identifies root causes, prioritizes corrective actions, and implements effective solutions to improve equipment reliability and minimize operational disruptions.

Develops Talent & Ensures Accountability

Leads, coaches, and develops technical personnel through clear expectations, effective work assignments, performance feedback, and ongoing training. Holds team members accountable for work quality, safety, productivity, and adherence to established procedures while promoting continuous improvement and technical excellence.

Qualifications

Required:

Associate degree or two-year technical degree in Electrical Engineering Technology, Electronics Technology, Industrial Automation, Mechatronics, Electrical Engineering, or a closely related technical field with a minimum of three (3) years of relevant industrial automation or electrical controls experience; or
A minimum of five (5) years of progressively responsible experience in industrial automation, electrical controls, robotics, or industrial control systems in lieu of formal technical education.
Strong technical knowledge of industrial electrical systems, motor controls, programmable logic controllers (PLCs), human-machine interfaces (HMIs), variable-frequency drives (VFDs), industrial instrumentation, and automated equipment.
Demonstrated proficiency in PLC programming, troubleshooting, and diagnostics, including the ability to interpret, analyze, and modify control logic to identify equipment failures and implement corrective actions.
Working knowledge of industrial communication networks, including Ethernet-based industrial protocols, networked control devices, and troubleshooting communication-related equipment failures.
Working knowledge of industrial robotics, robotic controllers, safety systems, servo drives, motion control, and associated automation equipment.
Ability to read, interpret, and troubleshoot electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, control-panel drawings, process and instrumentation diagrams, equipment manuals, and other engineering documentation.
Strong understanding of electrical theory, control circuits, instrumentation, feedback devices, and industrial automation principles.
Ability to use electrical and electronic diagnostic equipment, including digital multimeters, clamp meters, insulation-resistance testers, and other applicable troubleshooting and calibration tools.
Demonstrated ability to independently diagnose complex electrical and automation system failures, apply structured troubleshooting methods, identify root causes, and develop effective corrective actions.
Ability to establish maintenance priorities, assign technical work, evaluate work quality, and coordinate personnel and resources to support equipment reliability and production requirements.
Ability to train, coach, and develop technical personnel, evaluate individual performance, and ensure accountability for assigned responsibilities.
Working knowledge of industrial electrical safety practices, hazardous-energy control, machine safeguarding, and applicable electrical codes and safety standards.
Strong written and verbal communication skills in the English language, including the ability to communicate technical information effectively with technicians, engineers, maintenance personnel, operations, contractors, and management.

Preferred

Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electrical Engineering Technology, Automation Engineering, Mechatronics, or a closely related technical discipline.
Previous supervisory or leadership experience directing electrical, automation, instrumentation, or industrial maintenance personnel.
Advanced experience programming, configuring, and troubleshooting Allen-Bradley/Rockwell Automation PLCs, HMIs, drives, and associated industrial control systems.
Experience with industrial robotic systems, robotic programming, motion control, safety controllers, and automated manufacturing equipment.
Experience with industrial networking technologies and protocols, including EtherNet/IP, PROFINET, PROFIBUS, Modbus TCP, and other industrial communication systems.
Experience configuring, maintaining, and troubleshooting supervisory control and data acquisition (SCADA) and HMI systems, including platforms such as AVEVA/Wonderware, Ignition, and Rockwell Automation FactoryTalk View SE/ME, as well as industrial data acquisition, process monitoring, and control-system integration.
Experience supporting equipment installations, system modifications, commissioning, control-system upgrades, and engineering improvement projects.
Experience utilizing equipment performance data, downtime analysis, root-cause analysis, and preventive or predictive maintenance strategies to improve equipment reliability.

The position combines hands-on firmware and software development with mentoring responsibilities and occasional customer-facing technical support, contributing directly to the performance, reliability, and evolution of cutting-edge embedded systems.

Design and develop embedded software features based on high-level customer and product line requirements.

Collaborate effectively with cross-site and global teams, coordinating development activities and sharing knowledge across locations.

University degree in Electrical Engineering or Computer Science, or an equivalent technical discipline.
8+ years of experience in embedded software systems, with flexibility to consider 5+ years for particularly strong candidates.
Expert-level proficiency in C and C++ programming for embedded systems.
Proven experience designing and developing embedded firmware and software features from high-level requirements.

jobs.title: Functional Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Obsidian Systems is a software engineering consultancy that builds production systems for capital markets and other regulated industries. Our clients include market infrastructure providers, national exchanges, and global financial institutions. Much of our work today centers on the Canton Network, the privacy-enabled blockchain adopted by major capital markets institutions, where Obsidian is one of the most experienced engineering firms in the ecosystem.

We're a remote-first, globally distributed team that values ownership, curiosity, and clear communication. We believe the best ideas come from people who ask difficult questions, take responsibility for their work, and collaborate openly to solve challenging problems.

**About the Role**

We're looking for a **Functional Software Engineer** to join our engineering team and contribute to challenging client projects across our technical domains. You'll design, develop, and maintain software using functional programming principles, working with engineers and client teams to turn complex requirements into robust, maintainable solutions. Depending on the project, your work may involve backend systems, domain modelling, distributed systems, financial infrastructure, blockchain applications, or developer tooling.

This role is suited to an engineer who enjoys reasoning about complex systems, values strong types and clear abstractions, and sees software development as more than simply making code work. Knowledge in every technology is not necessary. We value strong engineering fundamentals, a willingness to learn, and the ability to apply sound technical judgment to unfamiliar problems.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Design, implement, test, and maintain reliable software using functional programming principles.
* Develop clear, composable, and maintainable solutions to complex engineering problems.
* Apply strong typing, domain modelling, and abstraction to improve software correctness and reliability.
* Collaborate with engineers, technical leads, and client stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver effective solutions.
* Contribute to the design and architecture of systems, making thoughtful trade-offs between correctness, simplicity, performance, and maintainability.
* Write automated tests and use appropriate techniques to validate system behaviour.
* Review code, share technical knowledge, and contribute to engineering standards.
* Investigate and resolve complex technical issues across existing systems.
* Communicate technical decisions clearly and explain trade-offs to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Adapt to different client environments, codebases, and technical challenges.
* Contribute to continuous improvement across our engineering practices, tools, and delivery processes.

**Key Requirements**
--------------------

* 5+ years of professional experience developing and delivering production software.
* Strong understanding of software engineering fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, testing, and software design.
* Experience with functional programming, either professionally or through substantial projects.
* Ability to reason about complex problems and translate requirements into well-structured software.
* Strong debugging and problem-solving skills.
* Commitment to code quality, correctness, and maintainability.
* Ability to communicate effectively and collaborate with other engineers.
* Willingness to learn new technologies and work across different technical environments.

**Preferred Requirements:**

* Experience with Haskell, Scala, OCaml, F#, Clojure, or another functional programming language.
* Familiarity with type systems, algebraic data types, pattern matching, and immutable data structures.
* Experience with strongly typed domain modelling and functional design patterns.
* Exposure to distributed systems, concurrent programming, or backend infrastructure.
* Experience in blockchain, financial infrastructure, capital markets, or other domains where correctness and reliability are particularly important.
* Familiarity with property-based testing and other techniques for validating complex software behaviour.
* Experience with Nix or reproducible development environments.
* Experience working in an engineering consultancy or collaborating directly with client teams.

**How We Work**
---------------

At Obsidian Systems, we believe great work comes from thoughtful people who take ownership, communicate openly, and enjoy solving difficult problems together. These principles guide how we work every day.

Own Your Work, Protect Your Team

* We take full ownership of our responsibilities while supporting the people around us. We believe accountability creates trust, and clear ownership allows teams to move quickly without stepping on one another's work.

Don't Settle for Superficial

* We aim to understand problems deeply rather than treating symptoms. We ask questions, challenge assumptions, and make unknowns explicit so we can build durable solutions instead of temporary fixes.

Be Honest Proactively

* We communicate openly and early. Raising risks before they become problems helps our team and our clients make better decisions. We value transparency over avoiding uncomfortable conversations.

Get to It

* Many of the challenges we solve have never been solved before. We don't wait for perfection; we start, learn, iterate, and move forward. Progress comes from taking the next concrete step.

If you're excited by continuous learning and playing a real role in building the next generation of financial market infrastructure, you'll feel at home at Obsidian.

**AnewHealth is one of the** **nation’s leading pharmacy care management companies that specializes in caring for people with the most complex, chronic needs—wherever they call home. Established in 2023 through the combination of ExactCare and Tabula Rasa HealthCare, we provide a suite of solutions that includes comprehensive pharmacy services; full-service pharmacy benefit management; and specialized support services for Program of All-Inclusive Care for the Elderly. With over 1,400 team members, we care for more than 100,000 people across all 50 states.**

**Job Details**

AnewHealth is seeking a mid-level Software Engineer to develop and maintain software on our existing Electronic Health Record (EHR) platform using Ruby. This role will make changes to the platform across both front-end and back-end layers, balancing defect resolution with new feature development in an agile environment. The ideal candidate has strong SQL skills, is comfortable working within a mature, mission-critical codebase, and brings prior exposure to development in a healthcare setting.

**Responsibilities**

* Build and modify user-facing views and interactions on the front end, and implement business logic, services, and data access on the back end.
* **Defect Resolution —** Triage, debug, and resolve defects in the production EHR application, performing root-cause analysis and delivering durable fixes.
* **New Feature Development —** Design and build new features and enhancements within the existing platform architecture, from requirements through implementation and testing.
* **Data & SQL —** Write, optimize, and troubleshoot complex SQL queries against the platform's relational database(s), including work involving clinical and patient-related data structures.
* **Agile Delivery —** Participate in sprint planning, daily standups, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
* Commit to and deliver against sprint timelines, collaborating closely with product owners, QA, and other engineers on the team.
* **Quality & Compliance —** Write and maintain automated tests, participate in code reviews, and follow secure coding practices appropriate for a system handling protected health information (PHI).
* **AI-Enabled Development —** Use AI tools to accelerate technical documentation, generate and refactor code, build supporting resources (test data, scripts, diagrams), and assist with code execution and validation, while ensuring appropriate review of AI-assisted output.

* Experience developing new features within an existing, mature codebase.
* Exposure to software development in a healthcare environment, ideally involving an EHR or other clinical system.
* Working experience in an agile/scrum environment, including familiarity with tools such as Jira or Azure DevOps.

This is a remote position.

Medical, dental and vision coverage are effective 1st of the month following date of hire**.*

We share our appreciation for our team members regularly during all-hands, a workplace appreciation tool, regular shoutouts in our Teams channels, social media, amongst more. Our remote-first work environment blends work and life without the added pressure of commuting or feeling guilty about leaving early to visit the dentist.

Come work with us and learn what teamwork and integrity blended with an emphasis on well-being and balance can do for your career and lifestyle!

We're an AI-first engineering team, and we treat that as a discipline, not a shortcut. Every engineer here works with agentic coding tools — Claude Code and GitHub CoPilot are key drivers in our daily work, which changes the shape of the job:

* You'll spend more of your time on design, decomposition and review, and less on typing. Agents handle much of the implementation; you own the architecture, the verification and everything that ships.

* Judgment matters more, not less. Knowing when to hand work to an agent — and when not to — is a skill we hire for and grow.
* Skillable's whole business is proving skills by doing. We hold our own work to the same standard: AI-assisted or not, it isn't done until it's verified.

The **Software Engineer** is responsible for owning features within the designated team - designing, building, and maintaining both server-side logic and infrastructure as well as client-side logic and interfaces that are key to our custom labs and related applications. Develop and optimize APIs, databases, UIs, design systems, and libraries written in either C# or JavaScript/TypeScript. As a **Software Engineer II** on an engineering squad at Ellevation, you'll build and operate features that directly shape how educators manage English Learner programs across thousands of school districts. You'll work across a full-stack environment — React on the frontend, C#/.NET Core or Python on the backend — and you'll own your work end-to-end: design, build, ship, and keep it running.

At this level, you're not just executing tickets. You're expected to bring a proposed path when you surface a problem, close open questions by building rather than debating, and leave the systems you touch in better shape than you found them. You'll be a real contributor to how the squad works — in design discussions, in code review, and in the day-to-day quality bar the team holds together.

### **About You:**

You might be a great fit if you:

* You bring a proposed path along with the problem — you've found that framing a solution, even a rough one, moves things forward faster than waiting for the perfect answer.
* When something is blocking the team, your instinct is to build the smallest thing that answers the question rather than debate it — a spike, a script, a quick prototype.
* You share real opinions in design discussions — on tradeoffs, complexity, and risk — because you believe teams make better decisions when people actually weigh in.
* You take code review seriously in both directions: you ask until you understand before approving, and you welcome the same rigor on your own work.
* You stay engaged past the merge — on cleanup, follow-up bugs, and alerts that trace back to what you shipped — because you care about the full lifecycle, not just the delivery moment.
* You use AI tools to move faster, and you read and own everything that goes out under your name.

### **What You’ll Do:**

* Build and ship product features across React, .NET Core/Python, and supporting infrastructure — from design through operation.
* Bring concrete tradeoffs to design discussions — performance, complexity, blast radius, time-to-ship — so the squad is making decisions based on real costs.
* Close open questions by spiking, scripting, or prototyping, keeping the team moving rather than waiting on answers that could be found by building.
* Operate what you build: instrument it, respond to alerts, and close the loop on issues that surface after release.
* Review code thoughtfully — ask questions, push for improvements when they matter, and welcome the same on your own PRs.
* Pick up improvements you notice along the way — tech debt, alerting gaps, missing tests — without waiting to be asked.

### **What You’ll Bring:**

* 2–4 years shipping production software, with enough end-to-end ownership to know what "done" actually means.
* Fluency in at least one frontend JS framework (React/Vue/Angular), and a strongly typed language (C#/.NET/Python/Go) — and comfort learning across the stack where the work takes you.
* Experience naming tradeoffs concretely rather than just expressing preferences — you've been in design discussions where your perspective shaped the outcome.
* Engineering habits — testing, observability, careful review — that reflect care for the long term, not just the current ticket.
* Some experience operating what you've built: you've debugged production, you know what good instrumentation looks like.
* Some experience with how code gets deployed and runs in production — you understand the path from commit to live, and you know what good instrumentation looks like.

At Ellevation, we believe in the power of education and the educators who make it possible. Joining our team means:

* Working on meaningful challenges that directly impact English Learners.

* Collaborating in a supportive, cross-functional environment.
* Growing personally and professionally as part of a high-performing team.

**Frontend:** React (with ongoing migration from legacy systems)

**Infrastructure:** AWS, Terraform, CI/CD with Jenkins, Docker  
**Developer Experience:** Internal tooling, repo templates, CI/CD workflows, container-based dev

The salary range for this role is $125,000 to $145,000 commensurate with candidate experience and internal parity. Our philosophy is that the full range is indicative of growth during employment. In addition, we provide comprehensive benefits to all full-time employees.
