jobs.title: Backend Engineer, Agent Infrastructure
jobs.description:
The role

Specter's agents run unattended on customer data overnight, on schedule, and on demand. They read general ledgers, query banks, post journal entries, and send messages on behalf of finance teams. The infrastructure under them - orchestration, retries, observability, sandboxing, cost control - is the difference between a demo and a system a CFO trusts with the books.

This role builds that infrastructure. It's one of the highest-leverage engineering roles at the company, because everything else in the product runs on top of what you build.

What you'll do

Build and own the agent runtime: scheduling, queueing, tool execution, retries, idempotency, audit trails, replay. Long-running, partially-failing, non-deterministic workloads are the default, not the edge case.
Design the observability stack. Every action an agent takes should be inspectable, replayable, and explainable to a non-technical reviewer six months later during an audit.
Make agent runs cheap and fast. Token spend, latency, and parallelism all matter, and they trade off against each other in non-obvious ways.
Build the integration layer that connects agents to ERPs, banks, spreadsheets, and the dozens of source systems customers actually use. Each one is different. Most of them are old. Many are inconsistent, under-documented, rate-limited, or shaped by customer-specific configuration.
Set the standard for production reliability across the engineering org. You're the person who decides what "ready to ship" means for agent code.

What we look for

Strong backend engineer. Python, Postgres, async, queues, distributed systems. You've debugged something that only fails in production at 3am, and you can talk about what you learned.
You think in terms of correctness and recovery, not just happy paths. Idempotency, exactly-once, at-least-once - you know the difference and when each matters.
Comfort with LLM-shaped workloads: non-deterministic outputs, partial failures, long-running tasks, retries that have to be careful about side effects.

Nice to have

Experience with vector stores and graph databases.
Prior work on agentic systems and ETL.
Experience with banking, ERP, or other integrations related to the finance stack.

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Summary

The Data Engineer is a hands - on technical role at the delivery core of TDIndustries' data platform build - out. This is not a support or maintenance role - it is an engineering role with direct accountability for building the data pipelines, lakehouse architecture, and data products that the business depends on for decisions, analytics, and AI capabilities.

The right candidate brings deep, practical expertise in Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric, and dbt, and applies that expertise to design and deliver pipelines and data products that are performant, well - governed, and built to last. They understand how to translate architecture from blueprint to production, write code that others can maintain, and build frameworks and standards that make the team faster over time. They are curious about where data engineering is heading - particularly the intersection of data pipelines and AI - driven workloads - and bring that curiosity back to the team in practical ways.

This is a Mid - Senior Individual Contributor (Hands - On) role that works closely with the Sr. Solution Architect and Data Product Managers, contributing meaningfully to architectural decisions while owning engineering execution. It is the right role for someone who wants to grow into a technical lead and eventually take ownership of the data engineering capability as the DAI function scales.

Essential Duties

Data Pipeline Engineering & Delivery
Design, build, and maintain production - grade data pipelines that ingest, transform, and deliver data across the medallion architecture (Bronze / Silver / Gold) on Snowflake and Microsoft Fabric.
Implement ELT/ETL patterns using dbt as the primary transformation layer, writing modular, tested, well - documented models that serve as the foundation for data products.
Develop and maintain data pipelines supporting batch, micro - batch, and streaming ingestion across enterprise source systems - including Dynamics 365, Procore, Workday, IoT, and field operations platforms.
Translate solution architectures designed by the Sr. Solution Architect into engineered, production - ready implementations - bridging the gap between architecture intent and delivery reality.
Own pipeline reliability - monitor, alert on, and remediate data pipeline failures proactively, ensuring data products meet their SLAs.

Lakehouse Architecture & Data Modeling
Build and maintain data models within the lakehouse platform, applying Kimball dimensional modeling, Data Vault, or OBT patterns as appropriate for the use case and consumption layer.
Implement and enforce medallion architecture standards across the data platform, ensuring Bronze, Silver, and Gold layers are clearly defined, properly governed, and fit - for - purpose.
Develop reusable data assets - conformed dimensions, shared fact tables, and domain - specific data products - that serve multiple analytics and AI consumers without duplication.
Contribute to data product design, providing engineering input on schema, SLAs, lineage, and consumption interfaces alongside Data Product Managers and the Solution Architect.
Standards, Frameworks & Engineering Excellence
Build and maintain reusable engineering frameworks, templates, and patterns - for pipeline design, dbt project structure, testing strategy, and deployment - that bring standardization and speed to the team's delivery cadence.
Define and enforce data engineering best practices: code review standards, branching strategies, testing requirements, documentation expectations, and deployment patterns.
Establish and maintain data quality tests within dbt and the broader pipeline stack, ensuring data products are validated before they reach analytics and AI consumers.
Contribute to architecture decision records (ADRs) and technical documentation that build institutional knowledge and enable the team to scale without key - person dependency.

Data - Driven AI Pipeline Support
Build and maintain data pipelines that support AI and ML workloads - including feature engineering pipelines, embedding generation pipelines, and data feeds for RAG architectures on Snowflake Cortex.
Stay current with the evolving intersection of data engineering and AI - driven platforms - Snowflake Cortex, Microsoft Fabric's AI capabilities, dbt Semantic Layer - and bring grounded, practical recommendations to the team.
Evaluate emerging tools and patterns as the data - driven AI landscape evolves, recommending best - in - class options based on fit with TD's platform and requirements rather than novelty.
Team Capability & Mentorship
Guide and upskill team members on Snowflake - based data engineering - sharing knowledge on performance optimization, data modeling patterns, cost management, and pipeline design.
Actively participate in design and code reviews, providing constructive, evidence - based feedback that raises the technical quality of the team's output.
Contribute to hiring and technical assessment as the data engineering team scales, helping identify candidates with the depth and mindset the team needs.
Model engineering habits that the team should adopt - clean code, strong testing, clear documentation, and a continuous improvement mindset.
Perform other duties as required.

Minimum Requirements

8-10 years of hands - on data engineering experience, with demonstrated depth in Snowflake and modern ELT/ETL practices - this is a firm floor; candidates without this will not be considered.
Production - grade dbt experience - not proof - of - concept or side - project exposure, but experience building and maintaining dbt projects in enterprise environments.
Demonstrated experience building data products on a lakehouse architecture, applying medallion architecture patterns at production scale.
Proven track record of building reusable engineering frameworks, pipeline templates, or standards that improved team delivery speed and consistency.
Experience working in environments with multiple enterprise source systems (ERP, CRM, HCM, or field operations platforms) and complex integration patterns.
Evidence of mentoring or upskilling peers - formal or informal; this role is expected to grow into a technical lead.
Experience with AI - adjacent data engineering (feature pipelines, Cortex, embeddings) is a significant advantage.
Experience in construction, building services, facilities management, or a similarly operationally complex industry is a plus - familiarity with project - based business data is directly relevant.
Business context awareness - understands that pipelines serve business decisions; builds with the consumer's needs in mind, not just technical correctness.
Engineering craftsmanship - writes clean, tested, well - documented code; treats data pipelines as production software, not scripts.
Standards - driven - instinctively builds for reuse and repeatability; resists one - off solutions when a pattern would serve the team better.
Adaptability - tracks where the data engineering discipline is heading, especially as AI capabilities reshape what pipelines need to do, and adapts without chasing hype.
Collaborative depth - partners effectively with architects, product managers, and governance leads; not a siloed executor.
Constructive ownership - identifies problems early, surfaces them clearly, and drives resolution rather than waiting for direction.
Growth orientation - energized by the opportunity to grow into technical leadership as the DAI function scales.

Core Platform (Required - In - Depth, Hands - On Proficiency)
Snowflake - data modeling, Snowpark, dynamic tables, streams and tasks, data sharing, query optimization, cost management, and security configuration. This is a firm requirement; candidates without deep hands - on Snowflake experience will not be considered.
Microsoft Fabric - Fabric Lakehouse, OneLake, Data Warehouse, Dataflows Gen2, Data Factory pipelines, Fabric notebooks, and Eventstream; working proficiency required.
dbt - model design, modular project structure, testing (schema, data, custom), documentation, incremental strategies, and dbt Semantic Layer; deep proficiency required.
Power BI - understanding of semantic model design and how downstream BI consumption shapes upstream data modeling decisions.

Data Engineering Stack
Python - data pipeline scripting, Snowpark development, and automation; strong proficiency required.
SQL - advanced query writing, window functions, CTEs, performance tuning; expert - level proficiency required.
Azure ecosystem - Azure Data Factory, Azure Event Hubs, Azure Blob Storage, and Azure Key Vault; working proficiency in the context of data platform integration.
Git and CI/CD - version control discipline, branching strategies, and deployment automation for data pipeline code.

Data - Driven AI & Emerging Capabilities
Snowflake Cortex - Cortex Analyst, Cortex Semantic Views, and Snowflake ML Functions for AI - grounded data pipelines.
Familiarity with feature engineering patterns, embedding pipelines, and vector store integration for RAG - based AI workloads is a meaningful advantage.
Awareness of how the dbt Semantic Layer, Snowflake Horizon, and Microsoft Fabric's AI services intersect with data engineering delivery.

jobs.title: Software Engineer II
jobs.description:
At ProService, we exist to empower employers to succeed in Hawai?i. More than 3,000 local businesses rely on us for payroll, HR, and benefits, and many run their day on tools like Toast, QuickBooks Online, and NetSuite. When those systems talk cleanly to ours, a restaurant owner closes payroll without re-keying hours. When they don’t, a small business loses time it doesn’t have.

This role owns that connection. You’ll build and run the integrations marketplace that links our customers’ business systems to our HR platform, blending strong engineering with real product ownership. Success looks like customers connecting in minutes, data that stays accurate without manual work, and problems fixed before anyone has to report them.

**IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL**

* Design, build, and launch integrations with platforms like Toast, QuickBooks Online, and NetSuite using OAuth 2.0, webhooks, and polling
* Own the integrations marketplace end to end, including the catalog, connect and disconnect flows, connection health, and a roadmap prioritized with Product
* Architect reusable serverless patterns on AWS (Lambda, EventBridge, SQS, DynamoDB) in Python, TypeScript, and React/Next.js so each integration ships faster than the last
* Partner directly with customers on bespoke integrations with ProService APIs, and with vendor developer programs on sandbox access, certification, and API changes
* Build monitoring and alerting that catches sync failures before customers notice
* Uphold code quality through testing, code reviews, and CI/CD, and support production reliability through on-call rotations

**IS THIS ROLE RIGHT FOR YOU?**

This is an ownership role, not a ticket queue. You’ll ship at least one production-ready integration per quarter and keep owning it after launch, including joining the on-call rotation to resolve critical issues within hours. You’ll also talk directly with customers and partners to shape what gets built next. These expectations are not optional — they’re the job. You’ll share them with a team that reviews each other’s code and treats incidents as chances to learn, not to assign blame.

The role also takes patience. Partner APIs change, certifications move at their own pace, and many decisions are judgment calls between fast and durable. The team works on Hawai?i Standard Time, so Southern California candidates should expect a workday that starts mid-morning and runs into the early evening.

**WHAT YOU’LL BRING TO THE TEAM**

You’ve shipped production-grade software in a SaaS or product-driven environment, and you’ve built third-party integrations that stay reliable. That means experience with OAuth 2.0 token lifecycle, webhooks, pagination, data mapping, and vendor API versioning. You’re fluent in AWS serverless, Python, TypeScript, React/Next.js, and Git-based Agile workflows. Accounting, POS, time and labor, or payroll familiarity is a strong plus. So is experience with partner certification programs or with AI/LLM APIs for data mapping.

**You’re probably a fit if:**

* **You enjoy the detective work of making systems agree.** *You trace a mismatched record through logs, payloads, and mappings to its root cause, so the customer’s numbers line up every time after.*
* **You make sound calls between fast and durable.** *When an API change collides with a deadline, you weigh a quick patch against a retry-safe fix and choose the path that keeps customer data safe.*
* **You keep your commitments when priorities compete.** *You juggle a new build, a production fix, and a partner certification, and everyone waiting on you knows when their piece is coming.*
* **You adjust quickly when the ground shifts.** *When a vendor deprecates an endpoint mid-sprint, you re-plan and keep customers connected without them noticing.*
* **You translate between technical and non-technical worlds.** *You explain trade-offs in plain language and bring Product, Support, and customers in early, so what you ship solves the real problem.*

**WORK LOCATION**

**Honolulu, Hawaii — Hybrid | Orange County or Los Angeles, CA — Remote**

We welcome applications from candidates based in Hawaii, who would work a hybrid schedule out of our Honolulu office, as well as fully remote candidates based in Orange County or Los Angeles. Hawaii-based candidates are preferred, followed by candidates in Orange County. Remote candidates must be available during Hawaii Standard Time (HST / UTC-10) business hours.

Hawaii (Hybrid): In office Tuesday – Thursday | Option for Remote Monday & Friday  
Southern California (Remote): Hours: Hawaii Standard Time (HST / UTC-10)

**COMPENSATION**

The base compensation for this position is $110,000.00 – $137,000.00 per year depending on experience and qualifications.

**WHY PROSERVICE**

ProService is a Hawaii-based PEO combining payroll, HR, and benefits expertise with purpose-built technology — all backed by the best local service in the islands. Backed by Silver Lake and recognized as one of Hawai?i’s Best Places to Work for 20 consecutive years, we’re a team of high performers united by one mission: Empowering Employers to Succeed in Hawaii.

* **A PROhana unlike any other.** We assume the best in each other, give feedback focused on what’s right—not who’s right—and show up every day. This isn’t just a workplace. It’s a community.
* **Do work that matters.** You’ll see exactly how your contributions move the needle—meaningful problems, real decisions, and a seat at the table.
* **Grow without a ceiling.** Internal roles post first, and we reimburse certifications, conferences, and memberships. Your growth is our growth.
* **Compete, collaborate, and win together.** High expectations, real accountability, and a team of experts ready to help you push through any obstacle.
* **Total rewards built around your whole life.** Fully paid healthcare, 401(k) matching, paid parental leave, student loan assistance, employee assistance programs, and paid time off—just to name a few.

Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

### **ABOUT THE TEAM**

The Payload Integrations team owns everything that connects to the vehicle beyond the base platform. This includes gimbals and EO/IR sensors, arming and fuzing devices, weapons payloads, radios, and other mission hardware. We build the software and interfaces that enable these payloads to reliably run on the vehicle. Nearly every customer program needs a new or modified payload, which makes this team a critical contributor to nearly everything we ship. Our work goes from the lab bench to hardware-in-the-loop testing to live flight, and it has to work in a variety of demanding operational environments.

### **ABOUT THE JOB**

We are looking for a Software Engineer to join the Payload Integrations team. You will design, build, and maintain the software that brings new sensors, communications systems, and mission payloads onto our autonomous vehicles. You will work closely with hardware, electrical, autonomy, and systems engineering teams, as well as outside payload vendors, to turn new hardware into dependable, well-tested components of the vehicle. If you are self-motivated, hold yourself to high standards, enjoy working where software meets hardware, and do well in a fast-paced, high-autonomy environment, this role is for you.

### **WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* Design and implement software integrations for gimbals, EO/IR sensors, radios, arming and fuzing devices, and other mission payloads on autonomous vehicles.
* Define and maintain clean, reusable interfaces between payloads and the vehicle software stack, to enable new payloads without changes to autonomy code.
* Work through vendor interface control documents (ICDs), implement device drivers and protocol handlers, and lead hardware bring-up in the lab.
* Build simulation, emulation, and hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) test infrastructure to evaluate payload behavior before flight.
* Support integration events, ground tests, and flight tests, and root-cause issues across software, firmware, and hardware boundaries.
* Partner with program teams to scope, estimate, and deliver payload integrations for customer projects on tight timelines.
* Contribute to the safety-critical software behind arming and weapons-related payloads, with a high bar for rigor, review, and testing.

### **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* 3+ years of professional software development experience, with a focus on embedded systems, robotics, or hardware integration.
* Strong experience with Rust and/or C++, plus working proficiency in Python.
* Hands-on experience integrating hardware over common interfaces and protocols (e.g., UART/RS-422, CAN, Ethernet/UDP, SPI/I2C).
* Experience reading datasheets and ICDs and turning them into robust software implementations.
* Comfort debugging at the hardware/software boundary using lab equipment and bus/packet analysis.
* Experience developing on Linux-based systems.
* Excellent collaboration and communication skills, including working with external vendors and cross-functional engineering teams.
* US Persons: Must be a U.S. Person due to required access to U.S. export-controlled information or facilities.

### **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Experience integrating gimbals, cameras, EO/IR sensors, or tactical radios and datalinks.
* Familiarity with safety-critical or arming/fuzing systems and related development practices.
* Experience with UAS, missiles, or other aerospace/defense platforms.
* Experience building HIL/SITL test environments or hardware emulators.
* Familiarity with middleware and serialization frameworks (e.g., Protobuf, gRPC, DDS, MAVLink).
* Experience with embedded Linux, real-time systems, or resource-constrained environments.
* Background supporting field integration and flight test campaigns.
* Active U.S. security clearance, or the ability to obtain one.

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

  

### **Benefits**

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you're supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. *For more information,* *Explore Our Benefits**.*

We're looking for someone with a solid foundation in software development who is ready to take the next step: owning meaningful work, growing their technical capabilities, and becoming more independent over time. Make it rain. Make Snow. Make Earth Habitable.

Rainmaker builds and deploys audacious technologies that work with nature to create an abundant, habitable planet. We are modernizing proven cloud-seeding science with weather-resistant UAS, radar and satellite observations, numerical weather prediction, novel sensing and validation systems, and sustainable seeding technologies. We are building an integrated system to make more freshwater available to farms, ecosystems, and communities.

Our ambition is bold, but we pursue it with humility. We take on difficult problems in the real world with technical rigor, grit, integrity, and an openness to learning and course-correcting. We are hiring individuals with evidence of exceptional ability. If you want to build systems that endure, restore, and deliver the future we were promised, we want to hear from you.

The vehicle software team builds the software that operates Rainmaker’s cloud-seeding vehicles, connecting flight control, onboard computing, sensors, payloads, and ground operations. We work closely with electrical, mechanical, manufacturing, and flight operations teams to turn new hardware into reliable systems that can be built, deployed, and operated at scale. Our goal is to make every vehicle a dependable tool for delivering more freshwater where it is needed.

### **About the Role**

You will own embedded firmware across Rainmaker’s vehicle and its integration with our onboard and ground control software systems. Your scope includes flight-controller firmware, power distribution, sensor and payload controllers, and the interfaces connecting those systems to onboard Linux software. You will take work from architecture and board bring-up through testing, manufacturing, deployment, and support in the field. We’re looking for a high-agency engineer who identifies what needs to happen, turns incomplete requirements into a clear plan, and follows through until the hardware works reliably in real operating conditions. This is a hands-on technical ownership role with the autonomy to shape the firmware architecture and the responsibility to deliver it.

* Own the architecture, implementation, and maintenance of all embedded firmware across the vehicle, including flight-controller firmware, power distribution, sensors, and seeding payloads.

* Integrate firmware with our vehicle software so commands, device state, and telemetry behave consistently from the microcontroller to the operator.
* Design and validate safe startup states, watchdogs, interlocks, and recovery behavior for resets, communication loss, sensor faults, and interrupted updates.
* Own firmware builds, versioning, flashing, over-the-air updates, and recovery workflows so deployed vehicles run known, traceable software.
* Build automated tests, simulation, and hardware-in-the-loop coverage that catch regressions and exercise failure modes before releases reach the fleet.
* Partner with manufacturing and flight operations to make provisioning, calibration, diagnostics, and servicing repeatable and practical.
* Investigate bench and field failures using logs, telemetry, and lab instruments; resolve root causes and turn what you learn into better software and tests.

* 3+ years of hands-on experience developing embedded software or firmware for microcontroller-based systems, including board bring-up, hardware integration, and deployment into production or field use.
* Demonstrated ownership of an embedded subsystem from design through release and ongoing support, including making technical decisions independently, validating behavior on hardware, and resolving failures in real operating conditions.
* Strong systems programming skills in Rust and/or C/C++, with the ability and willingness to work across both Rust and C/C++ codebases.
* Practical experience with peripheral drivers and communication buses such as CAN, UART, SPI, and I2C.
* Comfort reading schematics and using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and hardware debuggers to isolate problems across electrical and software boundaries.
* The ability to reason about system failures and implement robust state machines, fault detection, safe outputs, and recovery paths.
* Experience building maintainable firmware with version control, reproducible builds, automated testing, and disciplined release practices.
* Evidence of high agency: you surface problems without waiting to be assigned, make sound decisions with incomplete information, ask for help when it matters, and close the loop on results.
* Clear communication and the ability to work closely with hardware engineers and operators, explain tradeoffs, and document decisions so others can build and service what you ship.

jobs.description:
At Auction.com, we’re transforming real estate. As the nation’s leading online platform for buying and selling residential bank-owned and foreclosure properties, we connect buyers, sellers, and investors with innovative technology. With over $70 billion in assets, our success is driven by a culture of innovation, collaboration, and impact. We go beyond the bid—empowering our people to thrive and shape the future of the industry
  
  
About the role
  
We run one of the largest digital marketplaces in residential real estate, where buyers, sellers, servicers, and agents transact on real property with real money at stake. Every listing that moves through our platform touches valuation, bidding, contracts, payments, and a long list of external systems, and the platform keeps evolving to meet the needs of the market.
  
We’re hiring full stack engineers to build that platform. You’ll work in React and TypeScript on the front end, Node, Kotlin, and GraphQL services behind it, running on AWS and Kubernetes. You’ll own features end to end: design, build, test, ship, and support them in production.
  
What the work looks like
  
You’ll work in a lean technology org (~50 engineers) which means there is no layer between you and the work that matters. What you build ships.
  
You’ll ship customer-facing features and the services that power them, usually in slices small enough to get in front of users quickly.
  
You’ll test what you build. That means automated coverage at the unit, integration, API, and end-to-end levels, wired into CI so it keeps working after you move on. We don’t hand code to someone else to verify.
  
You’ll debug real problems in production. Distributed systems fail in interesting ways, and figuring out why is part of the job, not an interruption to it.
  
You’ll be in design discussions and code reviews as a participant, not an observer. If you think an approach is wrong, we want to hear it early.
  
You’ll work directly with product, UX, data, and other engineers. Most of the interesting decisions happen in those conversations.
  
You’ll have room to build AI-enabled features. We’re actively putting LLMs into customer and internal workflows, and engineers here are shaping what that looks like.
  
Who does well here
  
The technical bar matters, but these are the traits that actually predict who thrives on this team.
  
You get curious when something doesn’t add up. A weird log line, a metric that moved for no reason, a function nobody can explain. You go find out why instead of routing around it.
  
Blockers are problems, not stop signs. Everyone gets stuck. What matters is what you do in the next hour. You try a few angles, read the source, check the logs, and when you do ask for help you show up with what you’ve already ruled out.
  
You’re still learning. You picked up something new in the last few months, probably because you wanted to rather than because someone assigned it. You can also say “I don’t know” without it costing you anything.
  
You care whether it worked. Not whether the ticket closed, whether the customer’s problem is actually solved.
  
What you bring
  

* Roughly 3+ years building and shipping production software
* React, or another modern component framework you can translate from
* Node.js or Kotlin/Java backend services, with REST or GraphQL APIs
* Hands-on experience in AWS or a comparable cloud
* Enough comfort with Docker and Kubernetes that a container deployment isn’t a black box
* Automated testing as a habit rather than a phase
* Working knowledge of CI/CD, plus relational and NoSQL data stores
* Judgment about performance, scalability, and security, and the instinct to ask about them before shipping

If you have most of this and a track record of picking up the rest quickly, apply anyway. We’d rather hire someone who learns fast than someone who checked every box five years ago.
  
AI and emerging technology
  
You don’t need to be an AI or ML engineer. We’re looking for software engineers who are genuinely curious about this space and want to apply it to real customer problems.
  
**Any of the following is a plus:** LLM and generative AI application work, AI API integrations, AWS Bedrock or comparable platforms, retrieval-augmented generation, conversational interfaces, or agent and workflow automation. Personal projects count.
  
Nice to have
  

* Background in fintech, proptech, real estate, mortgage, lending, payments, e-commerce, or marketplaces
* Experience with high-volume transactional systems
* Microservices, distributed systems, or event-driven architecture
* Experience on a team where engineers owned both delivery and quality

How we engineer
  
Quality is part of engineering, not a separate department. Engineers here test what they build and own it through production.
  
We keep feedback loops short. Trunk-based development, feature flags, small changes, frequent deploys.
  
We prefer clarity over cleverness, in code and in conversation.
  
We hire people who are curious, direct, and accountable, and then give them problems worth solving.
  
  
The good faith base salary [or wage] range for this role at the time of posting and hire is $103,700 – $135,000 per year. Actual compensation offered will be determined based on a number of factors, including but not limited to a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies, experience, and geographic location.
  
  
In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for an annual performance bonus.
  
  
Auction.com also offers a comprehensive benefits package for eligible employees, including (but not limited to):
  

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance.
* Auction.com contributes an amount equal to 25% of your eligible contributions in our 401k plan.
* Paid Time Off (PTO), including 12 paid holidays.

The availability and value of benefits may vary and are subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable plan documents.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Operations
jobs.description:
At Relativity Space, we're building rockets to serve today's needs and tomorrow's breakthroughs. Our Terran R vehicle will deliver customer payloads to orbit, meeting the growing demand for launch capacity. But that's just the start. Achieving commercial success with Terran R will unlock new opportunities to advance science, exploration, and innovation, pioneering progress that reaches beyond the known.

Joining Relativity means becoming part of something where autonomy, ownership, and impact exist at every level. Here, you're not just executing tasks; you're solving problems that haven't been solved before, helping develop a rocket, a factory, and a business from the ground up. Whether you're in propulsion, manufacturing, software, avionics, or a corporate function, you'll collaborate across teams, shape decisions, and see your work come to life in record time. Relativity is a place where creativity and technical rigor go hand in hand, and your voice will help define the stories we're writing together. Now is a unique moment in time where it's early enough to leave your mark on the product, the process, and the culture, but far enough along that Terran R is tangible and picking up momentum. The most meaningful work of your career is waiting. Join us.

**About the Team:**  
  
The Interplanetary Sciences Program was established to expand access to scientific exploration across our solar system. Its mission is to make planetary research faster, more affordable, and more capable than ever before by rethinking how science missions are designed, built, and operated. The program aims to enable scientists to send instruments to distant worlds without decades of development or prohibitive costs. By creating a sustainable model for interplanetary exploration, we are transforming space science from an occasional event into a continuous process of discovery that accelerates knowledge, broadens participation, and inspires the next generation of explorers.

**About the Role:**

  

The Interplanetary Sciences Program is building the operations software that will optimize the mission science and innovate in how we operate the spacecraft. The software will command, monitor, and coordinate the spacecraft, its science instruments, and its communications systems across the Mars 2028 mission. At Relativity Space, we set audacious goals. The Mars 2028 mission is designed to transform how we conduct interplanetary science missions bringing AI models to run on the spacecraft in Mars orbit. The instrument suite will sense the atmosphere to inform weather models and probe the surface with Radar to understand the location of ice. The mission operations for the Mars 2028 mission will also be ground-breaking with automation across the whole stack to enable autonomous science collection meaning the spacecraft can be re-tasked to acquire follow-up observations based on analysis and inference of recent data on the flight hardware.

As a Software Engineer – Operations, you will design and build the tools that mission operators, instrument teams, and external partners rely on every day from command generation and validation, to telemetry and data dissemination, to the interfaces that let outside teams safely and reliably interact with our systems. This is a high ownership and hands-on engineering role at the intersection of software, spacecraft operations, and cross-team collaboration, with real influence over how the mission is run.

Operations software is the layer between a spacecraft hundreds of millions of kilometers away and the humans, instruments, and partner organizations that depend on it working correctly, every time. The tools you build will directly shape how safely and efficiently this mission commands its spacecraft, ingests its science data, and supports the instrument teams counting on us to get it right.

**What You'll Do:**

  

* **Design and implement operations software:** Build, test, and operate spacecraft commanding tools — including command generation, validation, sequencing, and constraint-checking software — using modern engineering practices and AI-assisted / agentic development tools to accelerate implementation without compromising rigor.
* **Work cross-functionally:** partner with mission operations, GN&C, flight software, instrument, and ground systems teams inside Relativity Space, as well as external partners and instrument providers, to translate operational needs into working software.
* **Build test suites:** build automated test suites and validation frameworks covering spacecraft commanding, telemetry processing, and data dissemination — including regression tests, simulation/flatsat-based validation, and hardware-in-the-loop test support — so that changes to operations software can be verified quickly and safely before they touch the mission.
* **Define external interfaces:** define and document the interfaces (ICDs, APIs, data formats) that instrument teams and other external stakeholders use to interact with operations tools, ensuring those interfaces are clear, stable, and well-supported across the life of the mission.
* **Automate tooling** for commanding, telemetry visualization, anomaly investigation, and data pipelines as mission needs change over time.

**About You:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* 3+ years of software engineering experience, ideally including some exposure to mission operations, ground systems, command and control, or other safety- or mission-critical software
* Strong software fundamentals and hands-on proficiency with Python or a comparable language
* Experience designing and writing automated test suites (unit, integration, and/or regression tests) for complex or safety-critical systems
* Experience defining or working against external-facing interfaces or APIs (ICDs, schemas, protocol definitions) shared with other teams or organizations

jobs.description:
**About Us:**

Connexity**, a Taboola** company, is a data-driven retail performance marketing and commerce platform that helps online retailers acquire new customers and drive incremental sales at a cost that meets their ROI objectives. As the leading independent source of new customers and sales for retailers, we manage the complexities of new customer acquisition on behalf of thousands of retailers. Connexity technology connects merchants like Walmart, Wayfair and Macy's with high-intent shoppers across a vast and complex network of publishers, creators, search and marketplace channels. We joined forces with Taboola in 2021, own ShopYourLikes and Skimlinks, making us the largest, open-web performance platform in the Retail & eCommerce space, generating $5B of GMV/retail sales per year.

**About the Role:**

We are seeking a skilled and motivated backend engineer to join our Internal Tools team. Our team owns the design and implementation of our next-generation internal tools platform — a new advertiser management platform that unifies several legacy systems under a single, modern foundation, with a focus on high-performance middleware and backend services.

You will play a central role in building this platform from the ground up: designing APIs and services, shaping the data model, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable, high-performance solutions.

**Responsibilities:**

* Data Modeling: Design and optimize relational database schemas and queries that serve as the system of record for the platform.

 **Requirements**

You should be able to critically evaluate AI-generated code, recognize when it is wrong or subtly unsafe, and take full ownership of everything you ship. Experience integrating LLM APIs into applications or building internal AI-powered tooling is a plus.
* Collaboration: Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with a proven ability to work effectively in a team environment. Experience working in Agile methodologies.
* Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to tackle complex technical challenges.
* Education: A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field is preferred but not required.

  
**Benefits**

Voted “**Best Places to Work**,” our culture is driven by self-starters, team players, and visionaries. Headquartered in Santa Monica, the company operates sites and business services in the US, EMEA, and APAC. We offer top benefits including flexible time off, paid holidays, competitive comp, team events and more!

We encourage individuality and are driven to represent a workplace that celebrates our differences, and provides opportunities equally across gender, race, religion, sexual orientation, and all other demographics. Our actions across Education, Recruitment, Retention, and Volunteering reflect our core company values and remind us that we’re all in this together to drive positive change in our industry.

As the operator of a federally funded research and development center (FFRDC), we are broadly engaged across all aspects of space— delivering innovative solutions that span satellite, launch, ground, and cyber systems for defense, civil and commercial customers. When you join our team, you’ll be part of a special collection of problem solvers, thought leaders, and innovators. Join us and take your place in space.

The Digital Innovation Division (DID) is accountable for integrating strategies, providing governance, and managing internal investments that form the foundation of Aerospace’s **digital innovation and transformation** . The DID Mission IT pillar supports engineering teams across Aerospace by delivering **top-tier IT engineering and IT support services** tailored to meet the unique needs of our engineering community.

  

Mission IT Operations is seeking a skilled **Site Reliability Engineer** with expertise in Kubernetes, Linux, scripting, and automation. In this role, you will be a contributor developing and maintaining both on-premises and cloud-based Kubernetes clusters that form the core of an overall Platform as a Service (PaaS), providing essential support to our engineering team. These are not conventional business IT systems: they are specialized computing environments supporting engineers and scientists whose work contributes directly to the success of the nation's space enterprise.

  

As part of a multidisciplinary platform and infrastructure team, you will work with senior engineers to manage multiple Kubernetes clusters used for scientific analyses such as space launch telemetry analysis and modeling and simulation, as well as for Artificial Intelligence (AI) Large Language Model (LLM) Training and inference services. You will contribute to the development of innovative solutions to complex challenges within the space enterprise by collaborating with rocket scientists and aerospace engineers in support of our nation’s most critical space assets. This position requires a strong sense of shared responsibility and ownership, working alongside cross-functional team members to achieve our mission objectives.

  

**Work Model:** This is a full-time position based in El Segundo, CA or Chantilly, VA which requires 100% onsite work.

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Developing and sustaining advanced services for our Kubernetes-based PaaS (e.g., Coder workspaces, Kueue batching scheduling, Knative serverless, Crossplane control planes)

* Frequent full security patching of all layers of Kubernetes infrastructure while maintaining very high uptime

SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

**SR. SOFTWARE ENGINEER, PLATFORM**

The application software team is the central nervous system of SpaceX – we create mission critical applications that are used throughout SpaceX to accelerate launch vehicle production and flight as well as systems that allow Starlink to grow into a worldwide fast, reliable Internet service. We are looking for engineers who treat fellow teammates with fairness, respect, and support.

Our team is currently creating and evolving systems to enable rapid build and reuse of Starship as well as designing the next generation manufacturing software that will be used in high throughput factories for Starlink. Other applications range from platforms that support concurrent streams of data from many always-on assets to manage the world's largest satellite constellation to public facing systems where customers can join our Starlink network globally. We work closely with engineers throughout the company to create and update our systems with respect to crewed launches, Starship flights, changes to the Starlink network and much more.

Aerospace experience is not required to be successful here - rather we look for smart, motivated, respectful, collaborative engineers who love solving problems and want to make an impact on a super inspiring mission. You will have full ownership of challenging problems, working with a team of enthusiastic engineers with diverse perspectives to design and produce solutions that enable SpaceX to move towards our goals at a rapid pace. The success of the missions at SpaceX depends on the software that you and your team produce.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Develop highly reliable software solutions that are used across SpaceX
* Create new applications that improve how SpaceX operates
* Build prototypes to prove out key design concepts and quantify technical constraints
* Own all aspects of software engineering and product development
* Deep dive into your users' problems to find and create efficient solutions
* Bring your voice to the table in team collaborations on architecture, design, and code reviews

* Expertise in designing software systems

jobs.title: Full Stack Robotics Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**Overview**

Octavian Robotics is solving the #1 complication in the $3T surgical industry. We are building robots for the sterilization of surgical tools. Only now with generalized robotics models have we been able to tackle this problem and save lives.

This company is a spin-out from Sorting Robotics and we are inheriting a decade of robotics infrastructure and know-how. **The role is for the first robotics software engineer at the company.** You'll be working directly with the founders and learning from the previous team on how to build a robotics company. You'll need to be scrappy, a jack of all trades and a master of one, be able to communicate your ideas quickly and effectively, adapt to changing dynamics, have experience with robotics, and be able to push through the journey of building a new company.

This role is not for the faint of heart. You should expect to work 60+ hours a week, expect for there to be more problems than solutions, expect for you to have very little hand-holding, invent technology that didn't exist 6 months ago, expect to feel the pressure of performance when everyone in the room is depending on you and there are millions of dollars on the line. All this will be true, but you will also be in a room of people that respect you; where everyone is rowing together to achieve the noble goal of saving lives with our robotic systems.

**Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and implement software to control machines developed by Octavian Robotics.
* Build and implement the initial infrastructure of the company.
* Work closely with mechanical and electrical engineers and guide design decisions based on what software can effectively accomplish.
* Work closely with customer success and sales staff to translate customer and company needs into software solutions.
* Train entry/mid-level software developers in the development lifecycle of the product lines you're working on.
* Work with engineers and customer success staff to remote and debug logs in the machine and understand customer problems.
* This is an on-site position. You're expected to work on-site with the other team members five days a week. We are based in Los Angeles.

Sometimes, nothing will work, and you'll need to conduct experiments until the problem's root cause (hardware or software-related) is fully understood.

Before writing any code, you must deeply understand complex topics and communicate proposed solutions to a highly technical team. Ideally, you write the minimum number of lines that solve the problem ("spin lock? Why not? It solves this problem" - "I'll just use a JSON file for now as a database so anyone can easily modify it").

Your work will be focused more on clear communication and business impact than on lines of code you can write or cool tech you can use.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Familiarity with Python
* Familiarity with Git
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, AWS services
* Familiarity with web standards, RESTful APIs, OAuth
* Experience training VLA or inference models for motor control

You will work on different parts of the stack at various times. We expect you to understand where everything goes and why, and we expect you to add to the stack to make the development process more robust.

 **Requirements**  

* Must be AI-Native in all workflows
* Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related fields.
* Experience with Linux (systemd, journalctl, network manager, permissions).
* Hands-on experience in robotics or computer vision
* Experience working with Hardware.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills.
* Authorized to work in the US without visa sponsorship.

  
**Benefits**  

* $170,000 - $190,000 per year full-time salary.
* 0.5% - 1% equity.
* Health, dental and vision insurance, flexible spending account, paid time off, parental leave.
* Schedule: 12-hour shift, Monday - Saturday. This job is not for the weak of heart.
* In person, Van Nuys or Los Angeles, CA. Relocation package available.

jobs.title: Full Stack Software Engineer I
jobs.description:
Parallel Systems is pioneering autonomous battery-electric rail vehicles designed to transform freight transportation by shifting portions of the $900 billion U.S. trucking industry onto rail. Our innovative technology offers cleaner, safer, and more efficient logistics solutions. Join our dynamic team and help shape a smarter, greener future for global freight.

**Full Stack Software Engineer I**

Parallel Systems is seeking a Software Engineer I to join our Interfaces team. The Interfaces team builds the software people use to operate, monitor, and manage our vehicles and fleet, including our main operator application and the product surfaces that will grow into enterprise customer software. This is a junior role with real ownership. You do not need years of production experience, but you do need high agency, clear communication, and the hunger to learn fast. We care more about how you work than how many years you have been paid to work.

You've started contributing beyond the UI, such as data models, APIs, or performance and reliability improvements for our enterprise software.

**Basic Requirements:**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, computer engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience (bootcamp plus portfolio, research, or shipped projects are fine).

jobs.title: Sr. Software Engineer
jobs.description:
At Auction.com, we’re transforming real estate. As the nation’s leading online platform for buying and selling residential bank-owned and foreclosure properties, we connect buyers, sellers, and investors with innovative technology. With over $70 billion in assets, our success is driven by a culture of innovation, collaboration, and impact. We go beyond the bid—empowering our people to thrive and shape the future of the industry
  
  
About the role
  
We run one of the largest digital marketplaces in residential real estate, where buyers, sellers, servicers, and agents transact on real property with real money at stake. Every listing that moves through our platform touches valuation, bidding, contracts, payments, and a long list of external systems, and the platform keeps evolving to meet the needs of the market.
  
We're hiring Senior Full Stack Software Engineers to help build and evolve that platform. You'll work in React and TypeScript on the front end, with Node, Kotlin, and GraphQL services behind it, running on AWS and Kubernetes.
  
At the senior level, you'll own complex features and technical solutions end to end—from design and architecture through build, test, deployment, and production support. You'll also help raise the engineering bar through thoughtful design decisions, code reviews, mentoring, and technical leadership.
  
What the work looks like
  
You'll work in a lean technology organization (~50 engineers), which means there isn't a lot of distance between you and the work that matters.
  
What you build ships.
  
You'll design and deliver customer-facing features and the services that power them, balancing speed with scalability, maintainability, and long-term technical health.
  
You'll help shape technical approaches before development begins—identifying tradeoffs, challenging assumptions, and helping the team make sound architecture and design decisions.
  
You'll test what you build, with automated coverage across unit, integration, API, and end-to-end testing wired into CI. We don't hand code to someone else to verify.
  
You'll debug complex production issues across distributed systems and help identify root causes, not just short-term fixes.
  
You'll be an active voice in design discussions and code reviews. Senior engineers here are expected to bring perspective, challenge approaches when needed, and help other engineers get better.
  
You'll work directly with product, UX, data, and other engineers. Many of the most important technical and product decisions happen in those conversations.
  
You'll also have room to build AI-enabled features. We're actively incorporating LLMs into customer and internal workflows, and engineers here are helping shape what that looks like.
  
Who does well here
  
You get curious when something doesn't add up. A weird log line, a metric that moved unexpectedly, or a function nobody can explain—you go find out why instead of routing around it.
  
You take ownership. Blockers are problems to solve, and you're comfortable navigating ambiguity, evaluating options, and moving work forward.
  
You have strong technical judgment. You know when a simple solution is enough and when scalability, performance, security, or architecture requires deeper thinking.
  
You make the engineers around you better. You share context, provide thoughtful code reviews, mentor others, and help establish good engineering practices without needing a formal leadership title.
  
You're still learning. Technology changes quickly, and you're genuinely interested in learning new tools and approaches—including AI—and applying them where they make sense.
  
You care whether it worked. Not whether the ticket closed, but whether the customer's problem was actually solved.
  
What you bring
  

* 5+ years of professional software engineering experience building and shipping production applications
* Strong experience with React and TypeScript, or comparable modern front-end technologies
* Experience building backend services with Node.js, Kotlin/Java, or similar technologies
* Experience designing and working with REST and/or GraphQL APIs
* Hands-on experience with AWS or a comparable cloud platform
* Practical experience with Docker and Kubernetes
* Strong automated testing practices across unit, integration, API, and/or end-to-end testing
* Experience with CI/CD and modern software delivery practices
* Experience with both relational and NoSQL data stores
* Experience designing or contributing to scalable, distributed production systems
* Strong judgment around performance, scalability, reliability, and security
* Ability to independently own complex technical work from design through production
* Experience mentoring engineers, contributing to code/design reviews, and helping improve engineering practices

If you have most of this and a track record of picking up the rest quickly, apply anyway. We'd rather hire someone who continues to learn than someone who simply checked every box five years ago.
  
AI and emerging technology
  
You don't need to be an AI or ML engineer. We're looking for senior software engineers who are genuinely curious about this space and want to apply it to real customer and business problems.
  
**Any of the following is a plus:** LLM and generative AI application development, AI API integrations, AWS Bedrock or comparable platforms, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), conversational interfaces, or agent and workflow automation. Personal projects count.
  
Nice to have
  

* Background in fintech, proptech, real estate, mortgage, lending, payments, e-commerce, or marketplaces
* Experience with high-volume transactional systems
* Microservices, distributed systems, or event-driven architecture
* Experience modernizing legacy applications or services
* Experience on a team where engineers owned both delivery and quality

jobs.title: Backend Engineer (Python / FastAPI)
jobs.description:
Rim Universe is building an AI-native platform for animated and serialized video content creation. Our platform helps creators transform ideas and scripts into structured production workflows, including story development, character creation, episode and shot planning, AI image/video generation, and editing.

We are currently expanding our engineering team and looking for a **Backend Engineer** to help build the core backend infrastructure powering our platform. If you're passionate about AI video creation, we'd love to have you join our team and help turn more great stories into amazing videos!

About the Role

As a Backend Engineer at Rim Universe, you will be responsible for building and maintaining backend systems supporting **AI model integrations, generation workflows, media asset management, and user/project data**.

You will work closely with our AI and product teams to build reliable, scalable backend services that support AI-powered content generation in a production environment.

Responsibilities

* Design, develop, and maintain backend services using **Python and FastAPI**
* Build and maintain **REST APIs** for our platform
* Integrate third-party APIs, including **LLM, image generation, and video generation models**
* Design and optimize **PostgreSQL** databases and queries
* Build asynchronous AI generation workflows, including task queues, status tracking, retries, failure handling, and webhooks
* Develop backend systems for users, projects, generated content, and media assets
* Deploy, monitor, and troubleshoot services in **Docker/Linux** environments
* Improve system reliability, scalability, maintainability, and performance
* Collaborate with AI, frontend, and product team members to deliver production-ready features

Requirements

* **2+ years** of backend development experience, with at least one project taken through development, launch and ongoing maintenance.
* Strong **Python** skills and hands-on production experience with **FastAPI** or **Django**. Able to quickly read and maintain an existing codebase.
* Experience with **PostgreSQL**, database design, and SQL optimization.
* Understands how background job systems work: job state machines, **leases and heartbeats**, timeouts, **retries**, **idempotency** and **failure recovery**. Familiar with reliable messaging patterns such as the **transactional outbox**. Has used **Redis** (Streams, locks or queues).
* Experience integrating **third-party HTTP APIs**, including authentication, **async callbacks**, **status polling**, **rate limiting** and **error classification**. Understands why a **pay-per-call API** must not be blindly retried when the outcome of a call is unknown.
* Experience with **LLM API** integration, **prompt template** management or **agent** development.
* Familiar with object storage such as **S3** or **MinIO**: **presigned URLs**, uploads and downloads, and **access control**. Able to guarantee **multi-tenant data isolation**.
* Comfortable with **Linux**, **Docker / Docker Compose** and **Git**. Able to investigate logs, manage secrets, run backup and restore, and write tests for critical flows.

Nice to Have

* Hands-on work on **AI video, image or speech generation**, or audio/video processing; familiarity with **FFmpeg**.
* Experience with the **ComfyUI API** or building **multi-step generation workflows** (e.g. speech synthesis → video generation → lip sync).
* Experience building **Stripe** payments, subscriptions, credit ledgers or usage-based billing.
* Experience optimizing generation job performance, analyzing model costs or planning service capacity.
* Working knowledge of **Node.js / TypeScript** (our frontend BFF uses Next.js).
* Experience with global SaaS products.

What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for someone who can take ownership of backend systems from maintaining through deployment.

You should think beyond simply implementing APIs and consider system reliability, maintainability, scalability, and production performance when designing solutions.

Rim Universe is moving quickly, so we value engineers who can work independently, solve problems proactively, and communicate clearly with the team.

Pay: $30.00 - $40.00 per hour

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Employee discount
* Flexible schedule

Language:

* Mandarin (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

**About The Team**
------------------

The Sentry Tower Software team develops robotic systems that provide force protection capabilities, monitoring the perimeter of secure areas, land or sea, for approaching people, vehicles, and vessels. We live in a world where security officers are increasingly overwhelmed by sensor data feeds. Our products leverage advanced sensor fusion and autonomy to seamlessly render activity in the environment to Lattice's common operating picture.

**About the Job**
-----------------

Sentry Towers are robotic systems: motors, cameras, radars, radios, and sensor boards, running on NVIDIA Jetson compute in the field. Verifying that a system like this works means accounting for physical actuation, real sensor data, and hardware that fails in ways no unit test anticipates. We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer to own our simulation and hardware test infrastructure and make automated, whole-system testing the default for everything we ship. A regression that escapes here does not surface on a developer's laptop. It surfaces on a tower at a site someone has to fly to, guarding a perimeter that does not pause while we debug.

You will work across both halves of the problem. Our software-in-the-loop environments are declaratively defined multi-node virtual towers, complete with a simulated ground control station, synthetic sensor feeds, and a game-engine-driven world, which lets us run whole-system scenarios in CI with no hardware attached. Our hardware-in-the-loop side drives real Jetson-based towers through a board test server: provisioning them over the network, flashing firmware, installing full system images, and reporting results back through our CI pipeline on a nightly and weekend cadence.

Both foundations are in place and working, so you are inheriting infrastructure rather than starting from nothing. What does not exist yet is most of what sits on top: the functional test suites, the scenario library, and the diagnostic tooling that turn a booting tower into a verified one are yours to design. Firmware integration, compute platform bring-up, and both our Air Defense and Counter-Intrusion business lines depend on this capability, and what you build becomes the standard they test against.

Test infrastructure is a job where the wins are invisible and the failures are loud. You will spend real time on work nobody asks for by name: chasing intermittent failures to root cause instead of retrying them, waiting on hardware that is scarce and shared, and rebuilding coverage when a compute generation changes underneath you. The measure of the role is bugs that never reach a tower, which means much of your best work leaves no trace anyone thanks you for.

Our Product: https://www.anduril.com/sentry

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**
------------------

* Own and grow our SITL environments: add product variants and scenarios, keep the simulated sensor and video pipelines faithful enough to be trustworthy, and keep whole-system test runtimes short enough to fit inside a normal development cycle.
* Build out functional coverage on the HITL bench across the behavior that matters: motion control and trajectory execution, camera and sensor bring-up, firmware update paths, network failover, and clean recovery from power loss and unexpected reboots.
* Own the CI integration end to end: scheduling, dependency chaining between test stages, artifact and log capture, result reporting, and the flake triage that keeps a hardware pipeline trusted instead of ignored.
* Grow the test platform continuously as the product line does. New compute generations, new payloads, and new product variants each need coverage, and keeping the framework ahead of the roadmap is the enduring core of this role.
* Make failures diagnosable without touching the rig. Invest in log capture, serial console capture, and test artifacts so an engineer can root-cause from the CI output alone.
* Partner with hardware and manufacturing engineers to stand up the physical HITL benches, specifying the fixtures, switching, power control, and instrumentation needed to exercise towers unattended. This is a substantial upfront build with periodic expansion as new hardware arrives.
* Partner with firmware, platform, and business line teams so they can add their own tests against your framework, and support them as their first users.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**
---------------------------

* 4+ years of professional software engineering, with meaningful time spent building test infrastructure, CI systems, or simulation for systems that involve real hardware.
* Proficiency in Python for test authoring and automation, plus working ability in Rust or C++ to read and debug the services under test.
* Demonstrated experience automating tests against physical hardware: device provisioning, remote power and reset control, serial consoles, network booting, or instrumented benches.
* Strong CI/CD engineering skills, including pipelines with expensive stages, hardware resource contention, and scheduled rather than per-commit execution.

We're looking for a **Software Engineer** to join our Data Plane Transport team within Cloud Platform Engineering. Our team builds and operates foundational services that enable secure, reliable communication between Alteryx Cloud, data planes, and customer environments. Our work includes Data Bridge, which enables customers to securely access private data sources, along with shared platform services for connectivity, networking, registration, and

orchestration across distributed cloud environments.

  

This is a hands-on, backend-focused engineering role, primarily developing services and APIs in Go, with some opportunities to contribute to frontend applications using TypeScript and React.

You'll collaborate with experienced engineers, contribute to technical decisions, and take ownership of features and improvements from development through production.

  

This is a remote-friendly role.

**Key Responsibiliti** es

Design, develop, test, and maintain backend services, APIs, and distributed systems, primarily using Go.

Build and improve secure connectivity solutions involving service registration,

orchestration, routing, and proxy/relay-based communication.

Own well-defined features and enhancements through implementation, testing,

deployment, and production support.

Develop and maintain cloud-native services running in AWS and GCP, with a focus on reliability, security, and scalability.

Contribute to frontend applications and platform management experiences using TypeScript and React when needed.

Investigate and troubleshoot issues across application code, cloud infrastructure, and networking components.

Improve automated testing, monitoring, logging, alerting, and operational tooling. Participate in technical discussions, design reviews, and code reviews while collaborating with Product, Infrastructure, Security, and other engineering teams.

Participate in an on-call rotation after onboarding, helping maintain production reliability and address recurring issues.

  

**Required Qualification** s

2+ years of professional software engineering experience, or equivalent relevant experience.

Experience building backend services and REST APIs using Go or a comparable backend language, with the ability to become productive in Go.

Strong software engineering fundamentals, including debugging, automated testing, and writing clean, maintainable code.

Familiarity with distributed systems, microservices, and service-to-service communication.

Understanding of networking fundamentals, including HTTP/TLS, TCP/IP, DNS, and client-server communication.

Experience developing or deploying applications in cloud environments such as AWS, GCP, or similar platforms.

  

Experience with Git, automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and modern software

development practices.

Strong problem-solving and communication skills, with the ability to independently deliver

scoped work while collaborating with a team.

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

Experience with TypeScript, React, or similar frontend technologies.

Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, Terraform, or other cloud-native tooling.

Familiarity with cloud networking, private connectivity, proxies, gateways, or secure tunneling.

Exposure to event-driven architectures and messaging technologies such as Kafka, Redis, or Pub/Sub.

Familiarity with observability tools such as Datadog, metrics, logging, and distributed tracing.

Understanding of security concepts such as authentication, certificates, secrets management, and encryption.

Experience troubleshooting production services, participating in on-call rotations, or improving system reliability.

This role is also eligible for a target annual bonus of 15% of base salary, based on individual and company performance.

In addition to base pay and bonus eligibility, this role includes clear forms of additional compensation, such as:

jobs.title: Layout Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
Overview:

Keysight is at the forefront of technology innovation, delivering breakthroughs and trusted insights in electronic design, simulation, prototyping, test, manufacturing, and optimization. Our ~15,000 employees create world-class solutions in communications, 5G, automotive, energy, quantum, aerospace, defense, and semiconductor markets for customers in over 100 countries. Learn more about what we do.

Our award-winning culture embraces a bold vision of where technology can take us and a passion for tackling challenging problems with industry-first solutions. We believe that when people feel a sense of belonging, they can be more creative, innovative, and thrive at all points in their careers.

**About the Role:**

We are seeking a highly skilled R&D Engineer with extensive hands-on experience in RFIC, MMIC, RF module, or analog/mixed-signal layout, combined with an interest in advancing layout automation and design productivity.

The ideal candidate will have a strong background in developing and optimizing complex high-frequency IC layouts, with practical understanding of RF layout considerations such as device placement, matching, routing, shielding, isolation, passive structures, parasitic effects, and electromagnetic interactions.

This role is primarily focused on RFIC/MMIC layout and physical design, while also providing opportunities to contribute to layout automation through Python, parameterized layout generation, and collaboration with software and automation engineers.

Responsibilities:

* Develop physical layouts for RF, microwave, and analog integrated circuits.
* Work closely with circuit designers to translate schematics into high-quality, manufacturable layouts.
* Apply RF/analog layout techniques including device matching, symmetry, shielding, grounding, isolation, and parasitic optimization.
* Layout active devices and passive structures such as transistors, resistors, capacitors, inductors, transmission lines, and matching networks.
* Optimize layouts for electrical performance, area, manufacturability, and reliability.
* Perform and debug DRC, LVS, and other physical verification checks.
* Support layout iterations based on simulation, extraction, and design feedback.
* Use Python scripting to improve productivity and automate repetitive layout and design-flow tasks.
* Identify opportunities to improve existing layout workflows through automation.
* Collaborate with software and automation engineers to translate practical layout requirements into automated solutions.

Qualifications:

**Required Qualifications**

* Strong hands-on experience in RFIC, microwave, analog, or mixed-signal IC layout.
* Solid understanding of RF and analog layout techniques and physical design considerations.
* Experience with industry-standard IC layout and physical verification tools.
* Experience with DRC, LVS, and parasitic-aware layout.
* Ability to work closely with RF/analog circuit designers.
* Working knowledge of Python or similar scripting languages.
* Strong problem-solving and debugging skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with MMIC/RFIC design and layout.
* Experience with technologies such as GaAs, GaN, SiGe, RF CMOS, or other RF semiconductor processes.
* Familiarity with Python-based scripting or layout workflow automation.
* Experience developing or working with reusable/parameterized layout structures.
* Interest in improving engineering productivity through automation.
